rows.title: Senior Analyst B2C
rows.descriptionText:
Job Purpose

This role supports the Commercial Activation team by helping deliver actionable insights, facilitating best practice sharing across the group and assisting in managing the activation of commercial projects for our core FMC champions and portfolio companies.

Working under the guidance of the Senior Managers, you’ll play a key role in shaping selected commercial strategies (e.g. proposition strategy and development, operational and go-to-market strategies) and supporting initiatives aimed at improving customer loyalty, increasing net adds, and boosting customer ARPU. You'll also contribute to the operational side of strategic programs like digital transformation or post-merger activities and ensure best practice learning is shared and implemented across the group.

As an individual contributor, you are valued for your analytical capability. You deliver as part of a collaborative team, influencing through expertise rather than line management, and you are accountable for the quality, accuracy and timeliness of your work and recommendations

Key Accountabilities


Produce robust quantitative and qualitative analyses to drive commercial insights that inform decisions and help identify, size and shape new commercial opportunities Manage assigned work packages and projects to successful execution, spanning market research, customer value proposition (CVP) development, business casing and go-to-market support, always meeting agreed objectives and timeline. Contribute to the development of selected commercial strategies around product, service or experience: helping to design the proposition blueprint, deliver the business case and the go-to-market strategy. Support the identification and prioritisation of transferable best practice and implement structured knowledge sharing to leverage the benefits for all OpCo’s. Be accountable for the quality, accuracy and timeliness of their work and recommendations. Collaborate with the wider Commercial Activation team to support the VP Commercial Activation in operating and budget reviews for core businesses and portfolio companies; providing non-recurring analytical and performance insights and ensuring follow-through on commercial and operational questions, issues and opportunities. Contribute to the commercial & operations input to operating and strategic meetings where applicable and required (to CEO and Board level). Stay informed about commercial, operational and technological trends and innovations relevant to the industry. 

Knowledge & Experience

Essential Skills & Abilities:


A curious mind, a self-starting attitude and a passion for getting things done are a must, together with strong analytical skills with a focus on accurate data interpretation. Specific skills: Problem solving & structuring — applies critical and lateral thinking to break problems into actionable tasks and uncover root causes; supports strategy and approach formulation for projects. Data analysis & insight generation — collects and validates relevant data, applies sound statistical methods, and identifies insights within defined parameters, translating them into clear recommendations. Business casing — builds clear, structured models and supports opportunity sizing and scenario modelling, with foundational financial literacy (P&L, long-range plan, company reports). Market research & commercial acumen — conducts secondary research from the right sources, tracks relevant industry trends, and applies commercial judgement to sense-check insights and assess the likely implications or considerations of different commercial strategies. CVP & go-to-market — understands consumer pain points, can contribute to CVP development and shows a keen interest in go-to-market fundamentals. Data visualisation & digital literacy — creates clear visuals and is proficient with core tools (Excel, BI platforms such as Power BI or Tableau, and presentation tools). Storytelling & communication — drafts the building blocks of a narrative and structures them into compelling presentations; presents confidently and credibly to internal teams and stakeholders. Ways of working — organises and prioritises own workload to meet deadlines; collaborates effectively across remote, matrixed teams; takes ownership of own tasks and stays curious and resilient under pressure. Fluent in English. 

Desirable Skills & Abilities


Recent graduate - including those completing a rotational or graduate program - or min 2 years’ experience in commercial, strategy, analytics, consulting or related roles. Exposure to strategic thinking, transformation initiatives or commercial management projects in dynamic environments. Experience working in a matrixed, international organisation is a plus. Familiarity with the telecom, media, tech and related industries is beneficial. 

Preferred Education/ Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, engineering or alike. 

What’s in it for you? 


Competitive salary + Bonus **where applicable** 25 days annual leave with the option to purchase 5 more Access to wellbeing and mental health benefits such as the Calm app, personal medical, critical illness cover and dental insurance Matched pension contribution up to 10% (UK only) Free public transport subscription (NL only) 24 hours of paid Volunteer Time Off Discounted gym and wellness memberships Access to our car benefit scheme Access to our online learning platform to continue to develop and grow your career with us The chance to join an innovative, fast-paced and passionate team

rows.title: 2027 Risk Analyst Higher Apprenticeship Programme London
rows.descriptionText:
Annual Salary £25,200 + benefits

Getting qualified. It's a huge achievement that can completely change your prospects – but it’s not always open to everyone, whether that's due to the cost of university or the timing not being right. But with our apprenticeships, all that can change. Here at Barclays we offer a world-class programme that provides you with a permanent, full-time job with a competitive salary from day one - all whilst gaining a professional qualification at the same time. Whether you're a school-leaver looking for alternative options to the traditional university route or you're someone thinking differently about your future, we'll help you to build an extraordinary career at Barclays, no matter your background.

Our programme is designed for school leavers and career changers, but is open to anyone, no matter your background or your age. If you already have a degree, make sure you visit https://search.jobs.barclays/graduates and consider our graduate opportunities.

Why a Barclays Apprenticeship?

You’ll get the opportunity to earn whilst working towards a Compliance and Risk Officer Apprenticeship, a perfect blend of theoretical learning and real-life practical work whilst on a full-time salary in a permanent job. A unique chance to get a professional qualification without the student loan, all whilst getting years of work experience under your belt. Due to the evolving nature of Apprenticeships, a new Apprenticeship might become available and if deemed more relevant to your role, we'll change the Apprenticeship before you start.

We’ve spent over a decade perfecting the support that you’ll receive on our Apprenticeship programme. From day one, you’ll be assigned a Programme Support Manager matched to your needs and background, and together with your People Leader, they’ll support you as an individual. We’ll also match you to an expert in your specialist subject, ready to share their knowledge.

The Apprenticeship route gives you the opportunity for self-discovery and helps you to explore different career paths. With over 325 years of expertise in Banking, Barclays operates in 39 countries, employing around 90,000 people to help move, lend, invest and protect money for customers and clients worldwide.

Why the Risk Apprenticeship programme?

Risk is involved in every product, service and decision Barclays makes. You’ll build an understanding of the risks involved in banking, use data and judgement to support decisions, and help protect the future of Barclays.

Are you eligible?

First, you’ll need the right qualifications. For this apprenticeship opportunity you’ll need a minimum of 104 points at A2 (grades BCC) or an equivalent, e.g. BTEC DMM, plus GCSE Mathematics and English Language (grade A*-C / 9-4) or equivalent.

Beyond that though, we’re also looking for commitment and enthusiasm. Our Apprenticeships place deep investment in you as an individual. That means we need you to match that commitment: you’ll turn up every day ready to work hard, push yourself, and think differently about what you’re capable of.

To apply for our apprentice programme, you must meet the Government's apprentice funding requirements that apply to you (as outlined in https://www.gov.uk/ for apprentices in England and in https://www.saas.gov.uk/ for apprentices in Scotland).

The Government apprentice funding requirements include a number of requirements that you must meet, including a 3 year residence requirement (subject to certain exceptions). To qualify for the Government's apprentice funding requirements, you must also have the legal right to work for the full duration of the programme at the point of enrolment, with no gaps in your legal right to work or dependency on future visa applications during the period of your apprenticeship (August 2027 to August 2031).

You must also not have undertaken any previous study, education, training, qualifications, or apprenticeship, gained learning or competence from prior work experience, or received prior funding or financial support which renders you ineligible for the Government’s apprentice funding.

Working In London

If you love the buzz of city life, our global HQ is the place to be. Our London hub is in Canary Wharf, at the heart of London’s financial district, with opportunities to explore many functions across a global financial institution.

What happens once you apply?

Step 1 - We'll review your application

Step 2 - You'll be asked to complete our online assessments

Step 3 - We'll ask you to complete a survey, so we can be sure of your eligibility

Step 4 - It's time to attend an in-person assessment day, where you'll be assessed during a group activity and interview (this will take place from October 2026)

Step 5 - We'll let you know the outcome and give you feedback.

It is the policy of Barclays to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.

The closing date for applications is 25 September 2026. Please note that this vacancy may close ahead of the advertised date due to application volumes, and we therefore recommend submitting your application as early as possible.

Purpose of the role

To support the day-to-day operations of the risk division by monitoring the bank’s risk profile, identifying and managing risks and providing insights and expertise to support senior colleagues to make informed decisions.

Accountabilities


Execution of small research projects to support risk identification and strategic decision making. Prepare presentations and reports to communicate the findings to senior management.Collaboration with cross-functional teams to support business initiatives.Participation in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.Identification and management of risks including reviewing and challenging business propositions.Management of business and client relationships under steadily decreasing supervision.Support of risk management and decision making by using financial models and strategies.


Analyst Expectations


To meet the needs of stakeholders/ customers through operational excellence and customer servicePerform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standardNo people leadership roles at this grade.Execute work requirements as identified in processes and procedures, collaborating with and impacting on the work of team members.Identify escalation of policy breaches as required.Take responsibility for customer service and operational execution tasks.Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.Gain and maintain an understanding of own role, how the team integrates to achieve overall objectives, alongside knowledge of the work of other teams within the function.Work within well-defined procedures that may involve a variety of work routines.Demonstrate an understanding of the procedures.Evaluate and select the appropriate alternatives from defined options.Make judgements based on the analysis of factual information.Build relationships with stakeholders and customers to identify and address their needs, in support of a smooth operating process, handling sensitive issues as required.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: Data Executive
rows.descriptionText:
Hybrid (2 days per week in the Clarendon Road, London N8 office)

We're Civica and we make software that helps deliver critical services for citizens all around the world. From local to state government, to education, to health and care, over 5,000 public bodies across the globe use our software to help provide critical services to over 100 million citizens.

Our aspiration is to be a GovTech champion everywhere we work around the globe, supporting the needs of citizens and those that serve them every day. Building on 21 years of continuous growth and success, we're at a pivotal point on our journey to realise that aspiration.

Why you'll love this role of Data Executive

This is an exciting opportunity to join Civica Election Services (CES), a specialist team delivering ballot, election and democratic engagement services for organisations across the UK. Working with membership bodies, housing associations, health organisations, professional institutes, trade unions and corporate clients, CES helps organisations run secure, accurate and efficient voting processes.

As a Data Executive, you'll play a vital role in the successful delivery of these projects. Working across multiple live assignments at any one time, you'll prepare and validate data, manage personalised email campaigns, support print production and collaborate with teams across project management, digital, design, production and results services.

This role would suit someone who enjoys solving problems, working with data, and ensuring every detail is correct. Success isn't about coming from a specialist data background. We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, highly organised, comfortable managing competing priorities, and able to make sound decisions under pressure.

If you're looking for a role where accuracy matters, no two projects are the same, and your work directly contributes to the delivery of important democratic and member engagement processes, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

 Examine, cleanse and prepare client-supplied data for postal mailings and email distributions Check datasets for duplicates, formatting issues and other data quality concerns using Microsoft Access and Excel Create and maintain data quality reports, working with clients to resolve data issues where required Prepare and manage personalised email campaigns using dedicated email distribution platforms Monitor and oversee high-volume email distributions, ensuring successful delivery and resolving issues where necessary Create variable data print setups using document composition software such as Quadient Inspire Work closely with project management, design and production teams to ensure mailing requirements are accurately delivered Ensure the most appropriate Royal Mail products are selected to maximise postal efficiencies and discounts Prepare print documentation and production files for mailing activities Support additional print and data requests during live projects and election periods Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously, balancing changing priorities and short delivery timelines Maintain accurate project records and documentation throughout the delivery lifecycle Leverage tools such as Copilot and Microsoft Office to improve efficiency and accuracy Support wider Data, Design and Digital team activities as required

Requirements

 Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel Experience working with data, databases, administration, operations, project support or other detail-oriented environments Excellent attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy under pressure and to tight deadlines Strong organisational and workload management skills, with the ability to oversee multiple assignments simultaneously Excellent communication skills and confidence working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Good understanding of Windows operating systems and common file formats Curious, methodical and analytical approach to problem solving Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment Experience using Microsoft Access, SQL or other database tools would be advantageous Experience of document composition tools such as Quadient Inspire or similar software would be beneficial Knowledge of HTML, email marketing platforms or digital communications would be advantageous Experience working within a project-based environment would be desirable Understanding of Royal Mail mailing products and Mailmark would be beneficial Knowledge of VBA or other programming/scripting languages would be advantageous An interest in elections, governance, member engagement, or democratic processes would be beneficial

We Want You to Bring Your Whole Self to Work

There is no such thing as the perfect candidate, so if you think you have what it takes but don't necessarily meet every single point on the list above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

As a company, we're passionate about what we do and the citizens we serve. If you, too, want to champion the use of technology in public services to improve outcomes for citizens and public sector organisations, then Civica is the right place for you. rows.title: Application Support Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Division: Group Business Solutions (GBS)

Join our Group Business Solutions (GBS) division and help ensure the stability, performance, and reliability of the critical applications that support financial market operations. Working at the heart of our production environment, you will play a key role in troubleshooting complex issues, supporting business users, and continuously improving our application support services.

Your day-to-day mission

Provide expert support for business-critical applications across production and test environments.Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex incidents and problems, minimizing business impact and ensuring service continuity.Support application releases and deployments into test and production environments.Collaborate closely with developers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to ensure smooth service delivery.Respond to business and operational requests within agreed service levels.Assess the production impact of large-scale changes and contribute to implementation planning.Participate in disaster recovery testing, production site switches, and operational readiness activities.Develop and enhance scripts, automation tools, and support processes to improve operational efficiency.Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to strengthen system stability, supportability, and performance.Share knowledge, coach colleagues, and provide technical guidance based on your expertise.

What You Need To Succeed

Proven experience in Application Support, Production Support, or Service Support within a Linux environment.Strong SQL skills and the ability to analyse data and troubleshoot application issues.Experience writing and maintaining shell scripts.Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach to incident resolution.Strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and take ownership of complex issues.Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

What Makes You Stand Out

Experience with Java, Kafka, and OpenShift.Knowledge of ITIL practices and service management processes.ITIL Foundation certification, or willingness to obtain it.Experience supporting large-scale, business-critical applications in a complex enterprise environment.Exposure to performance testing, database administration, or other specialist support disciplines.Experience improving operational processes through automation and tooling.

Why join us

You'll be part of a collaborative team that combines technical expertise, problem-solving, and continuous improvement to keep critical financial market services running smoothly. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys troubleshooting complex systems, working across teams, and making a tangible impact on service reliability and customer satisfaction.

Please note: this position is open only to candidates who already have the legal right to work in the United Kingdom. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

rows.title: Programme Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

This role is the primary point of accountability within Europe for the governance, tracking and reporting of the project portfolio. As a Programme Analyst you will support the planning and monitoring of programs or projects, ensuring they align with organisational objectives and deliver expected outcomes.

 Ensures that project artefacts (e.g. risks, issues, dependencies, status reports, financials, milestones) are kept up to date, and to consult with Business Partners and other key stake holders to ensure the maintenance and integrity of the project workstack. Drives consistency of approach and standards of delivery and execution across the Project Management resource pool working in collaboration with the Programme Director. Coordinates and/ or completes the preparation of the key PMO deliverables (e.g. status reports, publications, dashboards, time/resource allocation), including the monthly Senior Leadership Team Governance decks (i.e. ELT, Deep Dive and Delivery Reviews), International and Enterprise reports. Leads multiyear planning and annual financial planning on behalf of Tech and Execution. Manages the document library (and associated repositories) from initiation of a new project through to closure. Coordinates and administers key PMO meetings. Set up new projects on ‘in house’ systems and provide frontline support to all SPandE team for general enquiries whether it be calendars, artefacts, governance, SharePoint or JIRA. Analyse program data, metrics, and performance indicators advising on potential issues related to costs, benefit realisation, schedules, and performance. Consolidates time sheets in readiness for invoice approval for non-permanent employees. Assist in developing program plans, timelines, and resource allocation. Communicate with internal teams and external partners. Facilitate meetings and document action items with appropriate follow up where required. Identify inefficiencies and recommend solutions. Support implementation of best practices – drafting new or revised policies and standardised procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

 Ability to collect and analyse complex sets of data. Good critical thinking and critical thinking skills. Strong project management skills. Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, or a related field.

Minimum Qualifications

 Demonstrated experience as a Programme Analyst, Management Analyst, or suitable experience in a similar role. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and report writing skills. Strong organisational and time management skills. Advanced computer skills and knowledge of multiple databases and software systems.

What Is in It for You?

Private Medical Insurance: On commencement of employment, you are eligible for single cover provided by Travelers, with the option to add cover for your dependents, at your expense through payroll deduction.Retirement: Travelers will make a core contribution of a percentage of salary to your Pension Plan. Additionally, if you decide to contribute to the plan, you will receive an increased company contribution.Holiday Entitlement: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 25 days holiday entitlement annually, plus the opportunity to purchase additional days to allow for up to a total of 35 holidays per year.Wellness Programme: The Travelers wellness programme is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health programme provides access to free professional counseling services and other resources that support your daily life needs.Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards programme that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

rows.title: Customer Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Welcome to KFC. Home of the real ones.We sell the world’s best chicken. Seriously. And we’ve done it since 1939, when the idea of crispy, original recipe chicken took Kentucky by storm. Now, we’re proud to serve 1000+ communities across the UK and Ireland, bringing the grit, pride and iconic reputation that we started with, all those years ago.
Across the Restaurant Support Centre (RSC), we come to work to be ourselves, and to make something of ourselves. We want to see our potential go that little bit further, as part of one of the world’s most iconic brands.
What’s the gig? Well, you support our restaurants - and we’ll support you every step of the way. Simple. Our doors are open - and they can take you anywhere.
All we ask is that you be you. Because that makes us, us. Sound good? Great. Let’s find out about that job.
THE TEAMOur Tech team is a 60+ strong team of curious minds, building the digital experiences that power KFC – from app to kiosk, delivery to checkout. We work cross-functionally, move fast, and stay focused on what matters: creating smart solutions that make things better for our customers and our teams.
ABOUT THE ROLEAt KFC, we have millions of customers choosing us every week, across restaurants, drive-thrus, kiosks, delivery and digital. That creates a lot of data. The exciting bit is what we do with it.We’re looking for a Data Analyst, Loyalty & CRM to help us better understand our customers, how they behave and what keeps them coming back for more.
Sitting within our Data & Analytics team and partnering closely with Loyalty, CRM and Marketing, you’ll dig into customer, transactional and marketing data to uncover insights that can genuinely influence what we do next.
You might be exploring why certain customers visit more frequently, identifying opportunities to increase loyalty and retention, understanding which campaigns actually changed behaviour, or spotting a commercial opportunity hidden within millions of transactions.
Yes, you’ll build brilliant reporting. But this role goes much further than telling us what happened. We want someone curious enough to ask why it happened, why it matters and what we should do about it.
If you love solving problems with data, understand customers and can turn complex analysis into a story that gets people to act, this could be for you.
WHAT YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME DOING
Customer Analytics & Insight
You’ll help us understand our customers better and turn that understanding into commercial opportunities.You’ll:Analyse customer, transactional, loyalty and marketing data to identify trends, behaviours, risks and opportunities.Measure how our Loyalty programme is performing and identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention and customer value.Build customer segmentation and behavioural analysis to support more relevant, personalised experiences.Understand customer acquisition, frequency, spend, retention and lifetime value.Evaluate campaigns, promotions and loyalty activity to understand what’s working and where we can improve.Turn complex datasets into simple, actionable recommendations.Proactively look for opportunities where insight can improve customer experience and commercial performance.
Reporting & Visualisation
Great decisions need data people can trust and understand.You’ll:Build, automate and maintain dashboards using Power BI and other reporting tools.Create clear reporting across customer behaviour, loyalty, campaign effectiveness and commercial performance.Establish consistent KPIs and reporting standards across Loyalty and Marketing analytics.Make sure reporting is accurate, scalable and easy to understand, whether the audience is technical or not.Continuously improve how we work through better automation, data quality and simpler reporting.
Business Partnering
This isn’t an analyst role where you disappear into the data and send someone a spreadsheet.You’ll:Partner closely with Loyalty, CRM and Marketing to understand the business problem before jumping into the analysis.Act as the dedicated Data & Analytics partner for Loyalty, helping turn questions and opportunities into clear analytical approaches.Work across Commercial Finance, Digital, Operations, Technology and the wider Data & Analytics team.Partner with Data Engineering to make sure the data you need is available, trusted and fit for purpose.Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders across the business.Help us build a culture where data and evidence genuinely influence the decisions we make.
WHAT WE’D LOVE FROM YOUWe’re looking for someone who combines strong analytical capability with real commercial curiosity.
You’ll ideally bring:Strong SQL skills and confidence interrogating large datasets independently.Experience with Power BI or similar reporting and visualisation tools.Experience working with customer, transactional or commercial data.Exposure to cloud data platforms such as Snowflake.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a great eye for detail.An understanding of data quality, validation and governance.Strong Excel capability.Experience delivering analytics within Customer, Marketing, CRM, Loyalty or another commercially focused environment.Examples of using data and insight to influence a commercial or strategic decision.Confidence working cross-functionally and explaining analysis to people who don’t live and breathe data.
A degree in a relevant discipline is useful, but equivalent professional experience is just as valuable.Even better if you have...CRM, loyalty or customer engagement analytics experience.Customer segmentation or behavioural analytics experience.Experience measuring marketing and campaign effectiveness.GA4 or other digital analytics experience.Knowledge of customer lifetime value, attribution or incrementality.Experience with experimentation, A/B testing or statistical analysis.Exposure to platforms such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Adobe Campaign.
 ABOUT YOUYou’re naturally curious. Finding the answer is great, but you’ll probably have another three questions once you get there.You’re commercially minded and want your analysis to lead somewhere, whether that’s a better customer experience, smarter campaign or stronger commercial result.You can take something complicated and make it simple.You’re comfortable challenging assumptions and following the data rather than looking for the answer someone wants to hear.You enjoy partnering with different teams and building relationships, rather than working in a silo.You’re proactive, organised and comfortable juggling priorities in a fast-moving environment.You’re always looking for a smarter, simpler way of doing things.And, of course... a true KFC believer.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:We offer benefits that make your life that little bit easier, because we know the juggle is real.From flexible, hybrid working to Fri-Yay early finishes and Live Well Days, we’ve created a package that supports the real you, in and out of work.
You’ll get:Hybrid working from our Woking RSC (just 24 mins from London). The tech team come into the office 2 days per week.Up to 11% company pension contributionsFri-Yay finishes at 1pm every Friday25 days’ holiday (plus bank hols) a5 Live Well Days a year, just for youBonus scheme linked to company & personal performancePrivate healthcare, Digital GP access & mental health coachingEnhanced parental leave and flexible return optionsStudy support, income protection, life cover & moreAnd yes—25% off the chicken
Because real ones deserve real rewards.
THE ROAD TO BECOMING A REAL ONE...Apply (Go on... do it) – send us your CV and answer a couple of app questions.Intro call with our Talent TeamVirtual call with Hiring Manager + another team memberF2F interview & Task at our HQ, Home of The Real Ones in Woking
KFC FOR EVERYONE:Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, KFC is a place where you can bring the real you to work.
Our promise is this: every person who applies to a role at KFC, regardless of age, background, ethnicity, gender, ability, religion or sexual orientation, will have an equal opportunity to work here. We don’t just welcome, we encourage applications from underrepresented groups from all industries.
If you’d like any additional support with your application, have a disability or condition that may affect your performance during the recruitment process, or have any other requirements - just let us know. We’ll be there to help you be the real you.
Ready?We hope so, if you’re ready to be part of our community, now’s the time to apply.
Worried you aren’t ticking all the boxes? Don’t - we’d still love to hear from you.
Beware of fake job postings using Yum! and/or our brand logos -- KFC, Pizza Hut, Taco Bell and Habit Burger & Grill -- on fraudulent sites. Yum! Brands only posts jobs on official careers pages and never asks for money during onboarding. Avoid unsolicited contacts via Telegram, WhatsApp or similar social apps.

rows.title: Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Elevate

Elevate is a full-service consulting firm that inspires high-performing organizations to find their limits and push past them. With expertise in brand consulting, sales strategy, data-driven insights, and talent optimization, Elevate gives its clients a competitive edge in the fight for people’s precious time and attention. Established in 2018, Elevate set out to help sports teams and leagues spark innovation and drive performance. In the years since, the world of sports has transformed, today standing at the convergence of media, entertainment, and consumer brands, with Elevate supporting some of the world’s most ambitious businesses across these sectors. Elevate’s proprietary technology, data sources, and software products combined with our thoughtful insights, and people-centric approach give clients a 360-degree view of their customers, underpinning intelligent decision-making on marketing spend, growth strategy, and more.

Our team of 700+ employees spans the globe with in 20 locations worldwide. We value recruiting diverse individuals to our team to bring new perspectives to our company and look forward to learning more about you in the recruitment process. To learn more and see what we’ve been up to, follow Elevate on X, LinkedIn, and Instagram.

Overview

Elevate operates as a fully integrated partner for its clients, adding insight, expertise, and in-market marquee asset sales activity to accelerate and enhance revenue in collaboration with the client’s leadership, partnership teams and wider stakeholder landscape (e.g. marketing and brand, hospitality, technology, community, venue operations, etc.)

Elevate is seeking a passionate and talented individual to join our Strategy and Insights team within the International Partnerships department. Based in London, the ideal candidate will have a deep interest in sports and a proven ability to research and analyse businesses across various industries. We value curiosity and seek someone who can methodically channel their efforts to deliver actionable insights that drive success across sponsorship sales projects. The role requires creativity in aligning brands with sports properties and the ability to communicate ideas effectively through both written and verbal formats. The candidate will also play a key role in sourcing, managing, and leveraging data to build value for rights holders and venues. A flair for crafting innovative materials and creating compelling sales narratives to support our objectives is essential

Key Deliverables

Conduct detailed research on companies, including spend analysis, target geographies, marketing budgets, and previous sponsorship activities, as well as broader industry trends to identify opportunities and inform strategy.Create and maintain organised data sets and dashboards in Excel to house research findings, ensuring accessibility and usability for the broader team.Develop creative brand alignment concepts in collaboration with the Partnerships team, leveraging research to match brands with sports properties effectively.Provide ongoing support for sales conversations by sourcing relevant information, crafting tailored materials, and contributing insights to enhance client engagement.Manage reporting processes, ensuring accurate and timely updates for both internal stakeholders and clients, and oversee the effective use of the CRM system to track progress and outcomes.Collaborate with internal teams to produce impactful sales narratives and presentations, translating research and insights into compelling client-facing materials.Support the preparation and execution of sales pitches, client meetings, and brand negotiations by articulating insights and presenting data confidently in both written and verbal formats.Support with managing relationships with data providers, including briefing on requirements, monitoring data delivery, and maintaining effective partnerships.

PERSON SPECIFICATION

Demonstrates a genuine passion for sports and a strong interest in understanding its intersection with business and sponsorships.Combines analytical and creative thinking to uncover insights, identify opportunities, and translate them into actionable strategies.Enjoys conducting thorough research, demonstrating curiosity and the ability to investigate topics on a deeper level.Proficient in Microsoft Excel, with the ability to organise and analyse data effectively, as well as experience in creating professional and visually engaging presentation slides.Experience using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) is highly desirable, with the capability to manage and utilise client and sales data efficiently.Possesses excellent interpersonal and communication skills, enabling clear articulation of ideas and confident collaboration with team members, clients, and stakeholders.A strong team player who is adaptable and proactive in providing support and contributing to shared goals.Able to balance multiple priorities and meet deadlines under pressure while maintaining a high standard of work.Goal-oriented with a results-driven mindset and a commitment to delivering exceptional outcomes.Ability to work in the UK

This position is open to all qualified candidates. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability in connection with the application process, you may contact us at HR@oneelevate.com

We are proud to be an equal opportunity/veterans/disabled/ LGBT employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

rows.title: Data Executive
rows.descriptionText:
Hybrid (2 days per week in the Clarendon Road, London N8 office)

We're Civica and we make software that helps deliver critical services for citizens all around the world. From local to state government, to education, to health and care, over 5,000 public bodies across the globe use our software to help provide critical services to over 100 million citizens.

Our aspiration is to be a GovTech champion everywhere we work around the globe, supporting the needs of citizens and those that serve them every day. Building on 21 years of continuous growth and success, we're at a pivotal point on our journey to realise that aspiration.

Why you'll love this role of Data Executive

This is an exciting opportunity to join Civica Election Services (CES), a specialist team delivering ballot, election and democratic engagement services for organisations across the UK. Working with membership bodies, housing associations, health organisations, professional institutes, trade unions and corporate clients, CES helps organisations run secure, accurate and efficient voting processes.

As a Data Executive, you'll play a vital role in the successful delivery of these projects. Working across multiple live assignments at any one time, you'll prepare and validate data, manage personalised email campaigns, support print production and collaborate with teams across project management, digital, design, production and results services.

This role would suit someone who enjoys solving problems, working with data, and ensuring every detail is correct. Success isn't about coming from a specialist data background. We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, highly organised, comfortable managing competing priorities, and able to make sound decisions under pressure.

If you're looking for a role where accuracy matters, no two projects are the same, and your work directly contributes to the delivery of important democratic and member engagement processes, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

 Examine, cleanse and prepare client-supplied data for postal mailings and email distributions Check datasets for duplicates, formatting issues and other data quality concerns using Microsoft Access and Excel Create and maintain data quality reports, working with clients to resolve data issues where required Prepare and manage personalised email campaigns using dedicated email distribution platforms Monitor and oversee high-volume email distributions, ensuring successful delivery and resolving issues where necessary Create variable data print setups using document composition software such as Quadient Inspire Work closely with project management, design and production teams to ensure mailing requirements are accurately delivered Ensure the most appropriate Royal Mail products are selected to maximise postal efficiencies and discounts Prepare print documentation and production files for mailing activities Support additional print and data requests during live projects and election periods Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously, balancing changing priorities and short delivery timelines Maintain accurate project records and documentation throughout the delivery lifecycle Leverage tools such as Copilot and Microsoft Office to improve efficiency and accuracy Support wider Data, Design and Digital team activities as required

Requirements

 Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel Experience working with data, databases, administration, operations, project support or other detail-oriented environments Excellent attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy under pressure and to tight deadlines Strong organisational and workload management skills, with the ability to oversee multiple assignments simultaneously Excellent communication skills and confidence working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Good understanding of Windows operating systems and common file formats Curious, methodical and analytical approach to problem solving Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment Experience using Microsoft Access, SQL or other database tools would be advantageous Experience of document composition tools such as Quadient Inspire or similar software would be beneficial Knowledge of HTML, email marketing platforms or digital communications would be advantageous Experience working within a project-based environment would be desirable Understanding of Royal Mail mailing products and Mailmark would be beneficial Knowledge of VBA or other programming/scripting languages would be advantageous An interest in elections, governance, member engagement, or democratic processes would be beneficial

We Want You to Bring Your Whole Self to Work

There is no such thing as the perfect candidate, so if you think you have what it takes but don't necessarily meet every single point on the list above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

As a company, we're passionate about what we do and the citizens we serve. If you, too, want to champion the use of technology in public services to improve outcomes for citizens and public sector organisations, then Civica is the right place for you. We will help you unlock the best version of yourself, achieve career growth, and make a real difference to people and communities.

rows.title: Junior Analyst, Royalty Tracking & Business Intelligence
rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Junior Tracking Analyst

Department: Royalty Tracking & BI
Reporting To: Director of Tracking & BI
Location: London, United Kingdom
Hybrid Working: 3 days in your local office
Full-time | PermanentThe Role

As a Junior Tracking Analyst on our Royalty Tracking & BI team, you'll play a key role in supporting our Writer & Publisher Relations, Finance, Royalties, and Copyright teams by transforming data into valuable insights. You'll ensure revenue from global affiliates is accurately tracked and help identify new opportunities to maximise revenue across new and existing markets. Reporting directly to the Director of Tracking & BI, you'll be at the heart of driving transparent and actionable data solutions.To succeed in this role, you will need strong organisational and prioritisation skills, along with the ability to adapt quickly to new challenges. A positive, can-do attitude is essential, as is the ability to tell a compelling story with data. You should be able to make sense of ambiguous business queries and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to clarify and align on deliverables. Taking ownership of creating actionable dashboards that make business intelligence accessible across departments will be a key responsibility. You will manage both recurring and ad-hoc projects, with a focus on income tracking to maximise value and provide clients with transparent, accurate royalty reporting. You should also be comfortable working with large datasets and proficient in communicating insights through data visualisation.This is a great opportunity to join a passionate, innovative team where your work will have a direct impact on the music industry's most transparent and accurate royalty reporting.What You'll Do

You create, improve and maintain actionable dashboards that solve business problems.You conduct ad hoc investigations, create reports, and deliver insights to Senior Management.You support income royalty analysis for external clients and internal queries.You maintain and improve processes tracking income over time.You investigate income gaps and payment anomalies with your cross-functional peers.You keep updated on incoming statements from PROs, CMOs, and direct licences to inform revenue performance.You assist with audit investigations, delivering accurate analysis and commentary.You enhance your technical skills and domain knowledge to apply in ongoing projects.You collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and address business challenges.What You'll Bring

Preferred:

Experience with Tableau for dashboard creation, development and maintenance.Basic SQL skills (writing queries, joining tables, case logic).Intermediate Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, charts).Strong organisational and prioritisation skills under tight deadlines.Excellent communication and problem-solving mindset.High numeracy and attention to detail.Additional Skills That Could Add Value:

A basic understanding of publishing and royalty income flow across various revenue and rights streams, including radio, live performance, audio visual, and particularly the digital landscape and major DSPs.What Success Looks Like

By Month 3: Building Foundations

You'll have developed a strong understanding of Kobalt's royalty tracking processes, business intelligence tools, and reporting requirements. You'll be confidently supporting dashboard maintenance, income tracking activities, and reporting requests while building strong relationships with stakeholders across Writer & Publisher Relations, Finance, Royalties, and Copyright.By Month 6: Delivering Actionable Insights

You'll be independently creating and maintaining dashboards, supporting income tracking initiatives, investigating payment anomalies, and delivering meaningful analysis that helps improve transparency and supports business decision-making.By Year 1: Trusted Business Partner

You'll be a trusted member of the Royalty Tracking & BI team, confidently managing recurring reporting and ad hoc analysis, identifying opportunities to improve tracking processes, and delivering actionable insights that maximise revenue opportunities and support accurate royalty reporting across Kobalt.
Key Behaviours for Success

Analytical Thinking

Uses data to identify trends, investigate issues, and deliver meaningful insights that support informed business decisions.Curiosity & Problem Solving

Enjoys exploring complex datasets, asking questions, and finding practical solutions to ambiguous business challenges.Collaboration & Communication

Works effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, translating data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.Interview Process

Introductory call with a member of our Recruitment Team.Interviews with the hiring manager and team.Final stage interview which includes an onsite task. Feedback at each stage.We aim to complete the full interview process from initial application to offer within three working weeks. While we do our best to meet this timeline, there may be occasional delays. If that happens, our Recruitment Team will keep you updated every step of the way.Why Choose Us

At Kobalt, we've championed creators since 2000. Our technology and music services are built to make the industry more transparent, fair, and rewarding for artists, songwriters, and rights holders.We're proud to work with some of the world's most influential talents including Phoebe Bridgers, Sam Fender, Paul McCartney, Foo Fighters, Karol G, Young Thug, Kali Uchis, and Andrew Watt, as well as acclaimed writers like Simon Aldred (Rag'n'Bone Man, Liam Gallagher, Celeste) and Clarence Coffee Jr. (Dua Lipa, Lizzo, The Snuts).We're a company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and progress. Our values: Music First, Transparent, Tech Powered, and Transformative shape how we work, build, and grow together. We are a community of people who care deeply about making a meaningful impact in music and technology.Kobalt is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in equitable access to opportunities and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know—we're happy to help.If this sounds like you, then please share your story by filling out the application below. To get you in the right mood, have a listen here to songs by our talented creators, especially curated to get you in the right mood when looking for the next challenge!Important Notice

Applicants must be eligible to work in the United Kingdom. A full DBS check will be conducted on acceptance of the offer.Kobalt is an equal opportunity employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, national origin, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other status or characteristic protected by law.

This role would suit someone who enjoys solving problems, working with data, and ensuring every detail is correct. Success isn't about coming from a specialist data background. We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, highly organised, comfortable managing competing priorities, and able to make sound decisions under pressure.

If you're looking for a role where accuracy matters, no two projects are the same, and your work directly contributes to the delivery of important democratic and member engagement processes, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

 Examine, cleanse and prepare client-supplied data for postal mailings and email distributions Check datasets for duplicates, formatting issues and other data quality concerns using Microsoft Access and Excel Create and maintain data quality reports, working with clients to resolve data issues where required Prepare and manage personalised email campaigns using dedicated email distribution platforms Monitor and oversee high-volume email distributions, ensuring successful delivery and resolving issues where necessary Create variable data print setups using document composition software such as Quadient Inspire Work closely with project management, design and production teams to ensure mailing requirements are accurately delivered Ensure the most appropriate Royal Mail products are selected to maximise postal efficiencies and discounts Prepare print documentation and production files for mailing activities Support additional print and data requests during live projects and election periods Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously, balancing changing priorities and short delivery timelines Maintain accurate project records and documentation throughout the delivery lifecycle Leverage tools such as Copilot and Microsoft Office to improve efficiency and accuracy Support wider Data, Design and Digital team activities as required

Requirements

 Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel Experience working with data, databases, administration, operations, project support or other detail-oriented environments Excellent attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy under pressure and to tight deadlines Strong organisational and workload management skills, with the ability to oversee multiple assignments simultaneously Excellent communication skills and confidence working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Good understanding of Windows operating systems and common file formats Curious, methodical and analytical approach to problem solving Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment Experience using Microsoft Access, SQL or other database tools would be advantageous Experience of document composition tools such as Quadient Inspire or similar software would be beneficial Knowledge of HTML, email marketing platforms or digital communications would be advantageous Experience working within a project-based environment would be desirable Understanding of Royal Mail mailing products and Mailmark would be beneficial Knowledge of VBA or other programming/scripting languages would be advantageous An interest in elections, governance, member engagement, or democratic processes would be beneficial

We Want You to Bring Your Whole Self to Work

There is no such thing as the perfect candidate, so if you think you have what it takes but don't necessarily meet every single point on the list above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

As a company, we're passionate about what we do and the citizens we serve. If you, too, want to champion the use of technology in public services to improve outcomes for citizens and public sector organisations, then Civica is the right place for you. We will help you unlock the best version of yourself, achieve career growth, and make a real difference to people and communities.

We know that when our people are happy, they work better and have greater job satisfaction. Here's what you can expect:

Benefits

Time Off & Work-Life Balance

✔ 25 Days Annual Leave + bank holidays, plus the option to buy up to 10 extra days

✔ Days of Difference, with up to 3 additional days off for volunteering activities

rows.title: Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Elevate

Elevate is a full-service consulting firm that inspires high-performing organizations to find their limits and push past them. With expertise in brand consulting, sales strategy, data-driven insights, and talent optimization, Elevate gives its clients a competitive edge in the fight for people’s precious time and attention. Established in 2018, Elevate set out to help sports teams and leagues spark innovation and drive performance. In the years since, the world of sports has transformed, today standing at the convergence of media, entertainment, and consumer brands, with Elevate supporting some of the world’s most ambitious businesses across these sectors. Elevate’s proprietary technology, data sources, and software products combined with our thoughtful insights, and people-centric approach give clients a 360-degree view of their customers, underpinning intelligent decision-making on marketing spend, growth strategy, and more.

Our team of 700+ employees spans the globe with in 20 locations worldwide. We value recruiting diverse individuals to our team to bring new perspectives to our company and look forward to learning more about you in the recruitment process. To learn more and see what we’ve been up to, follow Elevate on X, LinkedIn, and Instagram.

Overview

Elevate operates as a fully integrated partner for its clients, adding insight, expertise, and in-market marquee asset sales activity to accelerate and enhance revenue in collaboration with the client’s leadership, partnership teams and wider stakeholder landscape (e.g. marketing and brand, hospitality, technology, community, venue operations, etc.)

Elevate is seeking a passionate and talented individual to join our Strategy and Insights team within the International Partnerships department. Based in London, the ideal candidate will have a deep interest in sports and a proven ability to research and analyse businesses across various industries. We value curiosity and seek someone who can methodically channel their efforts to deliver actionable insights that drive success across sponsorship sales projects. The role requires creativity in aligning brands with sports properties and the ability to communicate ideas effectively through both written and verbal formats. The candidate will also play a key role in sourcing, managing, and leveraging data to build value for rights holders and venues. A flair for crafting innovative materials and creating compelling sales narratives to support our objectives is essential

Key Deliverables

Conduct detailed research on companies, including spend analysis, target geographies, marketing budgets, and previous sponsorship activities, as well as broader industry trends to identify opportunities and inform strategy.Create and maintain organised data sets and dashboards in Excel to house research findings, ensuring accessibility and usability for the broader team.Develop creative brand alignment concepts in collaboration with the Partnerships team, leveraging research to match brands with sports properties effectively.Provide ongoing support for sales conversations by sourcing relevant information, crafting tailored materials, and contributing insights to enhance client engagement.Manage reporting processes, ensuring accurate and timely updates for both internal stakeholders and clients, and oversee the effective use of the CRM system to track progress and outcomes.Collaborate with internal teams to produce impactful sales narratives and presentations, translating research and insights into compelling client-facing materials.Support the preparation and execution of sales pitches, client meetings, and brand negotiations by articulating insights and presenting data confidently in both written and verbal formats.Support with managing relationships with data providers, including briefing on requirements, monitoring data delivery, and maintaining effective partnerships.

PERSON SPECIFICATION

Demonstrates a genuine passion for sports and a strong interest in understanding its intersection with business and sponsorships.Combines analytical and creative thinking to uncover insights, identify opportunities, and translate them into actionable strategies.Enjoys conducting thorough research, demonstrating curiosity and the ability to investigate topics on a deeper level.Proficient in Microsoft Excel, with the ability to organise and analyse data effectively, as well as experience in creating professional and visually engaging presentation slides.Experience using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) is highly desirable, with the capability to manage and utilise client and sales data efficiently.Possesses excellent interpersonal and communication skills, enabling clear articulation of ideas and confident collaboration with team members, clients, and stakeholders.A strong team player who is adaptable and proactive in providing support and contributing to shared goals.Able to balance multiple priorities and meet deadlines under pressure while maintaining a high standard of work.Goal-oriented with a results-driven mindset and a commitment to delivering exceptional outcomes.Ability to work in the UK
