rows.title: Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Research Analyst – JLL

What this job involves:

We are seeking a Research Analyst to join our team in our Silicon Valley office in Menlo Park. In this role, you will build and elevate a best-in-class research program that differentiates JLL and drives competitive advantage through market expertise, analysis, and insight. You will achieve data excellence while enhancing our offerings in business intelligence, data visualization, and graphical output. With primary responsibility for the Silicon Valley and Mid-Peninsula commercial real estate market, you will collaborate closely with JLL research leadership in San Francisco and colleagues throughout the Americas research group. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the largest research group in the real estate industry while working within a diverse, collaborative, and driven professional environment.

What your day-to-day will look like:

Collect and audit JLL's proprietary database of commercial real estate properties, lease and sale comps for office, industrial, and retail propertiesCollaborate with local market leadership and sales force to execute data collection and auditing plansAnalyze and present commercial real estate trends, including leasing, business migration, sales, and socio-economic dataExpand and improve the research platform, program, and output that demonstrates market expertise through data excellenceCreate compelling visual communications integrating JLL's proprietary research data for business development, external distribution, and client requestsDevelop strong relationships with internal and external clients and facilitate the use of technology toolsPresent to internal teams and clients to demonstrate tools and analytical capabilities

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in business, economics, urban planning, or related fieldUp to one year in commercial real estate research, economic and demographic analysis, or closely related fieldCommand of requisite technology including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and database systemsHigh-level analytical skills and problem-solving abilityStrong written and oral communication skillsStrong organizational, data collection, validation, and auditing skillsAbility to multi-task, succeed under pressure, and effectively manage time and workload

Preferred Qualifications:

Command of local Silicon Valley and Mid-Peninsula markets and business dynamicsComfort with visualization tools and data presentation platformsProactive and strategic thinking with ability to align research with business objectives and innovate research outputInterest in life science related real estate and understanding its importance within the Bay AreaMotivated and self-starting with a desire to succeed and contribute to team successAbility to develop and share best practice standards across regionsExperience presenting professionally to clients and representing the firm

Location: Onsite – Menlo Park, CA

At JLL, we are collectively shaping a brighter way — for our clients, ourselves and our fellow employees. We choose to take the more inspiring, innovative, and optimistic path on our journey toward success. What sets JLL apart is our culture of collaboration, locally and across the globe, which allows us to create transformative solutions for the real estate industry. We support each other's wellbeing and champion inclusivity and belonging across teams.

JLL is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Air Apps
At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.
The Role
As a Data Analyst at Air Apps, you will be responsible for analyzing and interpreting data to drive business insights and optimize product performance. You will create reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to help teams make informed decisions and improve user experience.
This role requires a data-driven mindset, strong analytical skills, and experience with visualization tools to turn complex data into actionable insights.
Responsibilities
Analyze user behavior, product performance, and key business metrics to identify trends and opportunities.Create and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using tools like Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Google Data Studio.Collect, clean, and structure large datasets to ensure accuracy and usability.Define and track KPIs for marketing, product, and business performance.Work with SQL, Python, or R to extract, analyze, and manipulate data.Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and marketing teams to provide data-driven insights.Conduct A/B testing and experiment analysis to improve product features and user engagement.Identify bottlenecks and opportunities in user journeys and customer funnels.Present findings in a clear and compelling way to stakeholders and leadership teams.Stay up to date with industry trends, analytics best practices, and emerging data tools.
Requirements
Around 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field.Proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation.Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Google Data Studio).Strong analytical skills with experience in Python or R for data analysis.Knowledge of A/B testing methodologies and statistical analysis.Experience with Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar user analytics tools.Strong problem-solving skills and ability to communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders.Experience working with large datasets and cloud-based data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake).Familiarity with ETL processes and data pipeline optimization is a plus.Ability to work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and manage multiple projects.
What benefits are we offering?
Apple hardware ecosystem for work.Annual Bonus.Medical Insurance (including vision & dental).Disability insurance - short and long-term.401k up to 4% contribution.Air Stipend of $3,120/year, paid over 12 monthly installments (for home office, learning, wellness, etc.).Air Conference 2025 in Las Vegas – an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.
Diversity & Inclusion
At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.
Application Disclaimer
At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Air Apps
At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.
The Role
As a Data Analyst at Air Apps, you will be responsible for analyzing and interpreting data to drive business insights and optimize product performance. You will create reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to help teams make informed decisions and improve user experience.
This role requires a data-driven mindset, strong analytical skills, and experience with visualization tools to turn complex data into actionable insights.
Responsibilities
Analyze user behavior, product performance, and key business metrics to identify trends and opportunities.Create and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using tools like Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Google Data Studio.Collect, clean, and structure large datasets to ensure accuracy and usability.Define and track KPIs for marketing, product, and business performance.Work with SQL, Python, or R to extract, analyze, and manipulate data.Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and marketing teams to provide data-driven insights.Conduct A/B testing and experiment analysis to improve product features and user engagement.Identify bottlenecks and opportunities in user journeys and customer funnels.Present findings in a clear and compelling way to stakeholders and leadership teams.Stay up to date with industry trends, analytics best practices, and emerging data tools.
Requirements
Around 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field.Proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation.Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Google Data Studio).Strong analytical skills with experience in Python or R for data analysis.Knowledge of A/B testing methodologies and statistical analysis.Experience with Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar user analytics tools.Strong problem-solving skills and ability to communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders.Experience working with large datasets and cloud-based data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake).Familiarity with ETL processes and data pipeline optimization is a plus.Ability to work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and manage multiple projects.
What benefits are we offering?
Apple hardware ecosystem for work.Annual Bonus.Medical Insurance (including vision & dental).Disability insurance - short and long-term.401k up to 4% contribution.Air Stipend of $3,120/year, paid over 12 monthly installments (for home office, learning, wellness, etc.).Air Conference 2025 in Las Vegas – an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.
Diversity & Inclusion
At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.
Application Disclaimer
At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.

rows.title: Human Data - Business Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText: SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates. ABOUT THE ROLE:Human Data powers model training and evaluation by producing high-quality human-generated data at scale. This role focuses on the metrics, systems, and operating insights that help Human Data run efficiently—spanning workforce performance, capacity and allocation, operational process health, and decision-making support for cross-functional partners. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with strong quantitative skills and operational judgment, able to turn incomplete data into clear recommendations that improve throughput, quality, cost, and reliability. You will partner with operations leaders, engineering stakeholders, and enabling teams to identify problems, build operating systems, and drive improved planning decisions.RESPONSIBILITIES:Perform analyses of Human Data operational metrics—such as capacity, utilization, quality, throughput, cycle time, cost efficiency, and workforce health—to uncover trends, risks, and opportunities.Build and maintain reporting, trackers, and dashboards that make core operating KPIs visible and actionable for managers and cross-functional partners.Develop and improve planning and forecasting views (e.g., demand signals, supply/capacity, staffing needs, or process volumes) that support proactive, informed decisions.Support allocation and operating tradeoffs by synthesizing operational and performance data into clear recommendations for who/what should move where.Design, document, and refine operational processes and escalation paths so recurring work - performance actions, staffing, handoffs, and similar flows - is consistent, measurable, and scalable.Identify data gaps and partner with stakeholders to improve data collection, hygiene, and definitions so analysis and operating systems remain reliable.Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, engineering, recruiting, onboarding, finance, and other partners to integrate insights into hiring, staffing, performance management, and operational planning decisions.Deliver concise readouts and recommendations to stakeholders, translating analysis into business-oriented next steps and tradeoffs.Own ad-hoc research and special projects that improve Human Data operating leverage.BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:Bachelor’s degree1+ years of professional experience in business analytics, business operations, consulting, workforce/operations analysis, or growth/ops strategy1+ years of experience building and owning analytical models, trackers, or operating systems in Excel / Google Sheets or equivalentPREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative fieldStrong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimizationExperience with forecasting, capacity planning, workforce analytics, or performance metricsProficiency in statistical or analytical techniques (e.g., cohort analysis, regression, time-series, anomaly detection) in Python, R, or similarExperience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) or modern BI workflowsBackground in high-growth tech, marketplace/staffing operations, data labeling, human-in-the-loop systems, or consulting environmentsExcellent communication skills, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teamsProject management experience, including prioritizing work in fast-paced settings and driving process change with diverse stakeholdersComfort using modern AI tools to accelerate analysis and operational workflow designADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:Weekend work may be required.Travel to other SpaceXAI sites may be required.COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:$122,000 - $180,000 USD Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a rows.title: Staff Data Scientist – AI/ML, Generative AI & Agentic Systems
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.

Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.

Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and forward-thinking Staff Data Scientist with 5–7 years of experience in AI/ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI systems to join our Advanced Supply Chain Analytics team. This role will focus on developing intelligent, autonomous, and self-orchestrating systems that enhance forecasting, planning, and operational decision-making across the global supply chain.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with LLMs, LangChain, multi-agent frameworks, and cloud-based ML engineering (AWS). You will design scalable, production-grade AI solutions, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to accelerate our digital and supply chain transformation journey.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

AI/ML, Generative AI & Agentic AI Development

Design, build, and deploy AI/ML models for Supply Chain Planning (Demand Planning, Product Planning, Capacity planning, Inventory optimization, and production scheduling).Develop multi-agent and generative AI-powered systems (using LLMs and frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI) to enable real-time decision orchestration and intelligent automation.Prototype intelligent assistants that interpret complex workflows, automate tasks, and generate data-driven recommendations for supply chain planners.Implement autonomous agentic workflows that integrate insights across multiple enterprise systems (SAP, Blue Yonder, MES, Dynamics, etc.).

Engineering & MLOps

Build and maintain scalable AI/ML pipelines using Python, Pandas, Neural Prophet, SQL, Spark, and AWS tools (S3, Lambda, SageMaker).Utilize containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) for deployment of multi-agent applications.Apply MLOps best practices — CI/CD, model versioning, monitoring (Grafana, CloudWatch), and drift detection.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work with Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, IT, and Engineering teams to identify and prioritize use cases for automation and decision augmentation.Present technical solutions, demonstrate prototypes, and communicate insights effectively to senior stakeholders.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Lead the exploration and adoption of Agentic AI frameworks for autonomous planning and execution in supply chain functions.Stay current with emerging technologies in AI/ML, GenAI, and distributed intelligence systems.Scale early-stage prototypes into enterprise-grade AI systems that deliver measurable operational efficiency.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field with a focus on AI/ML.5–7 years of experience in AI/ML model development and deployment, preferably in supply chain or manufacturing environments.Demonstrated success in designing and deploying LLM or agent-based systems for automation or optimization.

Skills

Expertise in Python, SQL, Spark, and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).Hands-on experience with LLMs, LangChain, Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., AutoGen, CrewAI, BabyAGI).Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, Airflow, and GitHub.Familiarity with AWS services and observability tools like Grafana and CloudWatch.Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.Proven leadership in cross-functional, innovation-focused environments.

Domain Expertise

Strong understanding of supply chain systems (SAP, BY ESP, MES) and planning processes (MEIO, IBP, factory build planning).

Why Join Us?

Shape the future of Agentic and Generative AI-driven Supply Chain Transformation.Collaborate with global teams driving large-scale operational excellence.Work with cutting-edge AI tools to solve complex, real-world problems at enterprise scale.

Additional Information

Sandisk is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants and employees and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee based on their race, color, ancestry, religion (including religious dress and grooming standards), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), gender (including a person’s gender identity, gender expression, and gender-related appearance and behavior, whether or not stereotypically associated with the person’s assigned sex at birth), age, national origin, sexual orientation, medical condition, marital status (including domestic partnership status), physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, protected medical and family care leave, Civil Air Patrol status, military and veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. We also prohibit harassment of any individual on any of the characteristics listed above. Our non-discrimination policy applies to all aspects of employment. We comply with the laws and regulations set forth in the "Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal” poster. Our pay transparency policy is available here.

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.

Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs.accommodations@sandisk.comto advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

Based on our experience, we anticipate that the application deadline will be 12/10/2026(3 months from posting), although we reserve the right to close the application process sooner if we hire an applicant for this position before the application deadline. If we are not able to hire someone from this role before the application deadline, we will update this posting with a new anticipated application deadline.

This range may be modified in the future.You will be eligible to participate in Sandisk's Short-Term Incentive (STI) Plan, which provides incentive awards based on Company and individual performance. rows.descriptionText:
Salary And Benefits

Classification

Health Educator

About Cal State East Bay

Cal State East Bay's beautiful main campus is located in the Hayward hills with panoramic views of the San Francisco Bay shoreline. Situated above the city of Hayward, the campus offers an ideal setting for teaching and learning and yet easy access to the many cities along the bay. The University has a satellite campus in Concord, a professional development center in Oakland and a significant presence online. Founded in 1957, Cal State East Bay is one of 23 universities of the California State University system (CSU). Cal State East Bay is recognized as a regionally engaged and globally oriented university with a strong commitment to academic innovation, student success, engaged and service learning, diversity, and sustainability.

About The Position

Please Note: Review of applications will begin on September 25, 2026.

Under the supervision of the AVP/Dean of Students and work lead direction of the Wellness Services Coordinator the Health Educator engages the campus community in evidence-based approaches to support student wellness and disseminate data to drive findings of associated programs. This position will coordinate operations for the WellNest including food pantry appointments, operational procedures for food storage, food distribution, providing health resources, and cooking demonstrations.

The Health Educator regularly collaborates with university committees to implement strategic initiatives to address the wellbeing needs of students. This position is responsible to assess, design, implement, and evaluate wellbeing programs. Additionally, the Health Educator regularly conducts workshops and outreach events promoting campus resources, as well as implements wellbeing messaging through social marketing approaches. The Health Educator inform wellbeing issues pertinent to a university setting including but not limited to Basic Needs - food & housing security, Alcohol, Tobacco, & Other Drugs (ATOD), Cold/Flu, Nutrition/Fitness, Self-Care, Sexual Health, and Violence Prevention. This position provides guidance for wellbeing campaigns, programs and services offered within the WellNest and Wellness Center. The Health Educator also works closely with campus partners to support promotion of wellness services and leadership development for student assistants.

The position works closely with Peer Advocates for Wellness (PAW) student assistants for scheduling office hours and monitoring weekly assignments. The Health Educator develops projects, outreach events, learning outcomes, professional development, and training. The Health Educator will also coordinate and mentor PAW students in providing services in a client-centered, trauma informed approach.

The Health Educator collaborates with the Director and Wellbeing Services Coordinator to inform needs for departmental purchases, office and outreach supplies. The Health Educator must be able to lift up to 20 pounds and will occasionally require work in the evenings and weekends for outreach events/workshops and presentations.

Responsibilities

Department Support and Daily Operations

Coordinate daily WellNest operations in support of health education, wellness promotion, and student access to basic needs resources, including coordinating food pantry appointments, connecting students with appropriate health and wellness resources, providing informational tours, greeting and assisting visitors, supporting food demonstrations, and addressing other operational needs that facilitate delivery of health education and wellness services.Facilitate and maintain best-practice procedures for food storage, distribution, and sanitation to support nutrition, food safety, and food security programming, ensuring adherence to county and state safe-food handling guidelines and adapting practices based on the changing health and wellness needs of the student population.Coordinate food procurement and food access efforts in support of student nutrition, food security, and wellness initiatives through partnerships with Pioneer Dining, food recovery programs, the Alameda County Community Food Bank, food drives, and other campus and community resources.Maintain operational records, utilization data, program logs, and reporting procedures for WellNest services to assess student participation and needs, evaluate service delivery, identify trends, and inform health education, wellness, and food security programming.Support daily operations of the RAW Wellness Center to facilitate student access to health and wellness resources and programs, including coordinating relaxation room and Wii appointments, providing informational tours, greeting and assisting visitors, and connecting students with available wellness services and resources.

Wellbeing Educational and Consultative Functions

Assess, implement, and evaluate student needs on a variety of wellness topics including but not limited to basic needs, ATOD, nutrition, sexual health, stress management, and other topic areas pertinent to a college student population.Maintain records and outcome data to prepare written and verbal reports. Support process/policy development for maintenance of accreditation documents.Serve as departmental point of contact for food access and food security initiatives including but not limited to CalFresh/EBT sales initiatives, PAW Approved, initiatives with Pioneer Dining.Participate in outreach, workshops, guest lectures, housing events, and other presentations that represent campaigns, programs, and services provided by RWUU.

Student Leadership Development

Facilitate didactic training, practicum experience, and student leader meetings. Develop projects and outreach assignments that align with learning outcomes.  Provide training and skill development for implementation of the wellbeing topics.  Ensure staffing levels are scheduled for service delivery within the WellNest and to implement outreach activities and events.Support mentorship, leadership development, professional growth, and career readiness of department student assistants.  

Administration and Collaboration

Collaborates with campus partners within the Division of Student Affairs and academic units to develop and implement programs and events that contribute to student success.Collaborate with the Director and department staff to develop annual budget projections for operational, programming and outreach needs.Collaborate with the Directors of Student Health & Counseling Services to identify and employ opportunities for clinical collaboration, appropriate healthcare practices, and facility usage that support student access to services.Maintain relationships with external partners, vendors, community-based organizations to enhance program offerings and secure additional resources. 

Minimum Qualifications

Education and Experience

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in an approved program in health education or a related health field. Equivalent to one to two years of progressively responsible health education experience or combination of education and experience which provides the required knowledge and abilities.

Skills and Knowledge

Thorough knowledge of health education theories, research, and program assessment; planning, design, implementation, and evaluation of health education programs; and industry standards for the delivery of health education in higher education. General knowledge of, or the ability to learn quickly, current and emerging college-age, student health problems and existing methods of intervention and control. Working knowledge of the principles of educational and social psychology and how these apply to health education program; and applicable industry standards and practices for health promotion such as those found in the American College Health Association’s “Standards of Practice for Health Promotion in Higher Education.”

Abilities

Ability to assess needs and establish or recommend program priorities and goals and develop plans to achieve goals;collect, compile, chart, and analyze data pertinent to health education program planning; plan, organize, conduct or oversee a variety of health education program and activities including discussion groups and workshops; develop educational materials and media such as pamphlets, audio and video materials, and electronic media; present ideas and information accurately, effectively and concisely, both orally and in writing; use computer and web-based information technology systems as a resource for research and providing health education programs; maintain confidentiality consistent with applicable laws and regulations; and establish and maintain effective working relationships with peers, students, medical, and other health professionals, representatives of the news media and other community groups.

Required Qualifications

Thorough knowledge of health wellness topics: Alcohol, Tobacco, & Other Drugs (ATOD), Nutrition/Fitness, Self-Care, Sexual Health, and Violence Prevention. The incumbent must be able to lift up to 20 pounds and have the ability to work weekends and evenings as needed for outreach events, workshops and presentations.

Preferred Skills And Knowledge

An American Public Health Association approved master’s degree in Public Health with emphasis on health education, a master’s degree in Public Health, Health Sciences, or equivalent and/or national certification are highly preferred.

Condition(s) of Employment

Satisfactory completion of a background check (including LiveScan, as appropriate), that may include, but is not limited to: criminal records check, verification of academic credentials, licenses, certificates, credit history, professional references and/or verification of work history is required for employment. Cal State East Bay will issue a conditional offer of employment to the selected candidate, which may be rescinded if the background check reveals disqualifying information, and/or it is discovered that the candidate knowingly withheld or falsified information. Unsatisfactory results may also affect the continued employment of current Cal State East Bay employees who were conditionally offered the position.

All background checks are conducted through the university's third party vendor, Accurate. LiveScan is conducted through the University Police Department.

rows.title: Psychological Assistant - Adult Team
rows.descriptionText:
Job Summary

Under the supervision of a licensed Psychologist or board certified Psychiatrist, provides mental health assessment, diagnosis, treatment and crisis intervention services for adult and/or child members who present themselves for psychiatric evaluation with a broad range of mental health needs. Under supervision, may collaborate with treating primary care providers and with psychiatric and allied health professional team members to plan and direct each individual patients treatment program.

Essential Responsibilities

Under the supervision of a licensed psychologist or board certified psychiatrist, develops, implements, coordinates, and evaluates clinical treatment programs for the diagnosis, treatment, and/or referral of Health Plan members with acute or chronic mental illness. Participates in staff conferences to select, plan, and evaluate treatment programs. Provides outpatient psychotherapy to individuals, couples, families and groups. Instructs and counsels patients and their families regarding compliance with prescribed therapeutic regimens and adherence to prescribed medication regimens, within the scope of practice. May administer specialized therapeutic procedures, as appropriate. Provides appropriate support to members family. May develop and conducts psychoeducational classes and groups. May conduct psychological assessments, including test administration, interpretation, and recommendations. Prepares intake summaries, treatment plans, and case summaries and maintains ongoing confidential records. Charts members treatment and progress in accord with state and NCQA regulations and in keeping with accepted community standards. Collaborates with physicians in screening and evaluating patients for psychotropic medications, within the scope of practice. Utilizes resources of public and private agencies and community organizations to meet the needs of the members treatment. May develop, implements, and evaluates behavioral medicine and health psychology programs in a variety of settings, including primary care. Provides consultation to other care providers and health educators on matters relating to mental health, health psychology and behavioral medicine. Provides clinical supervision to psychology doctoral interns, psychology postdoctoral residents, and other mental health trainees/fellows as necessary. Confers and consults with supervisor regarding members progress and treatment and may consult with psychiatrist as well, if both are involved in members care. May provide appropriate support to members family, including explanation of treatment, instructions in how to support treatment and interventions to increase acceptance of and adherence to treatment, at members request. Utilizes resources of public and private agencies and community organizations to meet the needs of the members treatment to include referral of the member and/or members family to external resources, as appropriate. Participates in departmental program development, implementation and evaluation. Reports safety concerns to mandated reporting agencies. 

Experience

Basic Qualifications:

Completion of a psychology doctoral internship - minimum of 1 year (1500 hours). 

Education

PhD/PsyD/EdD in Clinical, Counseling, Health or School Psychology from an accredited college or university. 

License, Certification, Registration

Psychologist License (California) within 24 months of hirePsychological Assistant Registration (California) required at hire

Additional Requirements

Once hired as an Assistant, an employee will be offered and must work a schedule that would accumulate at least half the required supervisory hours annually. Must be familiar with DSM-V as a means of diagnosis. Has experience in assessing, diagnosing and treating a broad range of psychiatric conditions. Knowledge of Evidence-Based Practice and psychotherapy research methods. Knowledge of the bio-psycho-social functions that contribute to mental health. Accuracy in diagnosing patients and developing effective treatment plans. Competence in individual, family and group psychotherapy. Professional maturity and ethical integrity necessary for assuming professional responsibilities. Commitment to quality of service, teamwork, and participation in a highly interactive multidisciplinary clinic. Ability to complete multiple tasks/objectives in a timely manner. Knowledge of social service agencies, state regulations and APA standards as it related to client treatment, patient rights and client/patient confidentiality. Previous clinical responsibilities to include psychological testing, diagnosis, crisis intervention, brief individual and group psychotherapy. Knowledge of psychological testing techniques, administration and interpretation. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Must be able to work in a Labor/Management Partnership. Upon completion of supervised hours, the employee must obtain state licensure within two (2) years. 

Preferred Qualifications

Previous clinical responsibility to include crisis intervention, individual and group psychotherapy. Demonstrated experience in psychological evaluations of adults, children, adolescents, & families, including administering & writing up psychological testing & assessment batteries preferredDemonstrated professional maturity and ethical integrity necessary for assuming professional responsibilities, preferred. Demonstrated commitment to quality of service, teamwork, and participation in a highly interactive multidisciplinary clinic, preferred. Demonstrated ability to complete multiple tasks/objectives in a timely manner, preferredAccuracy in diagnosing patients and developing effective treatment plans, preferredCompetence in individual, family and group psychotherapy, preferred

Company Description

Backed by leading climate and American dynamism investors, Terranova builds intelligent robotic systems to terraform the Earth itself — lifting land, restoring wetlands, and protecting critical infrastructure from floods and sea-level rise.

Our mission is to preserve the built environment, create new habitats, and usher in an era of abundance. Our work supports climate resilience, disaster recovery, and defense across the United States and beyond.

We're assembling a world-class team that wants to work on something real, physical, and civilization-scale. If you want your work to reshape the world — literally — this is the place to do it.

What To Expect

We're seeking a lab intern to support our engineering team in testing, validating, and iterating on the robotic systems that power Terranova's work. You'll spend your time hands-on in the lab — running experiments, maintaining test rigs, collecting and logging data, and helping turn engineering designs into working hardware. It's a chance to see how a physical product gets built and proven out, from bench test to field-ready system.

Key Responsibilities

Set up, run, and monitor lab experiments and hardware tests in support of the engineering teamMaintain, calibrate, and troubleshoot lab equipment, test rigs, and sensor instrumentationCollect, organize, and log test data, and help summarize results for engineersAssist with prototyping, assembly, and basic fabrication of hardware componentsSupport integration and validation testing as systems move from bench to fieldDocument lab procedures, test setups, and findings for the teamFollow lab safety protocols and help keep the workspace organized and running smoothly

Requirements

Comfortable with the pace and intensity of early-stage startup lifeWorking towards a bachelor's degree or higher in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related fieldComfortable in a lab environmentU.S. permanent residency required

Preferred Skills And Experience

Hands-on wet lab experienceExperience with environmental or materials testing — soil, sediment, water quality, corrosion, or durabilityFamiliarity with lab instrumentation (pH meters, spectrophotometers, GC/HPLC, microscopy)Basic data analysis skills (Excel, Python, or MATLAB) for processing experimental dataBackground in materials science, polymers, or composites a plusCoursework or project experience in environmental, geotechnical, or fluid systems a bonusStrong lab safety practices and attention to detailComfortable with fieldwork or sample collection outside the lab

Compensation And Timeline

$25–35/hr, plus relocation and company perksFall internship, September through December, with flexibility around your school schedule

rows.title: Content Marketer
rows.descriptionText:
About Conversion

Conversion is the agentic marketing automation platform. MOps teams at enterprise SaaS companies rip out Marketo, Pardot, and HubSpot and run everything here instead: CRM and warehouse data unified into one layer, a full enterprise MAP built on top of it, and AI agents that do the repetitive work with approval-first governance. Campaigns ship in hours instead of weeks.

We raised a $28M Series A and sell into companies like Plaid, ClickHouse, Productboard, and People Data Labs. We're ~25 people in San Francisco, five days a week, with engineers, designers, and operators from Airbnb, Palantir, Pinterest, IMC, Shopify, LinkedIn, and Microsoft.

About The Role

Hey 👋 Kyle here. I run product and growth at Conversion, and I'm hiring the person who owns content.

Some honesty about the audience first. We sell to marketers. They build campaigns for a living, they know every play in the book, and they can clock a keyword-stuffed blog post in about four seconds. Their feed is already full of slop. MOps directors and the managers under them are one of the most underserved audiences in B2B. Nobody writes for them. Nobody invites them to anything. The few companies that treat them like the smartest people in the building get remembered for it.

So the job is to make us the thing this audience reads on purpose. That means the category story (why every MOps team is sitting on a platform they resent, and why migrating stopped being terrifying), thought leadership under our founders' names and under yours, webinars and partner programming that put us in the rooms our buyers already live in, and the search surface, both Google and the AI answers quietly eating it.

One thing about how I evaluate this work, because it shapes who's happy here. Our sale runs three to six months and the average buyer group touches us around 55 times before anything closes. No single piece of content gets clean credit for a deal. You get judged on how well you run the channel against its ceiling, not on whether the channel pops in a given quarter. I'll take conviction, taste, and volume over someone waiting for a dashboard to tell them what to write next.

You'll work with me directly and our founders on POV and voice. You'll have material to work with: a product that wins better than 9 out of 10 head-to-head bake-offs, customers who will go on record, and an incumbent set that has been coasting for a decade.

This role is in-person 5 days/week in San Francisco.

What You'll Own

The category story. The argument for why enterprise MOps teams are leaving legacy platforms right now, made in enough formats and enough times that the market starts repeating it back to us. Thought leadership and founder voice. Specific, opinionated writing for MOps directors and CMOs. Ghostwriting and owning brand on LinkedIn, and building a voice in the space. Search and AI search. Own organic end to end. Rank for the high-intent queries, and get us cited in the answers people now get from ChatGPT and Claude instead of clicking through. Webinars and partner programming. Topics, co-hosts, promotion, run-of-show, follow-up. The MOps community is small and tight, and the partners worth working with are already obvious to you or will be fast. Distribution. Every piece ships with a plan for how it travels: email, LinkedIn, communities, sales enablement, paid when it earns it. The bar. You set the quality standard for words at Conversion and hold everything to it, mine included. 

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

Write constantly and can send me a link that proves it, published work with a point of view attachedHave marketed to a technical or operational B2B audience that resists being marketed toSwitch registers cleanly between company voice, founder ghostwrite, and your own accountHave owned content or demand at an early-stage company, ideation through distribution through iterationKnow SEO well and are already paying attention to what AI search is doing to itLike talking to customers, and can turn a 30-minute call into something worth publishingHave opinions about B2B content, including strong ones about who's doing it badly

You Might Be a Great Fit If You

Have lived inside Marketo, Pardot, or HubSpot and felt the pain firsthandHave run a webinar or partner content program you'd actually defend as goodUse AI to move fast without letting the output read like itCan name B2B brands you admire that go past the three everyone namesHave built a category narrative before, or want the shot at building one from zeroWant to be in an office where the team eats lunch together!

Useful Links

Website: https://conversion.ai/Learn more about our company culture here: https://conversion.ai/careers

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

rows.title: Senior Analyst, GenAI Marketing (Bangkok Based, Relocation Provided)
rows.descriptionText:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

Agoda’s Marketing organization is highly data-driven and uses experimentation, technology and analytics to create measurable value across markets and channels.

Marketing has successfully developed a strong bottom-up culture of AI adoption, with teams using GenAI to improve analysis, reporting, campaign operations, content development and other recurring workflows. We are now establishing a small Marketing AI Products team to take the next step: turning the most valuable cross-team opportunities into reliable, scalable and widely adopted products.

The team will focus on a small number of high-impact “lighthouse” initiatives while Marketing sub-teams continue to develop and own their everyday, team-specific AI use cases. Initial opportunity areas include experiment analysis, business reporting and monitoring, campaign operations, creative workflows and SEO/AEO content.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on analyst and product builder who can operate at the intersection of Marketing, data, product development and generative AI.

You will identify high-value workflows, translate business problems into clear product requirements, develop and evaluate solutions, and work with developers and Marketing teams to take successful ideas from prototype through deployment and adoption.

This is not a traditional reporting role or a purely coordination-focused product role. You will be expected to work directly with data and AI tools, understand users’ workflows in detail and take ownership of delivering measurable outcomes.

In This Role, You’ll Get To

Identify recurring Marketing workflows where AI can materially improve speed, quality, scalability or decision-making.Quantify each opportunity by establishing its current effort, pain points, user base and potential business value.Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user journeys, milestones and measurable success criteria.Build and test prototypes using SQL, Python, automation tools and generative AI technologies.Partner with developers, Technology teams and sponsoring Marketing teams to turn successful prototypes into reliable products.Design evaluation frameworks covering output accuracy, reliability, usability, safety and appropriate human review.Lead user research, pilots and iterative testing with analysts, channel specialists and other target users.Drive rollout, documentation, training and adoption in partnership with sponsoring teams.Measure hours saved, improvements in turnaround time and quality, adoption levels and downstream business impact.Maintain a prioritized portfolio of Marketing AI opportunities and communicate progress, learnings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.Monitor developments in AI capabilities and identify when existing products should be improved, expanded or retired.Contribute reusable tools, standards and playbooks that help Marketing teams build better AI-enabled workflows independently.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

4–6 years of relevant experience in analytics, product analytics, marketing strategy, business operations, consulting, product management or a related field.Bachelor’s degree or higher in a quantitative, technical or business discipline such as computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, economics or finance.Strong SQL skills and experience working independently with large or complex datasets.Hands-on experience with Python, scripting, workflow automation or similar technical tools.Experience defining hypotheses, designing experiments and translating results into actionable business recommendations.Strong product thinking, including the ability to understand user problems, define requirements and make pragmatic scope and prioritization decisions.Ability to break ambiguous problems into structured workstreams and move rapidly from analysis to execution.Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.Experience influencing stakeholders and communicating complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, dependable solutions.Ability to collaborate effectively across Marketing, Analytics, Product and Technology teams.Experience building GenAI applications, AI agents or automated analytical workflows.Familiarity with prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, APIs, model evaluation and human-in-the-loop workflows.Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Codex, Cursor, Claude Code or Google AI Studio.

It’s Great if You Have

Experience writing product requirements, managing a product backlog or taking an internal product from prototype to scaled adoption.Knowledge of digital marketing, performance marketing, experimentation, SEO/AEO, campaign operations or personalization.Experience establishing quality-assurance and monitoring processes for data or AI products.Experience deploying internal tools or working closely with software engineers on production systems.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will help launch and scale a small number of cross-Marketing AI products with clear adoption and value metrics. These products should deliver measurable improvements in employee productivity, output quality or business outcomes—and have clearly defined ownership, documentation, quality controls and maintenance plans.

rows.title: Digital Merchandising Coordinator
rows.descriptionText:
A Digital Merchandising Coordinator in eCommerce optimizes the online shopping experience to drive sales, managing product launches, site navigation, and visual merchandising. They act as a liaison between marketing, creative, and web engineering teams, ensuring accurate product data, captivating imagery, and strategic, searchable product placement.

The ideal candidate will be commutable to the Concord, CA office for occasional onsite collaboration during local business hours.

What We Offer

Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance 401(k) Retirement Savings PlanHSA or FSA eligibilityLong and Short-Term Disability InsuranceFitness Reimbursement Program25% employee discount & FAM MembershipFlexible PTOGroup Life InsuranceEAP through AllOne Health (formerly Carebridge)

Key Responsibilities

Site Maintenance & Strategy: Update product listings, curate collections, and manage site navigation (categories/menus). Product Launches: Coordinate new product setups, ensuring imagery, copy, and attributes are accurate. Performance Optimization: Analyze data on product performance and search behavior to boost conversions and optimize SEO. Visual Merchandising: Oversee "sorting and pinning" (product sequencing) to ensure the homepage and category pages are visually appealing and trendy. Cross-functional Support: Work with Marketing to align site content with promotional campaigns and email marketing. 

Essential Skills

Experience with CMS platforms (e.g., Shopify, Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud) and analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics). High attention to detail, analytical mindset, and strong organizational skills. 1-3+ years in eCommerce, retail, or digital marketing. 

Compensation

Gopuff pays employees based on market pricing and pay may vary depending on your location. The salary range below reflects what we’d reasonably expect to pay candidates. A candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Exceptions may be made for exceptional individuals. For additional information on this role’s compensation package, please reach out to the designated recruiter for this role. This role is eligible for a discretionary annual cash bonus and participation in Gopuff’s equity incentive plan. Base Salary Range: $70,500 - $75,000

And now, we’re assembling a team of motivated people to help us drive forward that vision to bring a new age of convenience and predictability to an unpredictable world.

Like what you’re hearing? Then join us on Team Blue.

rows.title: Social Content and Community Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Harmless Harvest envisions a world where nutritious, clean, organic, and healthy food and beverages are the standard rather than the exception; where all people involved in creating the product are treated with fairness; and the planet is treated harmlessly. We are focused on changing the world, and we are always looking for like-minded, wildly passionate individuals to help us do this.
About the Role:
As our Social Content and Community Specialist, you will play a key role in bringing the Harmless Harvest brand to life across social channels. This role is equal parts creative storyteller, content creator, and community builder, responsible for planning and publishing engaging social content, capturing real-time brand moments, managing day-to-day community engagement, and helping translate performance insights into stronger content over time. You will be a highly visible “Harmless voice” to consumers, ensuring every post, comment, message, and interaction feels authentic, on-brand, and connected to our broader marketing priorities. Reporting to the Director of Brand Communications, you will collaborate closely with the product marketing, creative, e-commerce, and consumer experience teams to support campaigns, activations, launches, and ongoing brand storytelling.
Key Responsibilities:Content Planning, Creation + ExecutionOwn and manage the content calendar across all social platforms, ensuring consistent messaging, timely posts, and alignment with broader marketing prioritiesStay ahead of social media trends, cultural moments, and platform updates to inform content strategyConcept, shoot, and edit compelling, high-quality content with a focus on Instagram and TikTok.Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines, voice, and publishing timelinesCollaborate with the marketing, creative, and e-comm teams to ensure content supports brand storytelling and campaign goalsAttend brand activations, campaign shoots, and in-person events to capture real-time social contentHelp manage and organize an asset library of photos, video, b-roll, and other creative contentManage contract creation and execution for UGC creators, influencers, and other social partnerships, ensuring compliance and alignment with brand goals.
Community ManagementMonitor and engage with community comments, messages, and mentions across all social media channels in a timely, professional, and on-brand manner.Maintain a consistent brand voice and tone across all platforms, ensuring messaging aligns with brand guidelines and values.Act as the first point of contact for followers, addressing questions, feedback, and concerns while escalating issues when appropriate.Foster meaningful conversations with the community to build strong connections, loyalty, and advocacy.Track and document influencer mentions and tags in a live document, while identifying opportunities for larger-scale engagement and collaboration.
Other Responsibilities 
Pull monthly social performance reports through Sprout Social, translating key metrics and community insights into actionable recommendations that inform content strategy, optimize future posts, and identify opportunities to deepen engagement.Product and sample needs fulfillment, for Influencer, trade shows, photoshoots, etc.Occasional intermittent customer service (Zendesk platform) coverage during especially high volumes or CX team time off.
What you bring:A socially-native creative with at least 2+ year in social media with demonstrated experience in creating content and community managementA high-energy self-starter who thrives on moving fast, effortlessly handling multiple deadlines, and drives their own workflow forward with ease.A collaborative creative lead who can seamlessly brief, direct, and manage the workflows of external agencies, freelancers, and content creators.Strong on-camera presence with the ability to film, speak to camera, and create engaging social-first video content that feels authentic to the brand.Comfortable using tools like Sprout Social to organize content calendars, monitor engagement, track performance, and apply insights to improve social strategy over time.Proficiency in graphic design tools (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Figma) and video editing software (e.g., Premier Pro and/or CapCut or similar)Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related fieldHybrid role (3 days in Oakland office per week), must be based in based in the Bay Area
Who you are:Make the impossible, possible – someone who is resilient, optimistic, and determined.Protect the most vulnerable – someone who is compassionate, empathetic and acts with integrityCraft incredible things – someone who is creative, passionate, with keen attention to detailAct with heart – someone who is kind, generous and respectful
Why you’ll love it here:
Join a passionate team that comes from all backgroundsGenerous Paid Time Off and Company HolidaysParental LeaveComprehensive health benefits and perks

rows.title: Growth Marketer (SF)
rows.descriptionText:
Growth MarketerSan Francisco · Full-time
We think learning is about to change completely.
AI has made it possible, for the first time, to build learning systems that understand what someone knows, what they need to learn, and how to teach them differently. At the same time, the half-life of knowledge at work is shrinking: tools change every week, roles are being rewritten, and static training is increasingly obsolete.
Scholé is building the learning layer for that world.
We are a research-driven AI for education company spun out of UC Berkeley and EPFL. We're teaching Harvard's Agentic AI Intensives. Our platform uses a system of carefully orchestrated agents to turn expert knowledge into personalized, adaptive learning experiences for every person in an organization. And even though we believe each lesson should look different for each person, we provide standardized analytics to company leadership.
Now we’re looking for an exceptional Growth Marketer to help us take it to every team and company we possibly can.
What you’ll do
You’ll work directly with the founders to shape how Scholé is understood, talked about, and discovered.
Develop campaigns around our product, customers, research, and launchesWrite excellent copy across our website, ads, emails, social, and sales materialsOwn our content and social presence, and find stories worth tellingTurn customer outcomes into compelling case studies and campaignsBuild and test landing pages, messaging, and positioningRun paid and organic acquisition experiments and improve conversionDevelop creative concepts that make Scholé stand out in a crowded AI marketHelp build a brand people remember and a marketing engine that compounds
Who we’re looking for
You’ve worked at a startup before and loved the part where there was no playbook yet. You have a strong bias for action, and are familiar with startups.
You are:An exceptional writer. You can make complicated ideas simple, sharp, and memorable.Creative. You have strong instincts for campaigns, stories, and ideas people want to share.Analytical. You care about what converts, not just what looks good.AI-pilled. You actively use AI tools in your work, experiment with new ones, and are comfortable building them into your day-to-day workflow.High-agency. You can take an idea from a blank page to something live.Curious. You want to deeply understand the product, customer, research, and market.Fast. You would rather publish, learn, and improve than spend a month polishing.
Experience in AI, education or developer tools is useful. Experience with enterprise tools is a big plus. 
Why Scholé
Most software helps people do their current jobs faster. We want to help people become capable of doing things they could not do before.
Scholé grew out of more than a decade of our research in AI, learning science, and human-computer interaction. We’re now turning that research into a product that can continuously teach millions of people as knowledge and work change around them.
We’re still early enough that one exceptional person can meaningfully change the trajectory of the company.
You’ll work alongside researchers, engineers, designers, and founders in our San Francisco office, with a lot of freedom to try things that have never been tried before.
If you want to help build how the world learns next, we’d love to meet you.
Send an email to team@schole.ai with your CV, 2 sentences on your related experience, and 1-2 ideas you have (copy, visuals).

rows.title: Senior Analyst, GenAI Marketing (Bangkok Based, Relocation Provided)
rows.descriptionText:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

Agoda’s Marketing organization is highly data-driven and uses experimentation, technology and analytics to create measurable value across markets and channels.

Marketing has successfully developed a strong bottom-up culture of AI adoption, with teams using GenAI to improve analysis, reporting, campaign operations, content development and other recurring workflows. We are now establishing a small Marketing AI Products team to take the next step: turning the most valuable cross-team opportunities into reliable, scalable and widely adopted products.

The team will focus on a small number of high-impact “lighthouse” initiatives while Marketing sub-teams continue to develop and own their everyday, team-specific AI use cases. Initial opportunity areas include experiment analysis, business reporting and monitoring, campaign operations, creative workflows and SEO/AEO content.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on analyst and product builder who can operate at the intersection of Marketing, data, product development and generative AI.

You will identify high-value workflows, translate business problems into clear product requirements, develop and evaluate solutions, and work with developers and Marketing teams to take successful ideas from prototype through deployment and adoption.

This is not a traditional reporting role or a purely coordination-focused product role. You will be expected to work directly with data and AI tools, understand users’ workflows in detail and take ownership of delivering measurable outcomes.

In This Role, You’ll Get To

Identify recurring Marketing workflows where AI can materially improve speed, quality, scalability or decision-making.Quantify each opportunity by establishing its current effort, pain points, user base and potential business value.Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user journeys, milestones and measurable success criteria.Build and test prototypes using SQL, Python, automation tools and generative AI technologies.Partner with developers, Technology teams and sponsoring Marketing teams to turn successful prototypes into reliable products.Design evaluation frameworks covering output accuracy, reliability, usability, safety and appropriate human review.Lead user research, pilots and iterative testing with analysts, channel specialists and other target users.Drive rollout, documentation, training and adoption in partnership with sponsoring teams.Measure hours saved, improvements in turnaround time and quality, adoption levels and downstream business impact.Maintain a prioritized portfolio of Marketing AI opportunities and communicate progress, learnings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.Monitor developments in AI capabilities and identify when existing products should be improved, expanded or retired.Contribute reusable tools, standards and playbooks that help Marketing teams build better AI-enabled workflows independently.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

4–6 years of relevant experience in analytics, product analytics, marketing strategy, business operations, consulting, product management or a related field.Bachelor’s degree or higher in a quantitative, technical or business discipline such as computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, economics or finance.Strong SQL skills and experience working independently with large or complex datasets.Hands-on experience with Python, scripting, workflow automation or similar technical tools.Experience defining hypotheses, designing experiments and translating results into actionable business recommendations.Strong product thinking, including the ability to understand user problems, define requirements and make pragmatic scope and prioritization decisions.Ability to break ambiguous problems into structured workstreams and move rapidly from analysis to execution.Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.Experience influencing stakeholders and communicating complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, dependable solutions.Ability to collaborate effectively across Marketing, Analytics, Product and Technology teams.Experience building GenAI applications, AI agents or automated analytical workflows.Familiarity with prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, APIs, model evaluation and human-in-the-loop workflows.Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Codex, Cursor, Claude Code or Google AI Studio.

It’s Great if You Have

Experience writing product requirements, managing a product backlog or taking an internal product from prototype to scaled adoption.Knowledge of digital marketing, performance marketing, experimentation, SEO/AEO, campaign operations or personalization.Experience establishing quality-assurance and monitoring processes for data or AI products.Experience deploying internal tools or working closely with software engineers on production systems.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will help launch and scale a small number of cross-Marketing AI products with clear adoption and value metrics. These products should deliver measurable improvements in employee productivity, output quality or business outcomes—and have clearly defined ownership, documentation, quality controls and maintenance plans.

rows.descriptionText:
Position Summary...Do you like to work on your feet and keep things neat and organized? Our merchandising & stocking associates connect all of the dots to make sure members can find everything they have on their shopping list. From every day needs to special occasions, members need you, as their mini tour guide, to take them that special product. Depending on the shift you work, your job could include moving inventory in the backroom, unloading trucks, fulfilling club pick-up orders or helping members while stocking shelves. From unloading trucks in the summer to filling ice cream in the freezer, this fast-paced job can be physically demanding - it’s like being paid to go to the gym! Be a part of a great team with a common goal – making sure members can find more of what they love, for less.

You will sweep us off our feet if:

 You thrive in fast-paced environments You keep member satisfaction as your top priority You’re comfortable with change and quickly adapt to different work scenarios You’re a problem solver who tackles obstacles head-on to ensure each task is completed with excellence You are able to pick up boxes and other heavy objects weighing more than 25 pounds

You will make an impact by:

 Promptly unloading trucks Assisting fellow associates as needed throughout the store Sorting and stocking products on shelves and in the backroom Engaging with vendors and drivers with a positive attitude Maintaining a clean, neat, and member-ready area

The merchandising & stocking associate role is a great way to start a fulfilling career at Sam’s Club. Apply now!

The above information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed in the role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. The full job description can be made available as part of the hiring process.

What you'll do...

Join the Founding Team at Sam’s Club Lathrop!

Location: 17401 S Manthey Road, Lathrop, CA 95330

Be part of something extraordinary from day one.

Sam’s Club is opening a brand-new club in Lathrop, CA, and we’re looking for energetic, reliable, and member-focused individuals to help bring it to life. As a founding associate, you’ll have the unique opportunity to shape the member experience, support club operations, and help create a culture of excellence from the ground up.

If you enjoy staying active, working on your feet, and keeping things organized, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Keep the Club Stocked, Organized, and Member-Ready

As a Merchandising Associate at Sam’s Club, you’ll help ensure products are stocked, organized, and easy for members to find. From everyday essentials to special occasion items, you’ll play an important role in creating a seamless shopping experience.

Depending on your shift, your day may include unloading trucks, stocking shelves, organizing inventory, fulfilling club pick-up orders, and helping members find what they need.

This fast-paced, physical role keeps you moving and active throughout your shift.

What You’ll Love About This Role

Be part of a brand-new club opening and help build something from the ground upStay active in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the sameWork alongside a supportive team with a shared goal of serving membersPlay a key role in making sure products are available and easy to findGrow your career with one of the world’s leading retailers through training and development opportunities

rows.descriptionText:
Kikoff: The Fintech Powering Financial Security at Scale

Kikoff is a profitable, pre-IPO fintech company on a mission to empower everyone to achieve financial security. With record revenue growth in 2025 and a unicorn valuation, we've built a suite of products that help millions of people build credit, access liquidity, and save money.

We're scaling fast. Join us if you want to build something meaningful and help millions of people move forward financially.

Why Kikoff

This is a consumer fintech startup, and you will be working with serial entrepreneurs who have built strong consumer brands and innovative products. We value extreme ownership, clear communication, a strong sense of craftsmanship, and the desire to create lasting work and work relationships. Yes, you can build an exciting business AND have real-life real-customer impact.

Kikoff is a high-growth consumer fintech startup offering credit-building solutions that are affordable, accessible, and educational. Our core product, the Kikoff Credit Account, has helped hundreds of thousands of customers build better credit. Kikoff has been featured by NerdWallet, Forbes, Buzzfeed, and others; and our app has a 4.9 rating amongst thousands of reviews. But Kikoff is more than just a credit builder: we are a long-term financial partner for our customers, and we have an exciting product roadmap of solutions to help our customers reach their financial goals.

About the role: We are looking for a high-caliber Growth Marketer to join our team who is interested in growing into a lead role. This role is designed for a data-driven strategist who thrives on solving complex problems and is eager to push the boundaries of traditional marketing. You will operate at the intersection of technical execution, rigorous analysis, and creative strategy to launch high-impact campaigns.

While you will initially collaborate with senior leadership to scale existing channels and refine creative assets, you will quickly transition into full ownership of your own campaigns and strategic initiatives. We are looking for a professional who moves with speed, values precision, and is ready to drive measurable business growth from day one.

This is a full-time position with benefits and equity in a fast-moving and fast-growing environment that will help you grow your abilities and career as you help build a better ecosystem of credit for our customers.

What You’ll Do

Growing the number of users who join our program at an efficient cost per acquisition by running campaigns across multiple digital and offline channels. Define, drive, and measure KPIs for each campaign. Continually design and execute AB tests to make the most effective campaigns. Work cross-functionally to bring campaigns to life: working with designers, copywriters, product team, data analysts, and more. Become a great growth marketer while getting broad exposure to many parts of marketing and building a company. 

Who You Are

2+ years of experience demonstrating success in driving growth toward defined CAC/ROAS or volume targets, within set timelines and budgets or a strong track record in an analytical academic discipline or a structured, data-driven role. Ability to define key marketing KPIs and break them down into their underlying drivers to understand and influence performance from first principles. Ability to move fast and flexibly, juggling multiple projects with the trustworthiness to execute on schedule at high-velocity and attention-to-detail. Strategic thinker able to break down and organize problems, assess opportunity areas, and develop big ideas and priorities to move the business forward. Understanding of hypothesis-driven A/B, MVT, and incrementality testing with the ability to analyze test result data to tease out learnings and insights to inform future testing. Understanding what makes an effective and strong direct response creative, with a framework to continually adjust and learn based on experimentation. 

Nice To Have

Experience in a fintech business or the D2C industry is a bonus 

Base Range

$120,000 - $145,000 USD
