VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

Job Description

MS NOW is looking for a passionate, strategic, and highly motivated Senior Analyst to join the Digital Platform Analytics team. This role will use audience and subscriber data to uncover insights across the customer lifecycle, from acquisition and engagement through retention and churn.

The Senior Analyst will partner closely with Editorial, Product, Marketing, Engineering, and business teams to translate complex data into actionable insights that inform audience development, product initiatives, editorial strategy, and the growth of MS NOW’s business.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct deep-dive and exploratory analyses using SQL and other analytics tool to identify trends, opportunities, and drivers of audience and subscriber behavior, and translate findings into clear recommendations Monitor and analyze key subscription and digital performance metrics, including acquisition, engagement, content consumption, retention, audience exposure, and video performance. Identify high-performing content formats, topics, audience behaviors, and emerging patterns Partner with Editorial, Product, Marketing, Engineering, and business stakeholders to define KPIs, measurement frameworks, and analytical requirements and ensure consistent, accurate measurement across MS NOW’s digital products Build, maintain, and evolve dashboards and recurring reporting that enable stakeholders to independently understand business and audience performance and support data democratization and governance Partner with experimentation leads and Product teams to develop data-driven hypotheses, establish measurement plans, analyze experiment results, and translate findings into actionable product recommendations Partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Product teams to develop and refine audience segmentation and predictive capabilities, including propensity and personalization models Work with large, complex datasets and data lake environments to combine multiple data sources and conduct advanced analyses of user behavior and business performance Communicate analytical findings and recommendations through clear, compelling narratives tailored to a range of audiences, including senior leadership 

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in digital analytics, product analytics, audience insights, or a related field, preferably within a direct-to-consumer, subscription, or digital media business SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets Proficiency in Excel and experience building analytical models and conducting details quantitative analysis Experience with tools such as Databricks/Snowflake, Adobe/Google Analytics, Amplitude, Tableau/Looker/Omni, and experimentation platforms 

Desired Characteristics

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move from ambiguous business questions to structured analysis and actionable recommendations Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and translate complex data into compelling narratives 

Additional Requirements

Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of three days per week from our NYC office.This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other benefits and perks.Salary: $80,000 - $100,000

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with a VERSANT Media employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. VERSANT Media's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to candidateaccessibility@versantmedia.com.

VERSANT Media is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. We include a good faith pay range for each position to comply with applicable state and local pay transparency laws and to promote equity across our organization. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location and may include additional forms of compensation and benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, etc.

VERSANT Media is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at VERSANT via-email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from VERSANT's Talent Acquisition team will be deemed the sole property of VERSANT. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by VERSANT as a result of the referral or through other means.

rows.descriptionText:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As a Business Development Representative at Anthropic, you'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by optimizing our lead management processes and identifying new market opportunities. In this pivotal role, you'll enable our sales team to focus on high-value, revenue-generating activities by leveraging your analytical skills, project management expertise, and strategic thinking. Your role is critical in streamlining our sales pipeline and uncovering untapped potential in the AI market.

Responsibilities

Maintain full ownership of pipeline generating activities in your sales territory Collaborate with sales teams to understand their needs and optimize lead handoff processes Manage and prioritize a high volume of inbound leads Conduct initial qualifications for high-potential leads Outbound against strategic prospects to generate high-intent opportunities with Startup and Enterprise teams Support the development and execution of strategic outbound initiatives Provide data-driven insights to inform sales strategies and resource allocation Continuously refine processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness 

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

2-3+ years of experience in a fast-growing startup, preferably in lead management and project management roles or 2-3+ years of experience in a field like finance & investment banking, consulting or software engineering Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, and SQL (preferred) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field 

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$116,480—$131,040 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

The annual salary range for this role is $90,000 - $100,000 in New York.

The World Economic Forum, committed to improving the state of the world, is the International Organization for Public-Private Cooperation. The Forum engages the foremost political, business and other leaders of society to shape global, regional and industry agendas.

Our digital products provide individuals and organizations that engage with the Forum internally and externally a seamless and efficient way to gain knowledge and strategic insights, develop and nurture connections, and drive collective action. As we continuously evolve our offerings, we're expanding our Digital Experience Office to drive this vision further.

Why We Are Recruiting

The World Economic Forum is transforming into an Intelligent Workplace — seamlessly integrating human-centered work with intelligent agents to enable AI-driven collaboration and workflow transformation. To support this vision, we are expanding the Digital Success & Support Team with a new role: Digital Experience & AI Enablement Specialist. This position will contribute to the adoption and effective use of the Forum's core digital and AI-enabled products across internal teams and external users, while continuously identifying opportunities to streamline workflows through practical automation.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is passionate about optimizing technology, partnering closely with users, and championing the adoption of digital and AI-powered platforms that make a tangible difference in everyday work.

Reporting Lines & Interactions

The Digital Experience & AI Enablement Specialist will report to the Head of Digital Success & Support in Geneva and will work closely with the Intelligent Workplace Product Team and internal stakeholders across the New York and San Francisco offices.

Breakdown Of Main Responsibilities

50% User Enablement, Digital Product & AI adoption 30% Workflow automation & user coaching 20% AI Champion community management 

The successful candidate will be assessed on 

Drive adoption of core digital and AI products by enabling users through practical, use-case-based change management, including targeted sessions, clear guidance, and self-service resources. Identify opportunities to streamline repetitive tasks and improve user productivity through the design and development of lightweight automations, workflows, and AI-enabled solutions Help manage a community of internal AI champions that promotes innovation and supports adoption across teams. Act as a primary point of contact for user questions and feedback, ensuring efficient adoption and continuous improvement of the user experience. Guide users to explore, adopt, and build practical digital solutions independently. 

Preferred Requirements And Experience

Bachelor’s or advanced university degree in Information Systems, Digital Business, Technology & Innovation Management, Organizational Change, Communications or a related field, with a strong interest in digital transformation and AI-enabled ways of working. 2+ years of relevant professional experience in digital enablement, user support, learning and development, innovation, workflow improvement, technology adoption, consulting, or related areas. Knowledge in AI-enabled productivity tools, workflow automation, and emerging digital technologies, with a demonstrated willingness to continuously learn and experiment. Hands-on experience designing practical AI use cases, lightweight automations, or workflow improvements that simplify day-to-day work. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain digital and AI concepts clearly and support users with empathy and patience. Experience facilitating training sessions, onboarding, workshops, user support, or community engagement initiatives is a strong advantage. Ability to work collaboratively across teams and build trusted relationships with users and stakeholders in a fast-paced international environment. Strong organizational skills, proactive mindset, and ability to manage multiple priorities independently. Comfortable operating in an evolving environment and contributing to new initiatives with a growth mindset and solution-oriented approach. Interest in community building, peer learning, and helping foster a culture of experimentation and responsible AI adoption. 

Why work at the Forum

We believe that progress happens by bringing together people from all walks of life who have the drive and the influence to improve the state of the world by building awareness and co-operation, shaping mind-sets and agendas and driving collective action. Join us and become a driver for positive change!

Why join us?

Join an independent and impartial organization with over 55 years of connecting leaders to make sense of global challenges and move the world forward together.

Position Title: Lead Analyst, People Data Insights (Crewmember Listening)

Position Summary:

At JetBlue, our mission is to inspire humanity, and the People Data Insights team advances that mission by translating people data into insights that guide talent strategy and improve outcomes such as retention, mobility, performance, and the overall Crewmember experience.

The Lead Analyst, Crewmember Listening, owns JetBlue’s enterprise listening strategy and survey portfolio. This role leads the design, administration, analysis, and evolution of key People surveys, including engagement, safety, candidate experience, onboarding, and exit, often in close partnership with People Business Partners and cross-functional stakeholders.

Leveraging expertise in research methodology, analytics, and applied psychology, the Lead Analyst conducts rigorous analyses and linkage research to connect listening data with business outcomes. In partnership with the broader People Data Insights team, this role delivers clear, data-driven insights that enable leaders to make informed decisions, strengthen the Crewmember experience, and drive business results.

This role requires strong collaboration across levels of the organization, exceptional attention to detail, and a passion for using data to influence strategy and change. The Lead Analyst is also expected to continuously build expertise in new tools, technologies, and subject areas to advance JetBlue’s listening capabilities.

The Team

 JOB DESCRIPTION 

In U.S. Consumer Services (USCS), our product is Membership—delivering benefits and services that are essential to our Card Members across travel, dining, entertainment, and retail. We compete by providing a differentiated Membership experience that drives loyalty and long-term growth. USCS brings this to life through our premium, cobrand, cash back, and lending portfolios, Membership Rewards, Travel & Lifestyle Services, the Centurion Lounge network, Global Dining, U.S. Consumer Banking, Amex Offers, Amex Ads, and best-in-class marketing programs.

Accelerating growth across our Cobrand portfolios is central to our enterprise strategy—expanding customer relevance, deepening loyalty, diversifying revenue streams, and delivering sustainable top-line growth. The Cobrand organization within the U.S. Consumer Services Group leads the strategy and management of our Cobrand partner relationships and Cobranded credit card solutions, integrating product innovation, portfolio strategy, P&L management, customer experiences, and operational excellence to strengthen loyalty and enhance our competitive position.

The Delta Cobrand Product Management team is responsible for shaping and executing the long-term strategy of one of our most significant strategic partnerships. The team drives the portfolio vision, value proposition design, financial performance, and innovation—ensuring we deliver differentiated, customer-centric products that drive acquisition, increase engagement, and create mutual value for both organizations.

About The Role

This Senior Analyst will be responsible for driving high-priority portfolio operations and partner-facing workstreams that will enable growth for the Delta Cobrand portfolio. This is a highly visible role, with responsibilities spanning across the end-to-end product management lifecycle, inclusive of program reporting, competitive insights, benefit management, invoicing, and operational risk management.

The Senior Analyst will play a critical role in strengthening operational rigor, surfacing insights that inform product decisions, and helping advance the long-term growth strategy for the portfolio. This individual will partner closely with Finance, Analytics, Control Management and Compliance teams, while supporting ongoing engagement with Delta counterparts.

This impactful role is for someone who wants to gain experience in product management and exposure to the P/L. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, comfortable operating across ambiguity, and energized by working at the intersection of product strategy, partner management, and execution. A successful candidate is someone who can connect day-to-day operational details to broader portfolio priorities, helping the team identify opportunities to improve customer experience, strengthen controls, and unlock growth.

Responsibilities

Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Analytics, Control Management, Compliance, and Delta partners to move initiatives forward Responsible for day-to-day key partner and product operations, including but not limited to reporting, invoicing, and insightsDeliver and synthesize insights and analyses through competitive research and trends to inform product improvements and leadership decision makingContribute innovative ideas that elevate and influence the broader portfolio and strategySupport benefit management across the product lifecycle, including monitoring performance, coordinating with stakeholders to resolve issues, and ensuring benefit delivery is compliant and aligned to the intended customer experienceMonitor Operational Risk Events and Issues Management through escalations, identifying root causes, and drive remediation efforts for risk mitigation Serve as control management lead by creating and performing control testing, smart monitoring, and mitigating customer or operational issues 

Qualifications

2 years of work experience in a product or partner management role preferred Demonstrated ability to assess business needs, identify solutions, and implement them seamlessly Proven track record to spearhead workstreams autonomously and drive completion across teams at all levels Strong organization, communication, and project management skills Ability to build and influence positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and with a strong executive presence Experience with distilling complex information into clear, compelling narratives for senior leadership and partners, Executive-level presentations and briefing materials Comfort with data to synthesize from multiple sources into actionable insights to inform strategy Quick learner of proprietary systems and processes with impeccable attention to detailLearning agility and flexible style – ability to handle changing priorities and a broad variety of projectsStrong collaborator and team player with excellent interpersonal skills and willingness to support projects beyond immediate job scope Positive attitude, proactive work style, and customer / partner first mindset Passion for travel

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

HYPR, the Identity Assurance Company, helps organizations create trust in the identity lifecycle. We are a community of bold thinkers and energetic doers who imagined a brand new approach to identity security and, at the same time, are eliminating a pervasive and persistent 60-year old problem – the password. Since being founded in 2014, the company has grown to be the premium provider of authentication security to marquee brands around the globe and are quickly becoming the recognized leader in Identity Assurance. We are looking for exceptional people with the ambition and the will to positively change the world. If that sounds like you, join us on our mission to create a passwordless world and secure the identity lifecycle.
Your Role and Impact
Are you a hands-on builder who gets energized by turning a manual, clunky process into something that runs itself? Do you thrive at the intersection of AI, automation, and go-to-market execution? We're looking for an AI & Automation Specialist to build the AI-powered tools, agents, and workflows that make our sales and marketing teams faster and sharper — from outreach optimization to campaign automation to internal reporting.
This is not a marketing-operations-as-usual role. You'll have real latitude to identify what's broken or slow across our GTM motion and go build the fix. We need someone who is AI-fluent, not just AI-aware — someone who has actually built things (internal tools, automations, agents, scripts) and is energized by turning a manual, clunky process into something that runs itself.
This is a hybrid role, based out of HYPR's New York City headquarters located conveniently in midtown Manhattan. The role is expected to be available for 3-4 days a week in the office / remote on other days. You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Growth & Marketing Operations and collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps teams across the GTM org.
Key ResponsibilitiesDesign, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and lightweight tools that improve GTM efficiency, using LLM APIs, no-code/low-code automation platforms, and agent-builder tools.Prototype and ship internal AI applications — research/enrichment agents, outreach personalization tools, content or reporting assistants — that GTM teams can actually adopt.Build and optimize AI-assisted workflows for sales outreach, including sequencing, personalization at scale, lead enrichment, and prioritization, in partnership with Sales on our Outreach engagement stack.Own and improve automations within HubSpot, including lifecycle workflows, lead routing/scoring, campaign operations, and data hygiene.Build reusable systems — templates, modules, and workflows — that scale across campaigns and teams, not one-off fixes.Support reporting and attribution by automating data pulls, dashboards, and recurring analysis that currently require manual work.Work directly with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to identify high-friction, high-repetition processes worth automating, and document what you build clearly enough that others can use, maintain, and extend it.Act as an internal resource for "can AI do this?" questions across the GTM org.
Tools You'll Work WithExisting GTM stack: HubSpot (marketing automation, lifecycle workflows, landing pages) and Outreach (sales engagement, sequencing, prospect workflows).AI & automation tooling: LLM platforms (Claude Code, or similar) for building; automation/orchestration platforms like n8n, Zapier, or Make; sales intelligence and enrichment tools like Clay, Apollo, or ZoomInfo.Reporting & data: Excel/Sheets minimum for dashboards and ad hoc analysis; SQL and basic scripting (Python or JavaScript) are a plus.
Requirements 2-4 years of experience in marketing operations, sales operations/RevOps, growth, or a related GTM function.Demonstrated builder instinct — you can point to specific things you've built (an automation, an internal tool, a workflow, a script) and explain the problem it solved.Genuine, hands-on fluency with AI tools — using them to build and automate, not just to draft copy or summarize documents.Comfortable with ambiguity — you can take a vague "this is slow and annoying" problem and turn it into a scoped, shippable fix.Strong documentation instincts and clear communication with non-technical stakeholders.Experience with SalesForce, HubSpot, Outreach, or similar marketing/sales engagement platforms is highly desirable.Basic scripting comfort (Python or JavaScript) is a plus for connecting APIs and debugging integrations.Experience in cybersecurity, identity, or enterprise B2B SaaS GTM is a plus, as is familiarity with agent-builder frameworks or MCP-style tool integrations.
The Benefits of Working with HYPRCompetitive Salary & Equity offer with significant upside as we scaleGreat Medical/Dental/Vision coverage, as well as FSA/HSA, 401k available and moreGenerous equipment budget and customized workstation. You will have what you need to be successfulLong-term stability within a high-growth sector within identity access automationA mission driven culture. At HYPR you will never be spinning your wheels on tasks that won't make an impact. Everything we develop is cutting edge and vital to the success and security of our clients
Note:This job is hybrid with 3-4 days onsite at our NY Corporate HQ.HYPR is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
OTE: $95,000 - $130,000

We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Please Note: This role requires the ability to work on site 3 days per week per company policy.

The World Economic Forum, committed to improving the state of the world, is the International Organization for Public-Private Cooperation. The Forum engages the foremost political, business and other leaders of society to shape global, regional and industry agendas.

Our digital products provide individuals and organizations that engage with the Forum internally and externally a seamless and efficient way to gain knowledge and strategic insights, develop and nurture connections, and drive collective action. As we continuously evolve our offerings, we're expanding our Digital Experience Office to drive this vision further.

Why We Are Recruiting

The World Economic Forum is transforming into an Intelligent Workplace — seamlessly integrating human-centered work with intelligent agents to enable AI-driven collaboration and workflow transformation. To support this vision, we are expanding the Digital Success & Support Team with a new role: Digital Experience & AI Enablement Specialist. This position will contribute to the adoption and effective use of the Forum's core digital and AI-enabled products across internal teams and external users, while continuously identifying opportunities to streamline workflows through practical automation.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is passionate about optimizing technology, partnering closely with users, and championing the adoption of digital and AI-powered platforms that make a tangible difference in everyday work.

Reporting Lines & Interactions

The Digital Experience & AI Enablement Specialist will report to the Head of Digital Success & Support in Geneva and will work closely with the Intelligent Workplace Product Team and internal stakeholders across the New York and San Francisco offices.

Breakdown Of Main Responsibilities

50% User Enablement, Digital Product & AI adoption 30% Workflow automation & user coaching 20% AI Champion community management 

The successful candidate will be assessed on 

Drive adoption of core digital and AI products by enabling users through practical, use-case-based change management, including targeted sessions, clear guidance, and self-service resources. Identify opportunities to streamline repetitive tasks and improve user productivity through the design and development of lightweight automations, workflows, and AI-enabled solutions Help manage a community of internal AI champions that promotes innovation and supports adoption across teams. Act as a primary point of contact for user questions and feedback, ensuring efficient adoption and continuous improvement of the user experience. Guide users to explore, adopt, and build practical digital solutions independently. 

Preferred Requirements And Experience

Bachelor’s or advanced university degree in Information Systems, Digital Business, Technology & Innovation Management, Organizational Change, Communications or a related field, with a strong interest in digital transformation and AI-enabled ways of working. 2+ years of relevant professional experience in digital enablement, user support, learning and development, innovation, workflow improvement, technology adoption, consulting, or related areas. Knowledge in AI-enabled productivity tools, workflow automation, and emerging digital technologies, with a demonstrated willingness to continuously learn and experiment. Hands-on experience designing practical AI use cases, lightweight automations, or workflow improvements that simplify day-to-day work. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain digital and AI concepts clearly and support users with empathy and patience. Experience facilitating training sessions, onboarding, workshops, user support, or community engagement initiatives is a strong advantage. Ability to work collaboratively across teams and build trusted relationships with users and stakeholders in a fast-paced international environment. Strong organizational skills, proactive mindset, and ability to manage multiple priorities independently. Comfortable operating in an evolving environment and contributing to new initiatives with a growth mindset and solution-oriented approach. Interest in community building, peer learning, and helping foster a culture of experimentation and responsible AI adoption. 

Why work at the Forum

We believe that progress happens by bringing together people from all walks of life who have the drive and the influence to improve the state of the world by building awareness and co-operation, shaping mind-sets and agendas and driving collective action. Join us and become a driver for positive change!

Join an independent and impartial organization with over 55 years of connecting leaders to make sense of global challenges and move the world forward together.

rows.descriptionText:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As a Business Development Representative at Anthropic, you'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by optimizing our lead management processes and identifying new market opportunities. In this pivotal role, you'll enable our sales team to focus on high-value, revenue-generating activities by leveraging your analytical skills, project management expertise, and strategic thinking. Your role is critical in streamlining our sales pipeline and uncovering untapped potential in the AI market.

Responsibilities

Maintain full ownership of pipeline generating activities in your sales territory Collaborate with sales teams to understand their needs and optimize lead handoff processes Manage and prioritize a high volume of inbound leads Conduct initial qualifications for high-potential leads Outbound against strategic prospects to generate high-intent opportunities with Startup and Enterprise teams Support the development and execution of strategic outbound initiatives Provide data-driven insights to inform sales strategies and resource allocation Continuously refine processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness 

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

2-3+ years of experience in a fast-growing startup, preferably in lead management and project management roles or 2-3+ years of experience in a field like finance & investment banking, consulting or software engineering Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, and SQL (preferred) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field 

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$116,480—$131,040 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Position Summary

The Operations Specialist – Tank Monitor Operations is responsible for supporting and coordinating the day-to-day operational activities associated with Paraco’s electronic tank monitoring program and in-field meter operations. This position plays a key role in ensuring operational continuity, process efficiency, equipment availability, inventory accuracy, and a high level of service to both internal and external stakeholders.

The Operations Specialist will work collaboratively across departments to monitor operational performance, identify opportunities for process improvement, implement operational initiatives, and resolve issues in a timely and effective manner. The position requires a high degree of organization, attention to detail, independent judgment, and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a dynamic operating environment.

Essential Functions And Responsibilities

Oversee and coordinate the day-to-day operational activities associated with Paraco’s electronic tank monitoring program and in-field meter operations.Monitor operational activities and workflows to ensure adherence to established processes, procedures, service standards, and quality expectations.Evaluate existing operational processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, effectiveness, quality, and customer experience.Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of operational processes, procedures, and initiatives.Coordinate the deployment, maintenance, repair, replacement, and lifecycle management of operational equipment.Maintain appropriate inventory levels of supplies, equipment, and materials necessary to support ongoing operations.Manage supply ordering activities, including monitoring inventory requirements, placing orders, tracking deliveries, and coordinating with suppliers.Establish and maintain effective working relationships with customers, suppliers, field personnel, and internal stakeholders.Respond to operational inquiries and issues, ensuring timely investigation, resolution, escalation, and follow-up as appropriate.Monitor and report on operational performance, trends, service levels, and key performance indicators.Maintain accurate and current policies, procedures, process documentation, and operational records.Assist with cross-functional projects and initiatives that support operational efficiency, process standardization, technology adoption, and service improvements.Provide operational support and guidance to field personnel as needed.Travel throughout Paraco’s operating footprint to support field operations, equipment, process implementation, and other business requirements.Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

QualificationsRequired Qualifications

Minimum of 2 years of experience in operations, logistics, field services, or a related function.Demonstrated experience supporting operational processes, procedures, and continuous improvement initiatives.Experience with project coordination, project management, or team leadership.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and develop practical solutions.Strong organizational skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.Demonstrated ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders at various levels of an organization.Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision while exercising sound judgment.Proficiency with Microsoft Office and other standard business technology; ability to learn and utilize company-specific systems and applications.Ability and willingness to travel throughout Paraco’s operating footprint as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in a field operations, logistics, energy, fuel, or service-based environment.Experience working with electronic monitoring systems, metering technology, connected devices, or similar field-based technology.Experience with inventory management and procurement processes.Experience developing and maintaining standard operating procedures and process documentation.Experience utilizing operational metrics and data to identify trends and drive process improvements.

Core Competencies

The Successful Candidate Will Demonstrate The Following Competencies

Operational Excellence: Demonstrates a commitment to efficiency, quality, consistency, and continuous improvement.Problem Solving: Identifies issues, evaluates alternatives, and develops timely and effective solutions.Communication: Communicates clearly, professionally, and effectively with a diverse range of stakeholders.Organization & Prioritization: Effectively manages competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.Accountability: Takes ownership of responsibilities, follows through on commitments, and proactively addresses challenges.Collaboration: Builds productive working relationships and effectively partners with cross-functional teams.Customer Focus: Demonstrates a strong commitment to delivering a positive experience for customers and stakeholders.Adaptability: Responds effectively to changing priorities, operational requirements, and business needs.Independent Judgment: Works effectively with minimal supervision and makes sound decisions within established guidelines.

This position operates in a combination of office and field environments and may require regular travel throughout Paraco’s operating footprint. The Operations Specialist must be comfortable working with field personnel, operational equipment, technology systems, customers, and external vendors.

The position may require flexibility in scheduling based on operational needs and the ability to respond to time-sensitive issues.

rows.descriptionText:
What We Are Building At Conveo

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

#1 What problem are we solving, and why is this an important problem to solve

The current/traditional research methods companies rely on are slow, expensive, and superficial. Running great research also requires expertise, which is a blocker to many companies. That directly affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them.

#2 The team you will join

You will join an extremely talented team of incredibly passionate, high-energy people. We go the extra mile while having the best time of our lives. Our team has the combination of decades of market research knowledge, incredible engineering ability, and experience building companies.

#3 How we operate

We truly care about our clients and the problem we solve. That means we humbly go the extra mile every time. We work hard, and we have fun. To keep our quality bar incredibly high, we want to execute with the smallest possible team. 

About The Role

We’re looking for a highly driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help build and scale pipeline generation at Conveo.

This is primarily an outbound-focused role. You will be responsible for identifying the right accounts and stakeholders, building targeted prospect lists, creating thoughtful outbound campaigns and messaging, and turning market interest into qualified meetings.

You will work closely with sales and marketing to ensure our outbound motion is relevant, timely, and commercially effective whether that is through cold outreach, event follow up, webinar campaigns, re engagement sequences, or trigger based prospecting. Additionally, you’ll serve as a brand ambassador for Conveo at international events to identify and nurture new lead opportunities.

While you may support selected inbound qualification where needed, the core focus of the role is on proactive outbounding and campaign execution.

What You’ll Do

Own outbound prospecting and campaign execution

Build and run outbound campaigns across target accounts, verticals, and buyer personas Research companies and identify the most relevant stakeholders to engage Create high-quality outreach copy tailored by role, industry, use case, and trigger Develop messaging that is concise, commercial, and relevant rather than generic Execute outreach across email, LinkedIn, sequencing tools, and other relevant channels Represent Conveo at events around the world to identify and nurture new leads 

Build targeted lists and prospecting motions

Create and maintain high-quality account and contact lists aligned to our ICP Segment prospects by role, function, industry, geography, and priority use case Support account prioritisation and stakeholder mapping for strategic opportunities Launch targeted campaigns around new product launches, content, case studies, funding events, hiring activity, market shifts, and other commercial triggers 

Own follow-up from events and demand generation activity

Attend relevant events, conferences, and webinars where appropriate Manage structured follow-up for leads generated through events, field marketing, and content activity Ensure warm prospects are engaged quickly and effectively after every event or campaign Turn interest and awareness into qualified meetings and next steps for the sales team 

Support pipeline creation and reactivation

Re-engage dormant leads and previously active opportunities Work stale pipeline systematically to surface new demand Identify where prospects have gone cold and build smart follow-up campaigns to bring them back into conversation Help ensure no high-potential account is left untouched 

Maintain strong process and commercial discipline

Keep CRM data clean, accurate, and up to date Track campaign performance, reply rates, meeting conversion, and funnel progression Feed insights back into sales and marketing to improve targeting, messaging, and channel performance Continuously refine campaigns based on what is and is not working 

Core Requirements

What we’re looking for

Experience in outbound prospecting, business development, or pipeline generation Strong written communication and copywriting skills Confidence identifying and engaging senior stakeholders Ability to research accounts and tailor outreach intelligently Highly organised, reliable, and able to manage multiple campaigns at once Comfortable working at pace in a high-growth environment 

What Great Looks Like

Commercially sharp and highly proactive Strong sense of ownership and personal accountability Able to write messaging that feels relevant, credible, and human Comfortable testing, iterating, and improving campaigns quickly Low ego, high urgency, and focused on outcomes Excited by the challenge of creating pipeline from scratch rather than waiting for it to appear 

Preferred Experience

Experience in a BDR or SDR role in B2B SaaS or a high-growth technology company Familiarity with tools such as HubSpot, Clay, Apollo, Outreach, Heyreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar Experience building outbound sequences and multi-touch campaigns Exposure to event-based prospecting and post-event follow-up Comfortable working across both strategic accounts and broader outbound campaigns 

How Success Will Be Measured

Qualified meetings generated from outbound activity Campaign performance across reply rates, conversion, and pipeline creation Quality of account targeting and stakeholder identification Speed and consistency of follow-up after events and campaigns Contribution to pipeline growth across target accounts and segments Strength of collaboration with sales and marketing 

Why join Conveo

Conveo is building the future of AI-powered research, and this role sits at the front of that growth journey.

You’ll join a smart, ambitious team and play a central role in helping us open doors with some of the most important brands in the world. This is an opportunity to have real ownership, shape the outbound engine, and make a visible impact on company growth.

What You Can Expect

A high-impact role with real ownership from day one Direct exposure to founders and senior commercial leaders The chance to help define and scale our outbound motion A business with exceptional momentum and ambition Competitive compensation and meaningful equity upside A culture built around speed, ownership, quality, and ambition Opportunities to attend events, build market relationships, and grow with the company

rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

Job Description

This position is part of the Data Insights & Strategic Analytics team and will report to the Senior Director, Measurement Strategy. The Analyst will support efforts to strengthen measurement capabilities across linear, digital and emerging platforms, playing a key role in data reporting, performance monitoring, and the operational processes that underpin the team’s measurement strategy. This includes working hands-on with data, helping to track key metrics, and ensuring the team is well-equipped to interpret and act on measurement insights.

This role is designed for someone eager to build expertise across three core areas: analyzing and working directly with a variety of industry data sets, understanding and monitoring evolving vendor methodologies and their impact on performance, and supporting the day-to-day operations of measurement strategy through vendor coordination and process management. The Analyst will contribute to developing internal fluency with a variety of standard industry data sets (e.g. Nielsen and comScore), along with other platform measurement and audience data sets (e.g. campaign measurement and attribution solutions), as well as emerging first- and second- party data sources.

This role requires comfort working with data in structured environments while also being able to adapt across a range of internal and external platforms over time. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, analytically curious, and eager to build deep expertise in media measurement across various platforms. They are proactive in working with data, comfortable navigating vendor tools and internal systems, and motivated to understand how measurement methodologies shape real-world performance insights.

Responsibilities:

Run and analyze reports using measurement platforms such as Nielsen and comScore, developing a strong working knowledge of underlying data setsTrack and document methodology changes from measurement vendors while analyzing trends, anomalies, and shifts in performance across brands and platforms to understand their real-time impactSupport the development and maintenance of tracking tools and dashboards to monitor ongoing performanceHelp manage vendor relationships, including scheduling meetings, support trainings, and follow-upsMaintain documentation related to measurement methodologies, processes, and vendor updates while tracking implementation timelines and ensuring stakeholders are kept informedSupport communication and collaboration across internal teams as well as with external measurement partners

Qualifications

1+ years of relevant experience in media, analytics, or measurement for the Analyst position and 3+ years for the Sr. Analyst positionWorking knowledge of both linear and digital media measurementExperience with Nielsen and comScore measurementBasic familiarity of SQL or Databricks (or similar data querying/processing tools)Familiarity with AI tools and processesStrong analytical skills and attention to detailProficiency in Excel and PowerPointStrong written and verbal communication skillsBachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, data analytics, or a related field

Desired Characteristics

Interest in the evolving media and measurement landscapeHighly organized with the ability to manage multiple prioritiesProactive, detail-oriented, and intellectually curiousStrong collaborator with a team-first mindsetEnthusiasm for learning and continuously building new skills, particularly in emerging measurement approaches and toolsInterest in being on the cutting edge of media measurement and contributing to the development of new processes, frameworks, and ways of working

rows.title: Total Rewards Analyst (Versant Media)

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

Job Description

The Opportunity

VERSANT is seeking a Total Rewards Analyst to support the execution and ongoing administration of our Total Rewards programs. Our Total Rewards function brings together Compensation and Benefits to attract and inspire world-class creative and commercial talent who will shape VERSANT’s future. We design rewards that help employees build meaningful careers, share in our success, and grow with us.

Our approach connects achievement to impact. Through broad-based and executive compensation, financial wellbeing benefits, physical and health wellbeing benefits, recognition, and other rewards, we aim to give employees a meaningful stake in VERSANT’s success - through the impact they make, the recognition they receive, and the opportunities they have to grow.

As a Total Rewards Analyst, you’ll gain broad exposure across these core areas, including broad-based compensation, executive compensation, financial wellbeing benefits, and physical and health wellbeing benefits, while also supporting recognition, global mobility, employee perks, communications, and other Total Rewards initiatives.

Working closely with the Total Rewards team and cross-functional partners, you’ll help turn program priorities into organized, well-coordinated execution. You’ll support communications, launches, timelines, employee-facing materials, reporting, and day-to-day program administration while helping the team identify practical ways to simplify recurring work and improve how Total Rewards operates as a connected function.

Why This Role Matters

At VERSANT, we believe success should be shared, performance should be recognized, and rewards should fuel both employee growth and our company’s success.

In this role, you’ll help bring that philosophy to life through strong execution. You’ll support the delivery of Compensation, Benefits, recognition, mobility, and other Total Rewards programs while helping employees understand and engage with the rewards and resources available to them.

You’ll also help create leverage for the broader Total Rewards team. By keeping recurring work organized, spotting common needs across programs, and helping improve repeatable processes, you’ll allow our subject-matter experts to spend more time on the work that requires their expertise.

What You’ll Do

Bring compensation programs to life as part of an integrated Total Rewards experience: Partner with the Compensation team to understand priorities for broad-based and executive compensation programs and support their execution. Coordinate timelines, communications, materials, reporting, and key activities alongside other Total Rewards initiatives. Support the annual Year-End Planning Timeline and related compensation planning activities in partnership with the broader compensation team and key stakeholders.Bring benefits programs to life as part of an integrated Total Rewards experience: Partner with the Benefits team to understand priorities for financial wellbeing and physical and health wellbeing programs and support their execution. Coordinate communications, program launches, employee materials, reporting, and ongoing delivery so benefits are accessible, clear, and connected to the broader Total Rewards experience.Support the broader Total Rewards portfolio: Assist with recognition programs, employee perks, global mobility, and other Total Rewards offerings by coordinating program logistics, timelines, communications, documentation, and stakeholder activities.Strengthen employee understanding and engagement: Support Total Rewards branding, communications, presentations, program launches, and other employee-facing forums. Help translate program information into clear, employee-friendly communications and materials.Coordinate execution across Total Rewards: Maintain the Total Rewards calendar, project plans, action items, key milestones, dependencies, and upcoming communications. Help teams stay organized and aligned by tracking deliverables, following up on open items, and supporting coordination across HR, Communications, Finance, and other stakeholders.Help improve how work gets done: Learn recurring Total Rewards processes, document key workflows, and identify practical opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, or eliminate unnecessary steps. Surface recurring pain points or duplicative activities to the Sr. Manager, Total Rewards Operations & Strategy and help implement agreed improvements, including appropriate use of existing tools and technology.Support vendor, budget, and invoice administration: Track invoices, vendor expenses, contracts, and program costs; maintain organized records; monitor spend against budget; and support forecasting and periodic budget updates.

Qualifications

What You Bring

A bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.Approximately 2-5 years of experience in Human Resources, Total Rewards, Compensation, Benefits, HR Operations, or a related area.Interest in building broad experience across Compensation and Benefits, including broad-based compensation, executive compensation, and financial and physical/health wellbeing programs.Strong organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and details.Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex information into clear, employee-friendly materials.Strong analytical skills and comfort working with spreadsheets, budgets, invoices, reporting, and data.Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with HRIS or other HR technology platforms is preferred.Curiosity about how work gets done and willingness to identify practical ways to make recurring work simpler, clearer, or more efficient.Strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.Ability to work effectively across teams and build productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential employee, compensation, and business information.

You’ll also bring VERSANT’s How We Do It behaviors to your work:

Trust: Handle sensitive compensation, benefits, employee, and business information with integrity, sound judgment, and discretion.Teamwork: Collaborate effectively across Compensation, Benefits, HR, Finance, Communications, and other teams to advance shared priorities.Transparency: Communicate clearly about priorities, progress, open items, dependencies, and potential issues so stakeholders stay informed.Agility: Adapt as priorities change and balance recurring program activities with new Total Rewards initiatives.Entrepreneurial Spirit: Look for practical ways to simplify work, improve processes and communications, and strengthen the employee experience.

Why You’ll Love It Here

Total Rewards at VERSANT is about creating an experience where employees can build meaningful careers, share in our success, and grow with us.

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to build broad experience across Compensation and Benefits - from broad-based and executive compensation to financial, physical, and health wellbeing benefits - while also gaining exposure to recognition, mobility, communications, and the broader employee experience.

You’ll join a team focused on making rewards meaningful and accessible, with opportunities to learn across multiple Total Rewards disciplines while contributing to programs that help employees feel motivated, valued, and empowered.

Additional Requirements

Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of three days per week.Benefits & Perks: This role comes with a great benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and other great perks. You can learn more on the Benefits page of the Versant Media Careers site. (www.versantmedia.com)Compensation: The salary range for this role is $85,000–$100,000, depending on experience and qualifications.

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with a VERSANT Media employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. VERSANT Media's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to candidateaccessibility@versantmedia.com.

VERSANT Media is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. We include a good faith pay range for each position to comply with applicable state and local pay transparency laws and to promote equity across our organization. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location and may include additional forms of compensation and benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, etc.

VERSANT Media is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at VERSANT via-email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from VERSANT's Talent Acquisition team will be deemed the sole property of VERSANT. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by VERSANT as a result of the referral or through other means.

rows.title: Sr. Associate Qualitative Insights

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Senior Associate, Qualitative Insights

This is a hybrid role to be based near one of our offices in New York City or Los Angeles

About Us

We drive intelligent growth for ambitious businesses and leading brands. 

Customer understanding is more potent and drives greater value when insights go to work directly within marketing and experience priorities. To give our clients that advantage, we put an insights-driven operating system at the core of our design, go-to-market and digital experience solutions.  

Material clients make smarter growth choices because they can see clearly how and when to take the shots that count. Together, we connect consumer intelligence with customer demand generation to build lasting, profitable relationships.

Job Description

As a Senior Associate, your primary role within the Strategy & Insights team is to provide support and ownership of day-to-day needs for custom qualitative projects, leading to high quality delivery of insights and related recommendations for a wide range of clients and categories.

Specific operations-oriented responsibilities include owning or overseeing organizational elements of project setup, supporting client communication and project updates, owning or providing contribution to fieldwork preparation and logistics, fieldwork support, contribution to analysis and reports, and supporting other ad-hoc project activities and/or long-term community projects as directed.

High attention to detail and accuracy, autonomy in self-management, creativity and flexibility. Ability to manage and prioritize multiple competing deadlines and needs with limited senior oversite.

Skills required for success include critical thinking, strategic thinking, strong analysis, project management and pattern and problem identification orientation around solutions and point of view (POV). Ability to learn and adapt to cutting edge technologies to drive efficiency.

You will be mentored by senior leadership and receive on-the-job formal training through Material.

Qualifications

We are open to alternative modes of education and experience that qualify candidates for the role. Many successful candidates have Bachelors degrees and/or studies in a social science, communications, or business related field and we welcome different backgrounds of study.Prefer a minimum of 2 years work experience, preferably related.You are deeply curious about people (e.g., what motivates them, the why behind their decision making).You enjoy thinking critically about what things mean and how insights should be applied to problems and challengesYou possess an entrepreneurial spirit with a strong drive to do whatever it takes to make big impact for your team and clients.You have an eye for details and make a conscious effort to understand the actual cause behind an occurrence.You can adapt to changing priorities to meet multiple project timelines and client needs.Project Management Skills: attention to detail, organization, and project trackingCommunication Skills: Effective verbal and written communication skills to present research findings in a clear and concise manner.Technical Proficiency: Experience using Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word)Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and effectively manage multiple projects while meeting deadlines.Curiosity and Learning Mindset: Demonstrated curiosity, willingness to learn, openness to sharing, receiving, asking for and applying feedback. And adaptability to new methodologies and technologies in the market research field.


Why work for Material?

Material is a global company and we work with best-of-class brands worldwide. We also create and launch new brands and products, putting innovation and value creation at the center of our practice. Our clients are in the top of their class, across industry sectors from technology to retail, transportation, finance and healthcare.Material employees join a peer group of exceptionally talented colleagues across the company, the country, and even the world. We develop capabilities, craft and leading-edge market offerings across seven global practices including strategy and insights, design, data & analytics, technology and tracking. Our engagement management team makes it all hum for clients.A community focused on learning and making an impact. Material is an outcomes focused company. We create experiences that matter, create new value and make a difference in our clients' lives and their customers' lives. 


Pay Range: $28.00/hr – $30.00/hr

Position Title: Lead Analyst, People Data Insights (Crewmember Listening)

Position Summary:

At JetBlue, our mission is to inspire humanity, and the People Data Insights team advances that mission by translating people data into insights that guide talent strategy and improve outcomes such as retention, mobility, performance, and the overall Crewmember experience.

The Lead Analyst, Crewmember Listening, owns JetBlue’s enterprise listening strategy and survey portfolio. This role leads the design, administration, analysis, and evolution of key People surveys, including engagement, safety, candidate experience, onboarding, and exit, often in close partnership with People Business Partners and cross-functional stakeholders.

Leveraging expertise in research methodology, analytics, and applied psychology, the Lead Analyst conducts rigorous analyses and linkage research to connect listening data with business outcomes. In partnership with the broader People Data Insights team, this role delivers clear, data-driven insights that enable leaders to make informed decisions, strengthen the Crewmember experience, and drive business results.

This role requires strong collaboration across levels of the organization, exceptional attention to detail, and a passion for using data to influence strategy and change. The Lead Analyst is also expected to continuously build expertise in new tools, technologies, and subject areas to advance JetBlue’s listening capabilities.

Medidata follows a hybrid office policy in which employees who are hired for an in-person position are expected to work on site a certain number of days per week following Company policy.

About our Company:

Medidata is powering smarter treatments and healthier people through digital solutions to support clinical trials. Celebrating over 25 years of ground-breaking technological innovation across more than 38,000 trials and 12 million patients, Medidata offers industry-leading expertise, analytics-powered insights, and one of the largest clinical trial data sets in the industry. More than 1 million registered users across approximately 2,300 customers trust Medidata's seamless, end-to-end platform to improve patient experiences, accelerate clinical breakthroughs, and bring therapies to market faster. A Dassault Systèmes brand (Euronext Paris: FR0014003TT8, DSY.PA), Medidata is headquartered in New York City and has been recognized as a Leader by Everest Group and IDC. Discover more at www.medidata.com. Listen to our latest podcast, from Dreamers to Disruptors, and follow us at @Medidata.

We are seeking a Product Analytics Associate to serve as a critical bridge between Product, Data Science, Client Delivery, and Sales. In this role, you will lead high value initiatives that are an essential part in driving Medidata's Study Experience product roadmap. You will work on initiatives focused on building new study insights, improving data quality, and supporting the development of advanced AI predictive models. Additionally, you will be instrumental in providing continuous analytics support for pre-sales proposals and client engagements to ensure we provide actionable insights to our customers.

Diversified. Resilient. Dynamic.

The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology-led service provides access to all major exchanges, order-flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award-winning data, insights and analytics.
