rows.title: VIE - Data Analyst (H/F) - New York

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
CONTEXTE ET MISSION

Dans le cadre de l'expansion de sa Data Platform cloud, Hermès engage la transformation de son patrimoine data aux États-Unis. Vous rejoignez cette initiative à un moment charnière : celui où les fondations analytiques se construisent. Votre mission est de garantir que les données soient fiables, documentées et exploitables .

Le ou la VIE sera un interlocuteur clé entre les équipes métier US et l'équipe Analytics & AI de HDTI, contribuant à la fois à la fiabilisation des données et à leur valorisation via Power BI. Vous formerez également un binôme opérationnel avec le ou la VIE Data Engineer présent(e) sur le même programme : l'un construit les fondations, l'autre les valorise.

Ce poste requiert avant tout une forte compréhension fonctionnelle des données : savoir analyser un jeu de données, en comprendre le sens métier, identifier les anomalies et documenter avec rigueur. La maîtrise technique est un levier, la capacité d'assimilation des processus fonctionnels est indispensable.

MISSIONS PRINCIPALES

Relais standards & bonnes pratiques

 Agir en tant que relais local des standards, méthodologies et bonnes pratiques définis en matière d'analyse de données et de développement BI et en garantir l’adoption et le respect au sein de l'équipe US.

Exploration & rétro-documentation de l'existant

 Établir le diagnostic data de l'existant US. Produire des profils de données (data profiling) et documenter les anomalies et zones de risque, constituant ainsi la cartographie de référence du patrimoine data avant migration. Identifier les règles métier implicites dans les données existantes pour alimenter la modélisation cible. Construire la mémoire analytique du projet.

Analyse de qualité & détection des écarts (Gap Analysis)

 Comparer les données sources (plateforme locale) aux nouveaux data models Snowflake, périmètre, définitions, et produire une analyse d'écarts actionnables pour les équipes d'ingénierie. Formaliser les écarts constatés et proposer des règles de réconciliation ou de transformation. Suivre les indicateurs de qualité data tout au long du processus de migration, en assurant une visibilité continue sur l'état de fiabilité des données.

Développement de dashboards & reporting

 Livrer les premiers reportings opérationnels post-migration aux équipes métier US, avec un impact visible dès les premières semaines : vous traduisez la donnée en décision. Développer des dashboards Power BI sur le semantic layer de la nouvelle Data Platform, en respectant les standards de certification Hermès. Contribuer à l'adoption de la nouvelle plateforme par les équipes métier en rendant les données accessibles, lisibles et fiables.

Collaboration & documentation

 Travailler en lien étroit avec le Data Engineer VIE et les équipes Analytics & AI Paris pour assurer la cohérence des livrables. Documenter systématiquement les analyses, hypothèses et conclusions dans les outils de référence de l'équipe. Contribuer aux ateliers de qualification métier pour valider les règles de gestion et les définitions de données.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

 Diplôme Bac+4/5 en data, statistiques, économétrie, mathématiques appliquées ou école de commerce avec spécialisation data ou équivalent Première expérience (stage, alternance ou poste junior) en analyse de données ou BI dans un environnement structuré SQL avancé Power BI Capacité à réaliser du data profiling et à interpréter des indicateurs de qualité de données La connaissance de Snowflake ou d'un cloud data warehouse est un plus La maîtrise de Python ou R pour l'analyse exploratoire est appréciée Autonomie, rigueur, sens analytique, curiosité Aisance en anglais professionnel (écrit et oral) indispensable ; le français est un atout

CE QUE VOUS Y TROUVEREZ

 Une mission à fort enjeu sur un programme de transformation data stratégique . Un rôle de passerelle entre les équipes IT & métier US et les équipes data centrales, avec une visibilité forte dès le départ. Basé(e) aux États-Unis, vous évoluez dans un environnement à culture entrepreneuriale forte, avec une autonomie réelle et une exposition directe aux équipes métier locales dès le premier mois. Les VIE qui réussissent cette mission ont vocation à rejoindre les équipes Analytics & AI d'HDTI à l'issue de leur contrat, en France ou à l'international. Ce poste est un tremplin, pas une parenthèse.

Merci de vérifier que vous remplissez les conditions du V.I.E avant de postuler à l’offre d’emploi.

Vous pouvez être volontaire si vous remplissez les 5 conditions suivantes :

Avoir entre 18 et 28 ans à la date de l'inscription. Le départ en mission s'effectue au plus tard le jour du 29e anniversaire. Au-delà, aucune dérogation n'est accordée.

Être français ou ressortissant d'un pays de l'Espace économique européen

Être en règle avec les obligations de service national (journée de défense et de citoyenneté)

Jouir de vos droits civiques (droit de vote et casier judiciaire vierge)

Remplir les conditions d'aptitude physique exigées pour les personnes exerçant des activités de même nature dans l'organisme d'accueil

Plus de détail sur le lien suivant : https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F10040

Employeur responsable, Hermès s'engage en faveur de l'éthique, de la diversité et de l'inclusion.

Rejoignez l'aventure humaine Hermès et construisez votre parcours cousu main.

"Créateur, artisan et marchand d’objets de haute qualité, Hermès est, depuis 1837, une maison française, familiale et indépendante qui emploie près de 25 185 collaborateurs dans le monde. Animé par un esprit d’entreprendre continu et une exigence constante, Hermès cultive la liberté et l’autonomie de chacun grâce à un management responsable. L’entreprise perpétue la transmission de savoir-faire d’exception par un ancrage territorial fort dans le respect des hommes et de la nature – source de matières d’exception. Seize métiers artisanaux irriguent la créativité de la maison dont les collections rayonnent dans près 300 magasins dans le monde."

Position Title: Lead Analyst, People Data Insights (Crewmember Listening)

Position Summary:

At JetBlue, our mission is to inspire humanity, and the People Data Insights team advances that mission by translating people data into insights that guide talent strategy and improve outcomes such as retention, mobility, performance, and the overall Crewmember experience.

The Lead Analyst, Crewmember Listening, owns JetBlue’s enterprise listening strategy and survey portfolio. This role leads the design, administration, analysis, and evolution of key People surveys, including engagement, safety, candidate experience, onboarding, and exit, often in close partnership with People Business Partners and cross-functional stakeholders.

Leveraging expertise in research methodology, analytics, and applied psychology, the Lead Analyst conducts rigorous analyses and linkage research to connect listening data with business outcomes. In partnership with the broader People Data Insights team, this role delivers clear, data-driven insights that enable leaders to make informed decisions, strengthen the Crewmember experience, and drive business results.

This role requires strong collaboration across levels of the organization, exceptional attention to detail, and a passion for using data to influence strategy and change. The Lead Analyst is also expected to continuously build expertise in new tools, technologies, and subject areas to advance JetBlue’s listening capabilities.

Essential Responsibilities

Own and lead JetBlue’s company-wide Crewmember listening programs (e.g., engagement, safety, candidate experience, onboarding, exit) in partnership with People Business PartnersDesign, administer, and continuously improve surveys to ensure methodological rigor, relevance, and alignment with organizational prioritiesEnsure all data privacy, security, and governance requirements are upheld across listening programsDesign and implement automated analytic pipelines using code (e.g., R) to generate and refresh thousands of survey analyses and outputs with minimal manual interventionCollaborate with different areas of the business to identify research questions based on organizational needs, and effectively collect data to answer those questionsConduct advanced analyses and linkage research to connect listening data with business and talent outcomesIntegrate listening data with other People and business data, as well as external research, to inform strategic decision-makingDeliver clear, compelling insights and recommendations to leaders at all levels, translating complex analyses into simple, actionable narrativesProvide thought leadership in evolving JetBlue’s listening framework, strategy, and practices to maximize impact over timeOther duties as assigned

rows.title: Analyst, Data Operations, Ares Insurance Solutions (AIS)

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.

Job Description

Ares Insurance Solutions (AIS) is seeking an Analyst to support the Asset Analytics and Data Operations function responsible for investment portfolios backing life and annuity insurance liabilities. This role will focus on maintaining the quality, accuracy, and completeness of investment data used across investment management, actuarial, finance, and forecasting processes.

The Analyst will play a key role in identifying, investigating, and resolving data anomalies, reconciliation exceptions, and data discrepancies across multiple investment systems and data sources, helping ensure the integrity and reliability of investment data used across the organization. Working closely with Asset Analytics, Investment Operations, Finance, Accounting, and Technology teams, the Analyst will support critical data governance and operational processes. The individual will also assist with the preparation and validation of asset-related inputs for FP&A and projection models and may support the execution of forecasting tools and processes.

This role is well-suited for a detail-oriented professional interested in investment operations, insurance asset management, data governance, and cross-functional problem-solving.

Responsibilities

Asset Data Management and Reconciliation

Monitor the quality, accuracy, and completeness of investment data across various asset classes, including public fixed income, structured products, private credit, mortgages, and alternative investments.Perform daily, monthly, and quarter-end reconciliations across investment accounting systems, portfolio management platforms, custodians, data warehouses, and analytical applications.Investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks involving positions, market values, book values, cash balances, accrued interest, investment income, ratings, security master attributes, and cash flows.Analyze data anomalies and reconciliation exceptions across multiple sources and determine root causes, whether related to source feeds, accounting treatment, data transformations, system configurations, timing differences, or operational processes.Partner with Investment Operations, Accounting, Technology, and external service providers to investigate and resolve data anomalies and reconciliation exceptions and validate remediation efforts.Maintain reconciliation inventories, exception logs, and support documentation to ensure transparency and auditability of the resolution process.Ensure data consistency across upstream and downstream systems supporting investment management, actuarial modeling, FP&A, regulatory reporting, and management reporting.Assist in establishing and enhancing data quality controls, exception monitoring, and operational workflows to proactively identify anomalies before they impact business processes.Support data validation efforts related to new security onboarding, portfolio transfers, acquisitions, system implementations, and data migration projects.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Serve as a key liaison between Asset Analytics, Investment Operations, Finance, Accounting, Actuarial, and Technology teams.Communicate data anomalies, reconciliation findings, business requirements, and remediation priorities to stakeholders across functions.Coordinate exception resolution efforts from identification through testing, validation, and closure.Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) for system enhancements, data feeds, platform upgrades, and process changes.Maintain documentation of data definitions, business requirements, reconciliation procedures, exception management workflows, and operating controls.

FP&A and Projection Support

Prepare, validate, and reconcile asset-related inputs used in FP&A forecasts, planning exercises, and financial projection models.Ensure completeness and accuracy of portfolio attributes, asset cash flows, yields, spreads, ratings, durations, reinvestment assumptions, and other modeling inputs.Support periodic forecasting and planning processes by providing timely and accurate data extracts and validation checks.Assist in executing asset-side projection tools and perform reasonability reviews of outputs.Investigate and resolve data anomalies, exceptions, or inconsistencies that may impact model inputs, assumptions, or projection results.

Process Improvement and Data Governance

Identify opportunities to improve reconciliation processes, data controls, and operational efficiency.Support initiatives to strengthen data governance and improve data lineage, transparency, and consistency across systems.Assist with the development of automated data validation and reconciliation processes where appropriate.Contribute to the establishment of best practices for investment data management and operational controls.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Actuarial Science, or a related field.

Experience

1–4 years of experience in investment operations, data management, accounting, financial services, insurance, asset management, or a related field.Experience working with financial data, reconciliations, operational controls, or data quality processes preferred.Exposure to life insurance, annuities, investment accounting, investment operations, or asset management is a plus.

Technical Skills

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.Working knowledge of SQL and database querying concepts.Experience with Python, Power BI, Alteryx, or other data analysis and automation tools is a plus.Ability to analyze large datasets and investigate data discrepancies across multiple systems.Familiarity with investment accounting concepts and investment data structures is preferred.

Professional Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.Ability to independently investigate complex data anomalies and determine root causes.Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.Ability to work collaboratively across business, operations, finance, actuarial, and technology teams.Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on operational excellence and control effectiveness.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with fixed income, structured products, private credit, or insurance investment portfolios.Understanding of investment accounting platforms, custodial data, security master data, and investment operations workflows.Experience supporting financial projections, planning processes, or actuarial and finance data requirements.Progress toward a professional designation in accounting, actuarial science, finance, or a related field is a plus, but not required.

Success In This Role

A successful candidate will:

Ensure the integrity and reliability of asset data across critical investment, finance, and actuarial systems.Consistently identify, investigate, and resolve reconciliation breaks, data anomalies, and data quality exceptions in a timely manner.Serve as a trusted partner across Operations, Accounting, Finance, Actuarial, Technology, and Asset Analytics teams.Deliver accurate and well-controlled asset data inputs for forecasting and projection processes.Contribute to a stronger data governance framework and a more scalable investment data operating model.

Reporting Relationships

Head of Risk, ALM & Capital Management, Ares Insurance Solutions

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Total compensation may also include a discretionary performance-based bonus. Note, the range takes into account a broad spectrum of qualifications, including, but not limited to, years of relevant work experience, education, and other relevant qualifications specific to the role.

$95,000 - $110,000

The firm also offers robust Benefits offerings. Ares U.S. Core Benefits include Comprehensive Medical/Rx, Dental and Vision plans; 401(k) program with company match; Flexible Savings Accounts (FSA); Healthcare Savings Accounts (HSA) with company contribution; Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance; Long-Term Disability (LTD) and Short-Term Disability (STD) insurance; Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Commuter Benefits plan for parking and transit.

Ares offers a number of additional benefits including access to a world-class medical advisory team, a mental health app that includes coaching, therapy and psychiatry, a mindfulness and wellbeing app, financial wellness benefit that includes access to a financial advisor, new parent leave, reproductive and adoption assistance, emergency backup care, matching gift program, education sponsorship program, and much more.

There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.

Application Deadline: 30 October 2026

Department: Research

Location: New York

Compensation: $68,000 - $78,000 / year

Description

TL;DR Kharon is seeking a full-time Research Analyst based in NYC or Washington D.C. This role requires in-office attendance 4 days a week.

Responsibilities

Monitoring new sanctions, enforcement actions, and policy activity by regulatory agencies for developments relevant to Kharon’s products.Driving the curation, publication, maintenance, and quality assurance of datasets.Performing data validation and reconciliation to support new products and partnership initiatives.Conducting research on issues in international affairs that impact business risks and identifying relevant data sources.Accurately perform detailed quality assurance of data and developing additional tooling to support these tasks as necessaryWrites original code to assist in automating data analysis, cleanup, and enhancements.

Qualifications

Must have a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Administration, International Relations, Political Science, Security Studies, Regional Studies, History, Sociology, or a related field.Must have at least 1-3 years of professional experience with sanctions, export controls, anti-money laundering or countering the financing of terrorism, and experience researching issues of international security and economy in high-risk jurisdictions.Experience with or willingness to learn SQL.Experience with data analysis, data visualization, and graph databases (Neo4J).Understanding of or willingness to learn web technologies (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, XPath, JSON, etc).

About Kharon

Kharon is a highly disruptive and incredibly innovative organization that navigates risk at the intersection of global security threats + international commerce.

What does that mean? Great question.

Operating at the nexus of global security, Kharon is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take really complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible. From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. Now, we’re experiencing unprecedented growth. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products. Given the significance of our work and the increasing global reliance on our insights, we are looking for a Research Analyst to join us as we work to shape the way businesses perceive and navigate global risks.

The core of this position is dedicated to conducting open-source research on a variety of foreign affairs and national security issues. More specifically, you will be researching, analyzing, and interpreting data as it relates to sanctions, export controls, and criminal/illicit networks. You will be responsible for the diligent pursuit of data as it relates to ever-evolving market demand and our client inquiries. Working collaboratively with the Kharon Research team, you will contribute to the development of new datasets and update existing ones, identifying and utilizing new sources and developing subject matter expertise on the various strategic topics. This includes monitoring new sanctions, enforcement actions, and policy activity by regulatory agencies, as well as conducting research on international affairs that affect business risks. Leveraging your sound analytical approach and research techniques, you will identify data typologies, perform detailed quality assurance, validate and reconcile data, and support new product and partnership initiatives. You’ll also play a key role in curating, publishing, and maintaining datasets, and may write original code to collect primary data across various languages. Cross-functional collaboration is essential as you help build out new research, surface insights from existing content, and report key project metrics to internal stakeholders.

To the right person, this will be the perfect kind of challenge. Our mission is compelling, our product is powerful, and we’re growing at a rate that makes us unstoppable. If you’re looking to be surrounded by people who will inspire you to think and challenge you to grow then look no further. Our team is made up of some of the most visionary and uncompromising individuals you will ever encounter. We don’t take ourselves seriously but we’re serious about the work we do and there is absolutely no slowing us down.

To Keep That Momentum Going, We Do Our Very Best To Make Sure That Each And Every Team Member Is Completely Taken Care Of. We’re Nothing Without Our People And We Strive To Offer a Package That Reflects That. As a Kharon Team Member, You Can Expect

Fully sponsored medical, dental, and vision insurancesFSA program for both medical and dependent careLong term disability401k + Roth with matching and immediate vesting Flexible paid time off + 11 paid holidays

The base salary range at Kharon is set between $68,000-$78,000. Please note that this figure does not necessarily include potential bonuses, commissions, benefits, or equity that may be part of the overall compensation package.

If interested in pursuing this position, please visit www.kharon.com/careers to apply.

Kharon is an equal opportunity employer. Kharon is committed to cultivating and maintaining a workplace that is free from harassment and discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation or identity, neurodiversity, appearances, age, protected veteran status, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

About Us

PhysicsX is a deep-tech company with roots in numerical physics and Formula One, dedicated to accelerating hardware innovation at the speed of software.

We are building an AI-driven simulation software stack for engineering and manufacturing across advanced industries. By enabling high-fidelity, multi-physics simulation through AI inference across the entire engineering lifecycle, PhysicsX unlocks new levels of optimization and automation in design, manufacturing, and operations — empowering engineers to push the boundaries of possibility. Our customers include leading innovators in Aerospace & Defense, Materials, Energy, Semiconductors, and Automotive.

Who We're Looking For

As a Data Scientist in Delivery, you are a problem solver and builder who is passionate about creating practical solutions that enable customers to make better engineering decisions. You are someone who can grasp advanced engineering concepts across multiple industries, and you excel at working directly with customers (and often side-by-side with them on-site) to transform cutting edge AI models into tools that are useful and used.

You’ve worked on difficult problems that require strong foundations in data driven modelling and deep learning techniques, with hands-on experience in probabilistic methods and predictive modelling. Expertise in python, along with proficiency in libraries like NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, TensorFlow and PyTorch, is essential, with the ability to deploy scalable, production-ready models and data pipelines.

With at least 1 year industry experience (post Masters or PhD) in a commercial, non-research environment, you’re ready to hit the ground running. You’re truly excited about growing your technical expertise and are naturally inclined to take ownership of data science work streams, continuously improving the systems and solutions you work on to ensure they are practical, impactful and meet the evolving needs of our customers.

This Role

In this role, you’ll work closely with our Simulation Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and customers to understand and define the engineering and physics challenges we are solving.

You’ll build the foundations for successful, impactful solutions by:

Pre-processing and analyzing data to prepare it for use in predictive modelling, building the foundation for machine learning algorithms to be developed.Developing and utilizing innovative deep learning models in combination with state-of-the-art optimization methods to predict and control the behaviour of physical systems.Taking full responsibility for the quality, accuracy and impact of your work.Designing, building and testing data pipelines that are reliable, scalable and easily deployable in production environments.Working closely with simulation engineers to ensure seamless integration of data science models with simulations.Contributing to internal R&D and product development, helping to refine models and identify new areas of application.Engaging in open communication and presentation with both technical teams and customers, helping onboard users and co-develop with customers.

You'll also have the opportunity to travel to customer sites in North America, Europe, Asia, Oceania, for an average of 3-4 weeks per quarter, where you'll collaborate closely with customers to build solutions on-site.

As the role evolves, there are exciting opportunities for growth as an individual contributor or a technical lead, especially if you’re driven by taking ownership of more complex projects and leading the direction of future solutions.

Please note, this role is based in Manhattan, NYC, working 2-3 days per week in our office.

Our delivery teams drive innovation to turn AI models into practical solutions - read our blog to learn more about how you’ll contribute to this exciting journey!

What We Offer

Build what actually matters

Help shape an AI-native engineering company at a formative stage, tackling problems that genuinely matter for industry and society. This is work with real-world impact - and something you can be proud to stand behind.

Learn alongside exceptional people

Work with a high-caliber, collaborative team of engineers, scientists, and operators who care deeply about doing great work, and about helping each other get better. We come from diverse backgrounds, but we share a commitment to operating at the highest level and addressing some of the most complex challenges out there. If you’re ambitious, thoughtful, and driven by impact, you’ll feel at home.

Influence over hierarchy

We operate with a flat structure: good ideas win - wherever they come from. Questioning assumptions and challenging the status quo isn’t just welcomed, it’s expected.

Sustainable pace, long-term ambition

Building meaningful technology is a marathon, not a sprint. We believe in balancing focused, ambitious work with a life beyond it. Our hybrid model blends time together in our New York office with work-from-home days, giving you the flexibility to work sustainably while staying connected in person.

And it doesn’t stop there …

🚀 Equity options - share meaningfully in the company you’re helping to build.

💰 5% contribution to 401(k) - build long-term security with a strong retirement plan.

🍽️ Free team lunch 1x/week - good food, great company, and space to connect.

🏥 Private health insurance – comprehensive cover for you, offering total peace of mind.

👶 Enhanced parental leave – 3 months full pay paternity and 6 months full pay maternity leave, to provide extra flexibility during the moments that matter most.

☀️ 20 days of Annual Leave (+ Public Holidays) - because taking time to rest matters.

📈 Personal development – dedicated support for learning, development, and leveling up over time.

💪 Gympass / Wellhub (subsidized) – for you and up to 3 family members, supporting both physical and mental wellbeing.

💳 Flexible Spending Account (FSA) – set aside pre-tax dollars for eligible healthcare expenses.

🔎 Watch this space, we’re continuing to build this as we grow…

Our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the Sailors who operate those reactors in the U.S. Navy's submarines and aircraft carrier Fleets. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today!

Job Description

The Engineering Quality organization is seeking a highly motivated Data Scientist who can design, build, and optimize data solutions that support strategic decision making across the organization. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills with an ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights for engineers and management.

Required Combination Of Knowledge And Skill

Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field; or Masters degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field.

Job Description

YOUR IMPACT

As a Product Marketing Analyst, you'll play a meaningful role in shaping how clients and advisors experience Goldman Sachs' wealth management offerings. From building and overseeing integrated marketing campaigns across key audiences to crafting compelling narratives around investment solutions, your work will directly influence how we connect with clients and grow our business.

You'll own the development of multi-channel campaigns — coordinating strategy, messaging, creative, and analytics across a diverse set of internal and external partners. If you're a sharp communicator with a passion for financial markets and marketing, and a drive to make an impact, this is the role for you.

Ideal candidates bring financial acumen, strong writing instincts, and deep hands-on experience designing and executing integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels and audiences. You're organized, entrepreneurial, and energized by the opportunity to continuously raise the bar for how a world-class marketing team operates.

OUR IMPACT 

Wealth Management

At Goldman Sachs, we help clients around the world reach their financial goals. Our Private Wealth Advisors deliver financial planning, investment management, lending, and comprehensive guidance to a diverse range of clients — from ultra-high net worth individuals and families to family offices, foundations and endowments,

Marketing & Client Engagement Team

The Marketing & Client Engagement Team sits at the intersection of brand, strategy, and client experience. We design and execute the marketing programs that bring Goldman Sachs Wealth Management to life — attracting new clients, strengthening existing relationships, and creating meaningful touchpoints across every stage of the client journey. We're growing our team and looking for a talented marketer to help drive that work forward.

How You Will Fulfill Your Potential

 Lead integrated marketing campaigns — Develop, manage, and oversee end-to-end integrated marketing campaigns across a range of investment, lending and planning solutions and key audiences, tailoring strategy and messaging to distinct client and advisor audiences.  Drive campaign strategy — Build comprehensive, multi-channel marketing programs that span digital, content, email, and advisor-facing channels — ensuring consistent messaging and a cohesive brand experience at every touchpoint.  Translate products into stories — Partner closely with business and product teams to deeply understand our offerings and translate complex financial concepts into clear, compelling campaign narratives that resonate with target audiences.  Tell compelling stories — Draft and edit copy for pitch books, articles and other client-facing materials that are clear, persuasive, and on-brand.  Collaborate broadly — Work across internal marketing teams and external partners, agencies, and vendors to bring integrated campaigns to life across new and existing channels.  Own the process — Manage campaigns end-to-end, from initial planning and audience segmentation through creative briefing, copywriting, design, implementation, optimization, and reporting.  Engage advisors — Partner with advisor teams to develop targeted content and campaigns that drive product awareness, education, and adoption across key wealth management offerings.  Educate and inspire — Compose and lightly design internal educational materials that help advisor teams stay informed and engaged.  Think creatively — Bring fresh ideas to the table to maximize client engagement and keep our marketing campaigns sharp, differentiated, and effective.  Let data lead — Use an iterative, data-driven approach to continuously measure, enhance, and optimize integrated campaign performance across channels and audiences.  Report with clarity — Create regular reports on campaign results, test findings, and ongoing initiatives to share actionable insights with leadership.  Improve how we work — Actively contribute to the evolution of the Marketing team's processes for stronger collaboration and more efficient campaign execution.  Keep things running — Manage invoicing, budget tracking, and statement of work approvals with precision and accountability. 

Experience & Skills We’re Looking For

Bachelor’s Degree Required2+ years of professional experience in integrated marketing, product marketing, or a related field Demonstrated experience building and executing integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns across diverse audiences and products  Experience in financial services (wealth management, investments, or related fields) strongly preferred  Strong copywriting and editorial skills — you write with clarity, creativity, and purpose  Ability to develop audience-specific messaging frameworks and campaign strategies that drive measurable engagement  Familiarity with design tools across the Microsoft suite  Proven ability to execute distinctive, results-driven marketing programs in the marketplace  A collaborative, positive team outlook with a client-first mindset  Strong interpersonal skills and comfort working in a team-oriented environment  Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and think clearly under pressure  Highly organized with sharp attention to detail and excellent follow-through  Strong verbal and written communication skills  An entrepreneurial spirit and creative approach to problem-solving 

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

We're committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

Medidata follows a hybrid office policy in which employees who are hired for an in-person position are expected to work on site a certain number of days per week following Company policy.

About our Company:

Medidata is powering smarter treatments and healthier people through digital solutions to support clinical trials. Celebrating over 25 years of ground-breaking technological innovation across more than 38,000 trials and 12 million patients, Medidata offers industry-leading expertise, analytics-powered insights, and one of the largest clinical trial data sets in the industry. More than 1 million registered users across approximately 2,300 customers trust Medidata's seamless, end-to-end platform to improve patient experiences, accelerate clinical breakthroughs, and bring therapies to market faster. A Dassault Systèmes brand (Euronext Paris: FR0014003TT8, DSY.PA), Medidata is headquartered in New York City and has been recognized as a Leader by Everest Group and IDC. Discover more at www.medidata.com. Listen to our latest podcast, from Dreamers to Disruptors, and follow us at @Medidata.

About the Team:

We are seeking a Product Analytics Associate to serve as a critical bridge between Product, Data Science, Client Delivery, and Sales. In this role, you will lead high value initiatives that are an essential part in driving Medidata's Study Experience product roadmap. You will work on initiatives focused on building new study insights, improving data quality, and supporting the development of advanced AI predictive models. Additionally, you will be instrumental in providing continuous analytics support for pre-sales proposals and client engagements to ensure we provide actionable insights to our customers.

Responsibilities:

Product Development and Data Science Innovation

New Insights Development: Explore internal data sources based on customer feedback and market needs to develop new, actionable insights and metrics for our customersMetric Refinement: Enhance existing product metrics to improve accuracy, consistency, and usability across platforms.AI Development: independently define and own product requirements for predictive models, partnering with Data Science teams to spearhead product requirements, research, validation for predictive models, ensuring outputs are trusted and understood by customers.

Client Delivery and Revenue Enablement

Customer Analytics: own the end to end development of complex analytics solutions, determining methods and approaches with minimal direction Develop insights that address immediate client needs and serve as validation for future roadmap features

Cross-Functional Leadership

Stakeholder Collaboration: Serve as a subject matter expect and primary point of contact across Data Engineering, Product Owners, Data Operations and Client Delivery teams - proactively identifying and resolving cross functional issues

Successful candidates will be skilled in analytical/quantitative thinking, structured communication and excited about building the next horizon of Medidata's journey of powering smarter treatments and healthier people.

Qualifications:

Bachelors degree or equivalent experience5+ years of work experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 3+ years with a Master's degree, in one of the following types of highly structured or scientific environments: management/healthcare consulting, life sciences, data and analytics roleProficiency in data analytics tools and concepts (e.g, Python, SQL, R)A passion for understanding complex issues with a data driven approachOutstanding structured and critical thinkingProduct or Project Management experience to oversee metric development, productization, and cross-functional roadmap alignment spanning multiple productsThe ability to interface directly with internal stakeholders and with clients to generate actionable and scalable self-service analytics tools

The following will be helpful, but are not essential:

Strong performance in a MS program in Data Science, Statistics, or Computer Science or related fieldExperience working in Life sciences or across the healthcare value chainAn entrepreneurial drive and a passion to advance the development of new treatmentsA strong analytical background and the ability to quickly digest and evaluate complex analyses with a keen eye for detail

As with all roles, Medidata sets ranges based on a number of factors including function, level, candidate expertise and experience, and geographic location. Pay ranges for candidates in locations other than New York City, may differ based on the local market data in that region.

The salary range for positions that will be physically based in New York will be $114,750- $153,000.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Medidata provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a commission on the terms of applicable plan documents, and many of Medidata's non-sales positions are eligible for annual bonuses. Medidata believes that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most and provides benefits, including medical, dental, life and disability insurance, 401(k) matching, family leave, flexible paid time off; and 10 paid holidays per year.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
The Team

 JOB DESCRIPTION 

In U.S. Consumer Services (USCS), our product is Membership—delivering benefits and services that are essential to our Card Members across travel, dining, entertainment, and retail. We compete by providing a differentiated Membership experience that drives loyalty and long-term growth. USCS brings this to life through our premium, cobrand, cash back, and lending portfolios, Membership Rewards, Travel & Lifestyle Services, the Centurion Lounge network, Global Dining, U.S. Consumer Banking, Amex Offers, Amex Ads, and best-in-class marketing programs.

Accelerating growth across our Cobrand portfolios is central to our enterprise strategy—expanding customer relevance, deepening loyalty, diversifying revenue streams, and delivering sustainable top-line growth. The Cobrand organization within the U.S. Consumer Services Group leads the strategy and management of our Cobrand partner relationships and Cobranded credit card solutions, integrating product innovation, portfolio strategy, P&L management, customer experiences, and operational excellence to strengthen loyalty and enhance our competitive position.

The Delta Cobrand Product Management team is responsible for shaping and executing the long-term strategy of one of our most significant strategic partnerships. The team drives the portfolio vision, value proposition design, financial performance, and innovation—ensuring we deliver differentiated, customer-centric products that drive acquisition, increase engagement, and create mutual value for both organizations.

About The Role

This Senior Analyst will be responsible for driving high-priority portfolio operations and partner-facing workstreams that will enable growth for the Delta Cobrand portfolio. This is a highly visible role, with responsibilities spanning across the end-to-end product management lifecycle, inclusive of program reporting, competitive insights, benefit management, invoicing, and operational risk management.

The Senior Analyst will play a critical role in strengthening operational rigor, surfacing insights that inform product decisions, and helping advance the long-term growth strategy for the portfolio. This individual will partner closely with Finance, Analytics, Control Management and Compliance teams, while supporting ongoing engagement with Delta counterparts.

This impactful role is for someone who wants to gain experience in product management and exposure to the P/L. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, comfortable operating across ambiguity, and energized by working at the intersection of product strategy, partner management, and execution. A successful candidate is someone who can connect day-to-day operational details to broader portfolio priorities, helping the team identify opportunities to improve customer experience, strengthen controls, and unlock growth.

Responsibilities

Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Analytics, Control Management, Compliance, and Delta partners to move initiatives forward Responsible for day-to-day key partner and product operations, including but not limited to reporting, invoicing, and insightsDeliver and synthesize insights and analyses through competitive research and trends to inform product improvements and leadership decision makingContribute innovative ideas that elevate and influence the broader portfolio and strategySupport benefit management across the product lifecycle, including monitoring performance, coordinating with stakeholders to resolve issues, and ensuring benefit delivery is compliant and aligned to the intended customer experienceMonitor Operational Risk Events and Issues Management through escalations, identifying root causes, and drive remediation efforts for risk mitigation Serve as control management lead by creating and performing control testing, smart monitoring, and mitigating customer or operational issues 

Qualifications

2 years of work experience in a product or partner management role preferred Demonstrated ability to assess business needs, identify solutions, and implement them seamlessly Proven track record to spearhead workstreams autonomously and drive completion across teams at all levels Strong organization, communication, and project management skills Ability to build and influence positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and with a strong executive presence Experience with distilling complex information into clear, compelling narratives for senior leadership and partners, Executive-level presentations and briefing materials Comfort with data to synthesize from multiple sources into actionable insights to inform strategy Quick learner of proprietary systems and processes with impeccable attention to detailLearning agility and flexible style – ability to handle changing priorities and a broad variety of projectsStrong collaborator and team player with excellent interpersonal skills and willingness to support projects beyond immediate job scope Positive attitude, proactive work style, and customer / partner first mindset Passion for travel

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

Competitive base salariesBonus incentives6% Company Match on retirement savings planFree financial coaching and financial well-being supportComprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefitsFlexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need20+ weeks paid parental leave for all parents, regardless of gender, offered for pregnancy, adoption or surrogacyFree access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds programCareer development and training opportunities

Role Summary

The two-year Graduate Program provides recent graduates with hands-on experience across a wide range of front, middle, and back-office functions, contributing to projects that support operations, financial activities, client engagement, and regulatory responsibilities. Depending on placement, participants may assist with audits, reporting, compliance, financial transactions, client onboarding, technology, risk management, trade execution, prime brokerage, and client services. In addition to practical experience, the program emphasizes professional development, offering exposure to industry practices, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration alongside experienced professionals.

Graduates are expected to start no later than September 2026.

Overview Of Marex And Department Description

Diversified. Resilient. Dynamic.

Marex has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology-led service provides access to all major exchanges, order-flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award-winning data, insights and analytics. For more information visit www.marex.com.

The Corporate and Executive Departments are first and foremost a coordination and strategic support function. As such, the teams are responsible for enabling effective executive operations by managing information flow, supporting strategic planning, and maintaining strong governance while continuously evaluating administrative and operational processes for improvement. The teams work on daily activities such as preparing executive materials, coordinating cross‑functional communication, tracking governance and action items, and supporting strategic initiatives, as well as building frameworks to enhance process efficiency, strengthen decision‑making, and drive organizational alignment.

Purpose of Role

The Business Administration and Strategy Analyst plays a key role in supporting the Corporate and Executive Departments by delivering high‑quality analytical, organizational, and operational support. This role contributes to effective executive decision‑making by preparing clear business materials, coordinating information across teams, and ensuring timely completion of strategic and administrative priorities. The Analyst serves as a central resource for maintaining governance standards, improving processes, and supporting communication flow between leadership and business partners.

In today’s fast‑paced and highly regulated capital markets environment, efficient and well‑structured executive operations are essential to maintaining transparency, strengthening oversight, and enabling informed leadership decisions. By delivering reliable research, producing polished briefing materials, and supporting critical governance processes, the Business Administration & Strategy Analyst acts as a valuable partner to senior leadership. This role enables smooth execution within the executive office and reinforces the company’s commitment to operational excellence and organizational integrity.

Responsibilities:

Provide analytical, administrative, and day‑to‑day support for executive priorities.Prepare executive‑level presentations and briefing materials with accurate, organized data.Support strategic initiatives through research, background preparation, and information organization.Maintain governance by updating documentation, tracking actions, and supporting compliance.Coordinate communication and meeting outputs to ensure timely follow‑through.Identify and recommend improvements to enhance executive workflow and efficiency.Troubleshoot ad hoc requests and business issues to enable smooth executive operations.Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.At all times complying with Marex’s Code of Conduct.To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility.To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/or your supervisor as required.To escalate risk events immediately.To provide input to risk management processes, as required.

The Company may require you to carry out other duties from time to time.

Competencies, Skills And Experience

Competencies:

 Adaptability & Resilience – Thrives under pressure and dynamic environments. Analytical & Detail-Oriented – Demonstrates curiosity, precision, and problem-solving. Collaboration & Relationship-Building – Drives teamwork and stakeholder engagement. Communication & Influence – Conveys ideas clearly and builds consensus. Technical & Organizational Skills – Applies technology effectively and manages priorities.

Skills and Experience:

 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a related field required. Genuine interest in one or more of the program’s departmental tracks. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship, including, but not limited to, F-1, J-1, and M-1 visa holders, as well as individuals on CPT or OPT.

Company Values

Acting as a role model for the values of the Company:

Be collaborative - by working together across the organization, we foster teamwork, can better respond to challenges and successfully deliver for our clients

Act with integrity - we pride ourselves on our honesty and high ethical standards. We apply these values when working with all our clients, colleagues and other stakeholders

Be adaptable and entrepreneurial - we embrace change as markets evolve to constantly increase our efficiency and create innovative solutions for our clients. We are interested in the world around us and inquisitive about understanding the challenges and opportunities our clients face.

Be respectful – how we treat each other, and our clients says everything about who we are. We always act respectfully and treat people fairly in everything we do.

Nurture talent – we aim to grow our own talent and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking and talented people choose to build their career. This means giving and taking stretch opportunities, taking risks, and committing to career development and support – for ourselves and our teams.

Conduct Rules

You must:

 Act with integrity. Act with due skill, care and diligence. Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators. Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly. Observe proper standard of market conduct. Act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

Job Description

This position is part of the Data Insights & Strategic Analytics team and will report to the Senior Director, Measurement Strategy. The Analyst will support efforts to strengthen measurement capabilities across linear, digital and emerging platforms, playing a key role in data reporting, performance monitoring, and the operational processes that underpin the team’s measurement strategy. This includes working hands-on with data, helping to track key metrics, and ensuring the team is well-equipped to interpret and act on measurement insights.

This role is designed for someone eager to build expertise across three core areas: analyzing and working directly with a variety of industry data sets, understanding and monitoring evolving vendor methodologies and their impact on performance, and supporting the day-to-day operations of measurement strategy through vendor coordination and process management. The Analyst will contribute to developing internal fluency with a variety of standard industry data sets (e.g. Nielsen and comScore), along with other platform measurement and audience data sets (e.g. campaign measurement and attribution solutions), as well as emerging first- and second- party data sources.

This role requires comfort working with data in structured environments while also being able to adapt across a range of internal and external platforms over time. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, analytically curious, and eager to build deep expertise in media measurement across various platforms. They are proactive in working with data, comfortable navigating vendor tools and internal systems, and motivated to understand how measurement methodologies shape real-world performance insights.

Responsibilities:

Run and analyze reports using measurement platforms such as Nielsen and comScore, developing a strong working knowledge of underlying data setsTrack and document methodology changes from measurement vendors while analyzing trends, anomalies, and shifts in performance across brands and platforms to understand their real-time impactSupport the development and maintenance of tracking tools and dashboards to monitor ongoing performanceHelp manage vendor relationships, including scheduling meetings, support trainings, and follow-upsMaintain documentation related to measurement methodologies, processes, and vendor updates while tracking implementation timelines and ensuring stakeholders are kept informedSupport communication and collaboration across internal teams as well as with external measurement partners

Qualifications

1+ years of relevant experience in media, analytics, or measurement for the Analyst position and 3+ years for the Sr. Analyst positionWorking knowledge of both linear and digital media measurementExperience with Nielsen and comScore measurementBasic familiarity of SQL or Databricks (or similar data querying/processing tools)Familiarity with AI tools and processesStrong analytical skills and attention to detailProficiency in Excel and PowerPointStrong written and verbal communication skillsBachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, data analytics, or a related field

Desired Characteristics

Interest in the evolving media and measurement landscapeHighly organized with the ability to manage multiple prioritiesProactive, detail-oriented, and intellectually curiousStrong collaborator with a team-first mindsetEnthusiasm for learning and continuously building new skills, particularly in emerging measurement approaches and toolsInterest in being on the cutting edge of media measurement and contributing to the development of new processes, frameworks, and ways of working

Additional Information

Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of three days per week. Subject to change based on business need. This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks.

Salary range: $72,000 - $80,000 for Analyst

$80,000 - $95,000 for Sr. Analyst

rows.title: Analyst, Data Operations, Ares Insurance Solutions (AIS)

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.

Job Description

Ares Insurance Solutions (AIS) is seeking an Analyst to support the Asset Analytics and Data Operations function responsible for investment portfolios backing life and annuity insurance liabilities. This role will focus on maintaining the quality, accuracy, and completeness of investment data used across investment management, actuarial, finance, and forecasting processes.

The Analyst will play a key role in identifying, investigating, and resolving data anomalies, reconciliation exceptions, and data discrepancies across multiple investment systems and data sources, helping ensure the integrity and reliability of investment data used across the organization. Working closely with Asset Analytics, Investment Operations, Finance, Accounting, and Technology teams, the Analyst will support critical data governance and operational processes. The individual will also assist with the preparation and validation of asset-related inputs for FP&A and projection models and may support the execution of forecasting tools and processes.

This role is well-suited for a detail-oriented professional interested in investment operations, insurance asset management, data governance, and cross-functional problem-solving.

Responsibilities

Asset Data Management and Reconciliation

Monitor the quality, accuracy, and completeness of investment data across various asset classes, including public fixed income, structured products, private credit, mortgages, and alternative investments.Perform daily, monthly, and quarter-end reconciliations across investment accounting systems, portfolio management platforms, custodians, data warehouses, and analytical applications.Investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks involving positions, market values, book values, cash balances, accrued interest, investment income, ratings, security master attributes, and cash flows.Analyze data anomalies and reconciliation exceptions across multiple sources and determine root causes, whether related to source feeds, accounting treatment, data transformations, system configurations, timing differences, or operational processes.Partner with Investment Operations, Accounting, Technology, and external service providers to investigate and resolve data anomalies and reconciliation exceptions and validate remediation efforts.Maintain reconciliation inventories, exception logs, and support documentation to ensure transparency and auditability of the resolution process.Ensure data consistency across upstream and downstream systems supporting investment management, actuarial modeling, FP&A, regulatory reporting, and management reporting.Assist in establishing and enhancing data quality controls, exception monitoring, and operational workflows to proactively identify anomalies before they impact business processes.Support data validation efforts related to new security onboarding, portfolio transfers, acquisitions, system implementations, and data migration projects.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Serve as a key liaison between Asset Analytics, Investment Operations, Finance, Accounting, Actuarial, and Technology teams.Communicate data anomalies, reconciliation findings, business requirements, and remediation priorities to stakeholders across functions.Coordinate exception resolution efforts from identification through testing, validation, and closure.Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) for system enhancements, data feeds, platform upgrades, and process changes.Maintain documentation of data definitions, business requirements, reconciliation procedures, exception management workflows, and operating controls.

FP&A and Projection Support

Prepare, validate, and reconcile asset-related inputs used in FP&A forecasts, planning exercises, and financial projection models.Ensure completeness and accuracy of portfolio attributes, asset cash flows, yields, spreads, ratings, durations, reinvestment assumptions, and other modeling inputs.Support periodic forecasting and planning processes by providing timely and accurate data extracts and validation checks.Assist in executing asset-side projection tools and perform reasonability reviews of outputs.Investigate and resolve data anomalies, exceptions, or inconsistencies that may impact model inputs, assumptions, or projection results.

Process Improvement and Data Governance

Identify opportunities to improve reconciliation processes, data controls, and operational efficiency.Support initiatives to strengthen data governance and improve data lineage, transparency, and consistency across systems.Assist with the development of automated data validation and reconciliation processes where appropriate.Contribute to the establishment of best practices for investment data management and operational controls.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Actuarial Science, or a related field.

Experience

1–4 years of experience in investment operations, data management, accounting, financial services, insurance, asset management, or a related field.Experience working with financial data, reconciliations, operational controls, or data quality processes preferred.Exposure to life insurance, annuities, investment accounting, investment operations, or asset management is a plus.

Technical Skills

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.Working knowledge of SQL and database querying concepts.Experience with Python, Power BI, Alteryx, or other data analysis and automation tools is a plus.Ability to analyze large datasets and investigate data discrepancies across multiple systems.Familiarity with investment accounting concepts and investment data structures is preferred.

Professional Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.Ability to independently investigate complex data anomalies and determine root causes.Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.Ability to work collaboratively across business, operations, finance, actuarial, and technology teams.Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on operational excellence and control effectiveness.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with fixed income, structured products, private credit, or insurance investment portfolios.Understanding of investment accounting platforms, custodial data, security master data, and investment operations workflows.Experience supporting financial projections, planning processes, or actuarial and finance data requirements.Progress toward a professional designation in accounting, actuarial science, finance, or a related field is a plus, but not required.

Success In This Role

A successful candidate will:

Ensure the integrity and reliability of asset data across critical investment, finance, and actuarial systems.Consistently identify, investigate, and resolve reconciliation breaks, data anomalies, and data quality exceptions in a timely manner.Serve as a trusted partner across Operations, Accounting, Finance, Actuarial, Technology, and Asset Analytics teams.Deliver accurate and well-controlled asset data inputs for forecasting and projection processes.Contribute to a stronger data governance framework and a more scalable investment data operating model.

Reporting Relationships

Head of Risk, ALM & Capital Management, Ares Insurance Solutions

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Total compensation may also include a discretionary performance-based bonus. Note, the range takes into account a broad spectrum of qualifications, including, but not limited to, years of relevant work experience, education, and other relevant qualifications specific to the role.

$95,000 - $110,000

The firm also offers robust Benefits offerings. Ares U.S. Core Benefits include Comprehensive Medical/Rx, Dental and Vision plans; 401(k) program with company match; Flexible Savings Accounts (FSA); Healthcare Savings Accounts (HSA) with company contribution; Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance; Long-Term Disability (LTD) and Short-Term Disability (STD) insurance; Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Commuter Benefits plan for parking and transit.

Ares offers a number of additional benefits including access to a world-class medical advisory team, a mental health app that includes coaching, therapy and psychiatry, a mindfulness and wellbeing app, financial wellness benefit that includes access to a financial advisor, new parent leave, reproductive and adoption assistance, emergency backup care, matching gift program, education sponsorship program, and much more.
