rows.title: Analyst, Data Operations, Ares Insurance Solutions (AIS)

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.

Job Description

Ares Insurance Solutions (AIS) is seeking an Analyst to support the Asset Analytics and Data Operations function responsible for investment portfolios backing life and annuity insurance liabilities. This role will focus on maintaining the quality, accuracy, and completeness of investment data used across investment management, actuarial, finance, and forecasting processes.

The Analyst will play a key role in identifying, investigating, and resolving data anomalies, reconciliation exceptions, and data discrepancies across multiple investment systems and data sources, helping ensure the integrity and reliability of investment data used across the organization. Working closely with Asset Analytics, Investment Operations, Finance, Accounting, and Technology teams, the Analyst will support critical data governance and operational processes. The individual will also assist with the preparation and validation of asset-related inputs for FP&A and projection models and may support the execution of forecasting tools and processes.

This role is well-suited for a detail-oriented professional interested in investment operations, insurance asset management, data governance, and cross-functional problem-solving.

Responsibilities

Asset Data Management and Reconciliation

Monitor the quality, accuracy, and completeness of investment data across various asset classes, including public fixed income, structured products, private credit, mortgages, and alternative investments.Perform daily, monthly, and quarter-end reconciliations across investment accounting systems, portfolio management platforms, custodians, data warehouses, and analytical applications.Investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks involving positions, market values, book values, cash balances, accrued interest, investment income, ratings, security master attributes, and cash flows.Analyze data anomalies and reconciliation exceptions across multiple sources and determine root causes, whether related to source feeds, accounting treatment, data transformations, system configurations, timing differences, or operational processes.Partner with Investment Operations, Accounting, Technology, and external service providers to investigate and resolve data anomalies and reconciliation exceptions and validate remediation efforts.Maintain reconciliation inventories, exception logs, and support documentation to ensure transparency and auditability of the resolution process.Ensure data consistency across upstream and downstream systems supporting investment management, actuarial modeling, FP&A, regulatory reporting, and management reporting.Assist in establishing and enhancing data quality controls, exception monitoring, and operational workflows to proactively identify anomalies before they impact business processes.Support data validation efforts related to new security onboarding, portfolio transfers, acquisitions, system implementations, and data migration projects.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Serve as a key liaison between Asset Analytics, Investment Operations, Finance, Accounting, Actuarial, and Technology teams.Communicate data anomalies, reconciliation findings, business requirements, and remediation priorities to stakeholders across functions.Coordinate exception resolution efforts from identification through testing, validation, and closure.Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) for system enhancements, data feeds, platform upgrades, and process changes.Maintain documentation of data definitions, business requirements, reconciliation procedures, exception management workflows, and operating controls.

FP&A and Projection Support

Prepare, validate, and reconcile asset-related inputs used in FP&A forecasts, planning exercises, and financial projection models.Ensure completeness and accuracy of portfolio attributes, asset cash flows, yields, spreads, ratings, durations, reinvestment assumptions, and other modeling inputs.Support periodic forecasting and planning processes by providing timely and accurate data extracts and validation checks.Assist in executing asset-side projection tools and perform reasonability reviews of outputs.Investigate and resolve data anomalies, exceptions, or inconsistencies that may impact model inputs, assumptions, or projection results.

Process Improvement and Data Governance

Identify opportunities to improve reconciliation processes, data controls, and operational efficiency.Support initiatives to strengthen data governance and improve data lineage, transparency, and consistency across systems.Assist with the development of automated data validation and reconciliation processes where appropriate.Contribute to the establishment of best practices for investment data management and operational controls.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Actuarial Science, or a related field.

Experience

1–4 years of experience in investment operations, data management, accounting, financial services, insurance, asset management, or a related field.Experience working with financial data, reconciliations, operational controls, or data quality processes preferred.Exposure to life insurance, annuities, investment accounting, investment operations, or asset management is a plus.

Technical Skills

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.Working knowledge of SQL and database querying concepts.Experience with Python, Power BI, Alteryx, or other data analysis and automation tools is a plus.Ability to analyze large datasets and investigate data discrepancies across multiple systems.Familiarity with investment accounting concepts and investment data structures is preferred.

Professional Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.Ability to independently investigate complex data anomalies and determine root causes.Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.Ability to work collaboratively across business, operations, finance, actuarial, and technology teams.Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on operational excellence and control effectiveness.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with fixed income, structured products, private credit, or insurance investment portfolios.Understanding of investment accounting platforms, custodial data, security master data, and investment operations workflows.Experience supporting financial projections, planning processes, or actuarial and finance data requirements.Progress toward a professional designation in accounting, actuarial science, finance, or a related field is a plus, but not required.

Success In This Role

A successful candidate will:

Ensure the integrity and reliability of asset data across critical investment, finance, and actuarial systems.Consistently identify, investigate, and resolve reconciliation breaks, data anomalies, and data quality exceptions in a timely manner.Serve as a trusted partner across Operations, Accounting, Finance, Actuarial, Technology, and Asset Analytics teams.Deliver accurate and well-controlled asset data inputs for forecasting and projection processes.Contribute to a stronger data governance framework and a more scalable investment data operating model.

Reporting Relationships

Head of Risk, ALM & Capital Management, Ares Insurance Solutions

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Total compensation may also include a discretionary performance-based bonus. Note, the range takes into account a broad spectrum of qualifications, including, but not limited to, years of relevant work experience, education, and other relevant qualifications specific to the role.

$95,000 - $110,000

The firm also offers robust Benefits offerings. Ares U.S. Core Benefits include Comprehensive Medical/Rx, Dental and Vision plans; 401(k) program with company match; Flexible Savings Accounts (FSA); Healthcare Savings Accounts (HSA) with company contribution; Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance; Long-Term Disability (LTD) and Short-Term Disability (STD) insurance; Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Commuter Benefits plan for parking and transit.

Ares offers a number of additional benefits including access to a world-class medical advisory team, a mental health app that includes coaching, therapy and psychiatry, a mindfulness and wellbeing app, financial wellness benefit that includes access to a financial advisor, new parent leave, reproductive and adoption assistance, emergency backup care, matching gift program, education sponsorship program, and much more.

There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.

About Us

PhysicsX is a deep-tech company with roots in numerical physics and Formula One, dedicated to accelerating hardware innovation at the speed of software.

We are building an AI-driven simulation software stack for engineering and manufacturing across advanced industries. By enabling high-fidelity, multi-physics simulation through AI inference across the entire engineering lifecycle, PhysicsX unlocks new levels of optimization and automation in design, manufacturing, and operations — empowering engineers to push the boundaries of possibility. Our customers include leading innovators in Aerospace & Defense, Materials, Energy, Semiconductors, and Automotive.

Who We're Looking For

As a Data Scientist in Delivery, you are a problem solver and builder who is passionate about creating practical solutions that enable customers to make better engineering decisions. You are someone who can grasp advanced engineering concepts across multiple industries, and you excel at working directly with customers (and often side-by-side with them on-site) to transform cutting edge AI models into tools that are useful and used.

You’ve worked on difficult problems that require strong foundations in data driven modelling and deep learning techniques, with hands-on experience in probabilistic methods and predictive modelling. Expertise in python, along with proficiency in libraries like NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, TensorFlow and PyTorch, is essential, with the ability to deploy scalable, production-ready models and data pipelines.

With at least 1 year industry experience (post Masters or PhD) in a commercial, non-research environment, you’re ready to hit the ground running. You’re truly excited about growing your technical expertise and are naturally inclined to take ownership of data science work streams, continuously improving the systems and solutions you work on to ensure they are practical, impactful and meet the evolving needs of our customers.

This Role

In this role, you’ll work closely with our Simulation Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and customers to understand and define the engineering and physics challenges we are solving.

You’ll build the foundations for successful, impactful solutions by:

Pre-processing and analyzing data to prepare it for use in predictive modelling, building the foundation for machine learning algorithms to be developed.Developing and utilizing innovative deep learning models in combination with state-of-the-art optimization methods to predict and control the behaviour of physical systems.Taking full responsibility for the quality, accuracy and impact of your work.Designing, building and testing data pipelines that are reliable, scalable and easily deployable in production environments.Working closely with simulation engineers to ensure seamless integration of data science models with simulations.Contributing to internal R&D and product development, helping to refine models and identify new areas of application.Engaging in open communication and presentation with both technical teams and customers, helping onboard users and co-develop with customers.

You'll also have the opportunity to travel to customer sites in North America, Europe, Asia, Oceania, for an average of 3-4 weeks per quarter, where you'll collaborate closely with customers to build solutions on-site.

As the role evolves, there are exciting opportunities for growth as an individual contributor or a technical lead, especially if you’re driven by taking ownership of more complex projects and leading the direction of future solutions.

Please note, this role is based in Manhattan, NYC, working 2-3 days per week in our office.

Our delivery teams drive innovation to turn AI models into practical solutions - read our blog to learn more about how you’ll contribute to this exciting journey!

What We Offer

Build what actually matters

Help shape an AI-native engineering company at a formative stage, tackling problems that genuinely matter for industry and society. This is work with real-world impact - and something you can be proud to stand behind.

Learn alongside exceptional people

Work with a high-caliber, collaborative team of engineers, scientists, and operators who care deeply about doing great work, and about helping each other get better. We come from diverse backgrounds, but we share a commitment to operating at the highest level and addressing some of the most complex challenges out there. If you’re ambitious, thoughtful, and driven by impact, you’ll feel at home.

Influence over hierarchy

We operate with a flat structure: good ideas win - wherever they come from. Questioning assumptions and challenging the status quo isn’t just welcomed, it’s expected.

Sustainable pace, long-term ambition

Building meaningful technology is a marathon, not a sprint. We believe in balancing focused, ambitious work with a life beyond it. Our hybrid model blends time together in our New York office with work-from-home days, giving you the flexibility to work sustainably while staying connected in person.

And it doesn’t stop there …

🚀 Equity options - share meaningfully in the company you’re helping to build.

💰 5% contribution to 401(k) - build long-term security with a strong retirement plan.

🍽️ Free team lunch 1x/week - good food, great company, and space to connect.

🏥 Private health insurance – comprehensive cover for you, offering total peace of mind.

👶 Enhanced parental leave – 3 months full pay paternity and 6 months full pay maternity leave, to provide extra flexibility during the moments that matter most.

☀️ 20 days of Annual Leave (+ Public Holidays) - because taking time to rest matters.

📈 Personal development – dedicated support for learning, development, and leveling up over time.

💪 Gympass / Wellhub (subsidized) – for you and up to 3 family members, supporting both physical and mental wellbeing.

💳 Flexible Spending Account (FSA) – set aside pre-tax dollars for eligible healthcare expenses.

🔎 Watch this space, we’re continuing to build this as we grow…

Salary Range 

$120,000 - 240,000 depending on experience 

Seniority will be assessed throughout our interview process 

We value diversity and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, religion, ethnicity, nationality, disability, age, sexual orientation or gender identity. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underrepresented in tech to apply. To help make a change, we sponsor bright women from disadvantaged backgrounds through their university degrees in science and mathematics.

 Duties Description 

The selected candidate will be involved in all aspects of infectious disease serology specimen processing including arbovirus and tick-borne pathogen testing. The selected candidate will also perform serology testing related to certain common vaccine-preventable diseases. Responsibilities will also include the management of specimen entry into the laboratory information management system (CLIMS); performing standard serology assays including, samples for Zika, West Nile Virus, or Chikungunya IgM, capture ELISAs, Luminex assays (Flavivirus microsphere immunoassay, Arbovirus microsphere assay), arbovirus and tickborne pathogen indirect immunofluorescence assays, Lyme disease ELISAs and Western blots; maintain the laboratory’s test results in CLIMS; assist in the development and optimization of in-house serology and molecular assays for infectious agents; evaluation of commercial assays, and special projects utilizing serology assays; prepare standard operating procedures as needed and assist in the preparation of validation packets for the Clinical Laboratory Evaluation Program; supervise new staff as needed and prepare PowerPoint presentations for lab meetings. parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Application Deadline: 30 October 2026

Department: Research

Location: New York

Compensation: $68,000 - $78,000 / year

Description

TL;DR Kharon is seeking a full-time Research Analyst based in NYC or Washington D.C. This role requires in-office attendance 4 days a week.

Responsibilities

Monitoring new sanctions, enforcement actions, and policy activity by regulatory agencies for developments relevant to Kharon’s products.Driving the curation, publication, maintenance, and quality assurance of datasets.Performing data validation and reconciliation to support new products and partnership initiatives.Conducting research on issues in international affairs that impact business risks and identifying relevant data sources.Accurately perform detailed quality assurance of data and developing additional tooling to support these tasks as necessaryWrites original code to assist in automating data analysis, cleanup, and enhancements.

Qualifications

Must have a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Administration, International Relations, Political Science, Security Studies, Regional Studies, History, Sociology, or a related field.Must have at least 1-3 years of professional experience with sanctions, export controls, anti-money laundering or countering the financing of terrorism, and experience researching issues of international security and economy in high-risk jurisdictions.Experience with or willingness to learn SQL.Experience with data analysis, data visualization, and graph databases (Neo4J).Understanding of or willingness to learn web technologies (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, XPath, JSON, etc).

About Kharon

Kharon is a highly disruptive and incredibly innovative organization that navigates risk at the intersection of global security threats + international commerce.

What does that mean? Great question.

Operating at the nexus of global security, Kharon is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take really complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible. From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. Now, we’re experiencing unprecedented growth. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products. Given the significance of our work and the increasing global reliance on our insights, we are looking for a Research Analyst to join us as we work to shape the way businesses perceive and navigate global risks.

The core of this position is dedicated to conducting open-source research on a variety of foreign affairs and national security issues. More specifically, you will be researching, analyzing, and interpreting data as it relates to sanctions, export controls, and criminal/illicit networks. You will be responsible for the diligent pursuit of data as it relates to ever-evolving market demand and our client inquiries. Working collaboratively with the Kharon Research team, you will contribute to the development of new datasets and update existing ones, identifying and utilizing new sources and developing subject matter expertise on the various strategic topics. This includes monitoring new sanctions, enforcement actions, and policy activity by regulatory agencies, as well as conducting research on international affairs that affect business risks. Leveraging your sound analytical approach and research techniques, you will identify data typologies, perform detailed quality assurance, validate and reconcile data, and support new product and partnership initiatives. You’ll also play a key role in curating, publishing, and maintaining datasets, and may write original code to collect primary data across various languages. Cross-functional collaboration is essential as you help build out new research, surface insights from existing content, and report key project metrics to internal stakeholders.

To the right person, this will be the perfect kind of challenge. Our mission is compelling, our product is powerful, and we’re growing at a rate that makes us unstoppable. If you’re looking to be surrounded by people who will inspire you to think and challenge you to grow then look no further. Our team is made up of some of the most visionary and uncompromising individuals you will ever encounter. We don’t take ourselves seriously but we’re serious about the work we do and there is absolutely no slowing us down.

To Keep That Momentum Going, We Do Our Very Best To Make Sure That Each And Every Team Member Is Completely Taken Care Of. We’re Nothing Without Our People And We Strive To Offer a Package That Reflects That. As a Kharon Team Member, You Can Expect

Fully sponsored medical, dental, and vision insurancesFSA program for both medical and dependent careLong term disability401k + Roth with matching and immediate vesting Flexible paid time off + 11 paid holidays

The base salary range at Kharon is set between $68,000-$78,000. Please note that this figure does not necessarily include potential bonuses, commissions, benefits, or equity that may be part of the overall compensation package.

If interested in pursuing this position, please visit www.kharon.com/careers to apply.

Kharon is an equal opportunity employer. Kharon is committed to cultivating and maintaining a workplace that is free from harassment and discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation or identity, neurodiversity, appearances, age, protected veteran status, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

rows.title: Data Scientist

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

PhysicsX is a deep-tech company with roots in numerical physics and Formula One, dedicated to accelerating hardware innovation at the speed of software.

We are building an AI-driven simulation software stack for engineering and manufacturing across advanced industries. By enabling high-fidelity, multi-physics simulation through AI inference across the entire engineering lifecycle, PhysicsX unlocks new levels of optimization and automation in design, manufacturing, and operations — empowering engineers to push the boundaries of possibility. Our customers include leading innovators in Aerospace & Defense, Materials, Energy, Semiconductors, and Automotive.

Who We're Looking For

As a Data Scientist in Delivery, you are a problem solver and builder who is passionate about creating practical solutions that enable customers to make better engineering decisions. You are someone who can grasp advanced engineering concepts across multiple industries, and you excel at working directly with customers (and often side-by-side with them on-site) to transform cutting edge AI models into tools that are useful and used.

You’ve worked on difficult problems that require strong foundations in data driven modelling and deep learning techniques, with hands-on experience in probabilistic methods and predictive modelling. Expertise in python, along with proficiency in libraries like NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, TensorFlow and PyTorch, is essential, with the ability to deploy scalable, production-ready models and data pipelines.

With at least 1 year industry experience (post Masters or PhD) in a commercial, non-research environment, you’re ready to hit the ground running. You’re truly excited about growing your technical expertise and are naturally inclined to take ownership of data science work streams, continuously improving the systems and solutions you work on to ensure they are practical, impactful and meet the evolving needs of our customers.

This Role

In this role, you’ll work closely with our Simulation Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and customers to understand and define the engineering and physics challenges we are solving.

You’ll build the foundations for successful, impactful solutions by:

Pre-processing and analyzing data to prepare it for use in predictive modelling, building the foundation for machine learning algorithms to be developed.Developing and utilizing innovative deep learning models in combination with state-of-the-art optimization methods to predict and control the behaviour of physical systems.Taking full responsibility for the quality, accuracy and impact of your work.Designing, building and testing data pipelines that are reliable, scalable and easily deployable in production environments.Working closely with simulation engineers to ensure seamless integration of data science models with simulations.Contributing to internal R&D and product development, helping to refine models and identify new areas of application.Engaging in open communication and presentation with both technical teams and customers, helping onboard users and co-develop with customers.

You'll also have the opportunity to travel to customer sites in North America, Europe, Asia, Oceania, for an average of 3-4 weeks per quarter, where you'll collaborate closely with customers to build solutions on-site.

As the role evolves, there are exciting opportunities for growth as an individual contributor or a technical lead, especially if you’re driven by taking ownership of more complex projects and leading the direction of future solutions.

Please note, this role is based in Manhattan, NYC, working 2-3 days per week in our office.

Our delivery teams drive innovation to turn AI models into practical solutions - read our blog to learn more about how you’ll contribute to this exciting journey!

What We Offer

Build what actually matters

Help shape an AI-native engineering company at a formative stage, tackling problems that genuinely matter for industry and society. This is work with real-world impact - and something you can be proud to stand behind.

Learn alongside exceptional people

Work with a high-caliber, collaborative team of engineers, scientists, and operators who care deeply about doing great work, and about helping each other get better. We come from diverse backgrounds, but we share a commitment to operating at the highest level and addressing some of the most complex challenges out there. If you’re ambitious, thoughtful, and driven by impact, you’ll feel at home.

Influence over hierarchy

We operate with a flat structure: good ideas win - wherever they come from. Questioning assumptions and challenging the status quo isn’t just welcomed, it’s expected.

Sustainable pace, long-term ambition

Building meaningful technology is a marathon, not a sprint. We believe in balancing focused, ambitious work with a life beyond it. Our hybrid model blends time together in our New York office with work-from-home days, giving you the flexibility to work sustainably while staying connected in person.

And it doesn’t stop there …

🚀 Equity options - share meaningfully in the company you’re helping to build.

💰 5% contribution to 401(k) - build long-term security with a strong retirement plan.

🍽️ Free team lunch 1x/week - good food, great company, and space to connect.

🏥 Private health insurance – comprehensive cover for you, offering total peace of mind.

👶 Enhanced parental leave – 3 months full pay paternity and 6 months full pay maternity leave, to provide extra flexibility during the moments that matter most.

☀️ 20 days of Annual Leave (+ Public Holidays) - because taking time to rest matters.

📈 Personal development – dedicated support for learning, development, and leveling up over time.

💪 Gympass / Wellhub (subsidized) – for you and up to 3 family members, supporting both physical and mental wellbeing.

💳 Flexible Spending Account (FSA) – set aside pre-tax dollars for eligible healthcare expenses.

🔎 Watch this space, we’re continuing to build this as we grow…

Salary Range 

$120,000 - 240,000 depending on experience 

Seniority will be assessed throughout our interview process 

We value diversity and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, religion, ethnicity, nationality, disability, age, sexual orientation or gender identity. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underrepresented in tech to apply. To help make a change, we sponsor bright women from disadvantaged backgrounds through their university degrees in science and mathematics.

We collect diversity and inclusion data solely for the purpose of monitoring the effectiveness of our equal opportunities policies and ensuring compliance with UK employment and equality legislation. This information is confidential, used only in aggregate form, and will not influence the outcome of your application.

rows.title: Assistant Teaching Professor, Japanese Cultural Studies (Non-Tenure-Track)
rows.descriptionText:
The University at Buffalo, The State University of New York, invites applications for a 10 month full-time, non-tenure-track qualified rank teaching position in Japanese Cultural Studies. The appointment will be made in the Asian Studies Program in the College of Arts and Sciences. The position is designed for an educator whose primary professional commitment is undergraduate teaching, curriculum development, and student engagement, and who is interested in making a sustained contribution to this interdisciplinary program.

The position requires teaching up to four interdisciplinary courses per semester in humanities and/or social sciences. The successful candidate will teach established undergraduate courses as well as develop new courses that contribute to the Asian Studies curriculum. A particularly important responsibility will be teaching large-enrollment courses on Japanese anime and popular culture. Other courses include, but are not limited to, a survey of Asian literature and a first-year seminar on Japan Studies. The position is especially well suited to a candidate with demonstrated success teaching Japanese anime, manga, film, media, and other forms of Japanese popular culture to undergraduates, including students from a wide range of disciplinary backgrounds.

The Assistant Teaching Professor will be responsible for sustaining and expanding the program’s undergraduate curriculum through effective, student-centered teaching and the development of new courses that prepare students for professional careers in Asia or with Asian businesses and communities. These courses could address topics such as Japanese media and popular culture, literature, history, urban societies, gender and sexuality, religion, politics, migration, labor, technology, food, and other subjects related to Asian Studies. We welcome candidates who can bring broad knowledge of Japanese culture to an interdisciplinary undergraduate curriculum and who are eager to develop courses that attract and serve students beyond the Asian Studies major.

This is a teaching-focused position with no research or publication obligation. We seek a colleague who regards undergraduate teaching and curriculum development as the central focus of their professional work and who is interested in making a long-term contribution as a teaching-focused faculty member. The three-year term appointment (academic-year obligation) offers an opportunity to develop an important role in the Asian Studies Program through excellent teaching, student mentoring, curricular innovation, and service to the program. The university is especially interested in candidates whose experience in teaching or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to diversity and excellence.

Hiring will be for the spring 2027 semester. Candidates must have conferred a PhD in Asian Studies or a related field by the time of appointment and demonstrate experience and excellence teaching undergraduate courses in Japanese studies, cultural studies, or related fields. Particular consideration shall be given to candidates who have taught anime, popular culture, or related courses. Demonstrated success teaching large-enrollment undergraduate courses is strongly preferred. The candidate’s disciplinary training may be in Japanese Studies, Asian Studies, cultural studies, media studies, literature, history, or another related field.

Review of applications begins September 25, 2026, and will continue until the position is filled.

The Following Documents Are Required

Curriculum vitaeA teaching portfolio which includes: a statement of teaching philosophy; two sample syllabi (including one for a course on Japanese anime); and a sample of course evaluationsCover letter: applicants should describe their experience teaching Japanese cultural studies to undergraduates, their experience with large-enrollment courses where applicable, and the ways in which their teaching and curricular interests would contribute to the Asian Studies Program at the University at Buffalo.

All application materials should be submitted via UB Jobs at this link: https://www.ubjobs.buffalo.edu/postings/64251. Application materials submitted directly to the posting contact will not be acknowledged and cannot be considered.

Learn More

Our benefits, where we prioritize your well-being and success to enhance every aspect of your life.Being a part of the University at Buffalo community.

University at Buffalo is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer and, in keeping with our commitment, welcomes all to apply including veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Working at the Naval Nuclear Laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: Trust, Empowerment, and Collaboration. Our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the Sailors who operate those reactors in the U.S. Navy's submarines and aircraft carrier Fleets. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today!

Job Description

The Engineering Quality organization is seeking a highly motivated Data Scientist who can design, build, and optimize data solutions that support strategic decision making across the organization. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills with an ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights for engineers and management.

Required Combination Of Knowledge And Skill

Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field; or Masters degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field.

Preferred Skills

Proficiency in Python, including experience with ETL tools and libraries (such as pandas, PySpark, or similar).Hands-on experience designing ETL workflows and automating data transformations.Strong knowledge of Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, and dashboard/report development.Ability to translate complex data into intuitive visualizations for leadership and non technical stakeholders.Solid understanding of SQL and relational databases.Strong problem solving skills and attention to detail.

Health, Dental, Vision & Voluntary BenefitsDisability, Life & Accident Insurance401(k) Savings program & Capital Accumulation PlanPersonal & Medical Time OffPaid Parental LeaveFlexible Work SchedulesTuition Assistance for Eligible EmployeesStudent Debt Benefit Personal Time Off Sell ProgramEmployee Assistance Program (EAP)Wellness ProgramVisit us online to view all NNL benefits!

$70,900.00 - $108,500.00 annually

Salary information provided is a general guideline only. Annual salary is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is operated for the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) by Fluor Marine Propulsion, LLC (FMP), a wholly owned subsidiary of Fluor Corporation. Kesselring Site, and Naval Reactors Facility, and at the U.S. Department of Defense-owned Nuclear Power Training Unit-Charleston. FMP employees also have an established presence at numerous shipyards and vendor locations. For nearly 70 years, the Naval Nuclear Laboratory has developed advanced nuclear propulsion technology, provided technical support, and trained world-class nuclear operators to ensure the safe and reliable operation of our nation's submarine and aircraft carrier Fleets. The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is a national asset solely dedicated to the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program. We rely on the dedication and innovation of our nearly 8000 engineers, scientists, technicians, and support personnel.

rows.title: Senior Associate, AI Solutions Architect, Marketing Technology

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

DoorDash’s mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. The Marketing Technology team is responsible for delivering best-in-class tools, data, and processes so teams at DoorDash can effectively acquire new customers, drive retention, and grow new business lines across all our audiences. Our mission is to enable teams to deliver personalized, engaging, and relevant content across all our owned and paid channels. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Analytics teams to translate Marketing’s technology needs into measurable business outcomes for our Growth and Performance Marketing teams.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Associate, AI Solutions Architect to help build and scale AI-powered tools across DoorDash's Marketing teams. You'll work alongside our existing Marketing Technology AI Solutions Architects to identify opportunities where AI can solve real marketing problems, then build, test, and iterate on the solutions that make it happen. This role is grounded in hands-on building: you'll spend your time prototyping, coding, and shipping tools rather than pitching strategy from the sidelines.

This is a great opportunity to grow your technical and strategic skills at the intersection of marketing and AI. You'll get mentorship from a team of builders and exposure to the full lifecycle of AI development from prototype to deployment. This role will report to the Senior Manager, Marketing Technology within the Growth Marketing organization.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

Build and deploy AI-powered tools and automations, such as automated reporting, QA frameworks, and workflow optimizations..Develop MVPs and proof-of-concepts, then iterate based on user feedback within a defined workstream.Contribute to AI training materials, prompt and template libraries, and workshops that help drive AI adoption across marketing teams.Partner with Data Engineering, Analytics, and Product teams to integrate AI solutions into our existing marketing technology stack.Evaluate third-party AI platforms and APIs to identify options that fit our marketing technology stack.Track and report on the impact of the AI solutions you build, including efficiency gains and quality improvements.Help identify and automate time-consuming marketing processes, working across both the AdTech (Performance Media) and Marketing Platforms (Retention) pods.Support the AI Center of Excellence by contributing to frameworks, governance, and best practices for AI adoption across Growth Marketing.

We're excited about you because you have...

2-4 years of experience at the intersection of marketing and technology, with hands-on experience building tools or automations.Technical experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python (can read, modify, and debug code), along with familiarity with APIs, Postgres, ETLs, SQL, and data structures.Experience implementing AI solutions beyond basic chatbot usage: working with AI APIs, MCPs, prompt chains, and low-code/no-code platforms (Zapier, Make, Retool, etc.).Comfort working directly with Product and/or Engineering teams to develop solutions and collaborate on roadmaps.Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical partners.A builder / tinkerer mindset: resourceful and comfortable with ambiguity, able to prioritize your own workstream with input from your manager.Nice to have: experience with marketing technology platforms and tools, or a background in Marketing Ops, Marketing Analytics, or MarTech.

Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash because…

We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do -- on every project, every day. We are learners - We’re not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it’s scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute.We are customer-obsessed - Our mission is to grow and empower local economies. We are committed to our customers, merchants, and dashers and believe in connecting people with possibility.We are all DoorDash - The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights. 

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See Below For Paid Time Off Details

For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$83,000—$122,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Do you excel in both social media marketing and empathetic client interactions?
Are you ready to play a pivotal role in an esteemed legal firm's client journey?
Can you swiftly transition from creating engaging content to managing client intake?
Are you seeking a dynamic role with growth potential in the legal industry?
Final question: When faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?
** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **If you have any questions, please email recruit@crisp.co only.Please do not reach out through our website's contact information (telephone, email, or web chat) or via direct messaging on any social media platform.To Apply: Submit your application by clicking the "Apply" button and applying on the Crisp Recruit page that opens.**RECRUITERS DO NOT CONTACT**
Barket Epstein Kearon Aldea & LoTurco is a prestigious law firm with deep roots in New York's legal landscape. With over two centuries of combined legal experience, our firm is synonymous with success and has established a formidable reputation across practice areas including criminal defense, civil rights, and personal injury. We pride ourselves on our commitment to justice and have been a relentless advocate for our clients in Nassau and Suffolk Counties, Manhattan, and beyond.
Our team comprises distinguished legal professionals, including former judges, prosecutors, and thought leaders in the legal field. We handle high-stakes cases with discretion and professionalism, offering an expansive suite of services from appeals and wrongful convictions to commercial litigation and DWI defense. Our multifaceted approach leverages the diverse expertise within our firm to secure favorable outcomes for our clients.
The Marketing & Intake Coordinator role at Barket Epstein is crucial for enhancing our firm's visibility and client relations. This position marries the creative intrigue of marketing with the empathetic touch needed for effective client intake. By driving engagement through social media and facilitating seamless client interactions, you will be instrumental in supporting our mission to deliver unparalleled legal services. Your impact will resonate in our client satisfaction and the strength of our firm's public presence.
What you’ll do:
Social Media Management: Manage the firm’s social media presence across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and X, including posting, scheduling, monitoring engagement, and supporting paid social campaigns.Content Creation: Develop engaging and relevant content to enhance the firm's online presence and reach.Intake Support: Answer and triage inbound inquiries efficiently, gather key facts, track lead sources, and quickly route qualified callers to the appropriate attorney.Client Interaction: Conduct empathetic interactions to understand client needs and route them to appropriate attorneys.Online Campaign Execution: Implement and monitor paid advertising campaigns under the guidance of the Marketing Director.Data Entry: Maintain accurate records of client interactions and intake notes using Clio.Reporting: Provide regular updates on marketing performance and client outreach success.
What we’re looking for:
Social Media & Paid Media Experience: 2–3 years of experience managing social media platforms, creating content, and supporting paid social advertising or boosted campaigns.Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively engage with clients and team members.Reliability & Punctuality: Consistent attendance, punctuality, and dependability are essential, as this role supports live intake calls and daily onsite marketing execution.Empathy and Professionalism: Ability to handle stressful client situations with care and understanding.Organizational Skills: Detail-oriented with the capacity to manage multiple tasks efficiently.Legal Knowledge: Familiarity with legal terms and processes is preferred but not essential.Availability: Must be available to work full-time onsite in Garden City, New York, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM–5:30 PM, with a 30-minute lunch.Technical Proficiency: Experience with Clio and Microsoft Office 365 for data management and communication.
Why you should work here:
Career Growth: Opportunity to ascend into a Director of Marketing role based on performance.Direct Impact: Be the first point of contact for clients, influencing their journey from the onset.Collaborative Culture: Work closely with a team of renowned legal professionals.Learning Opportunities: Gain exposure to multiple legal disciplines, enhancing personal development.Competitive Compensation: Salary is approximately $65,000, depending on experience and fit.
Additional perks:
Health Insurance: Medical coverage available, with the firm paying the majority of costs depending on plan selection.Retirement Plans: 401(k) with employer match available after eligibility period.Paid Time Off: Three weeks of PTO annually along with all governmental holidays.
Join Barket Epstein Kearon Aldea & LoTurco as a Marketing & Intake Coordinator and elevate your career within a firm that champions justice and client excellence. If you’re a creative, execution-focused marketer with a heart for client care, we want to hear from you. Apply to become a pivotal part of our team today.

rows.title: Marketing Associate

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Marketing is strongest when you can see the customer response firsthand. If you enjoy communication, promotional activity, and understanding what encourages customer action, this role offers practical experience in face-to-face marketing.
Marketing in the Real World
We work with clients across retail, telecommunications, consumer services, and professional services to deliver customer acquisition and sales-focused campaigns. Our programs include business-to-business, live event, and retail campaigns that help clients strengthen visibility and connect with customers.
Your Role on the Front Line
As an Entry-Level Marketing Associate, you will support campaign preparation and direct delivery while developing communication and commercial skills. This is a fully on-site position focused on customer interaction and campaign execution, not remote marketing, social media management, or digital-content creation.
Where Your Day Makes an Impact
• Assist with campaign briefs, schedules, promotional materials, and activity plans.• Support campaigns across retail, events, and B2B environments.• Communicate directly with customers and prospective customers.• Track customer responses, campaign activity, and sales-related outcomes.• Coordinate materials, locations, schedules, and team requirements.• Participate in campaign briefings and performance discussions.
The Value We Bring to You
• Competitive base salary plus performance-based bonuses, offering dependable pay and additional earning potential.• Practical training and ongoing coaching in communication, presentation, and campaign execution.• Regular development reviews with clear feedback.• Travel and campaign opportunities based on business needs.• Team socials, professional networking, and broader industry exposure.
Growing Your Marketing Capability
You will develop skills in customer engagement, campaign execution, reporting, presentation, and commercial awareness. Increased capability can lead to broader campaign or team responsibilities, with potential progression toward Marketing Coordinator, Campaign Manager, or Account Manager roles depending on performance and business requirements.
Bring Your Marketing Skills to New York
Applications are reviewed as received, and selected candidates will be contacted. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome reasonable accommodation requests during recruitment.

rows.title: GTM AI Operations Manager

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
HYPR, the Identity Assurance Company, helps organizations create trust in the identity lifecycle. We are a community of bold thinkers and energetic doers who imagined a brand new approach to identity security and, at the same time, are eliminating a pervasive and persistent 60-year old problem – the password. Since being founded in 2014, the company has grown to be the premium provider of authentication security to marquee brands around the globe and are quickly becoming the recognized leader in Identity Assurance. We are looking for exceptional people with the ambition and the will to positively change the world. If that sounds like you, join us on our mission to create a passwordless world and secure the identity lifecycle.
Your Role and Impact
Are you a hands-on builder who gets energized by turning a manual, clunky process into something that runs itself? Do you thrive at the intersection of AI, automation, and go-to-market execution? We're looking for an AI & Automation Specialist to build the AI-powered tools, agents, and workflows that make our sales and marketing teams faster and sharper — from outreach optimization to campaign automation to internal reporting.
This is not a marketing-operations-as-usual role. You'll have real latitude to identify what's broken or slow across our GTM motion and go build the fix. We need someone who is AI-fluent, not just AI-aware — someone who has actually built things (internal tools, automations, agents, scripts) and is energized by turning a manual, clunky process into something that runs itself.
This is a hybrid role, based out of HYPR's New York City headquarters located conveniently in midtown Manhattan. The role is expected to be available for 3-4 days a week in the office / remote on other days. You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Growth & Marketing Operations and collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps teams across the GTM org.
Key ResponsibilitiesDesign, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and lightweight tools that improve GTM efficiency, using LLM APIs, no-code/low-code automation platforms, and agent-builder tools.Prototype and ship internal AI applications — research/enrichment agents, outreach personalization tools, content or reporting assistants — that GTM teams can actually adopt.Build and optimize AI-assisted workflows for sales outreach, including sequencing, personalization at scale, lead enrichment, and prioritization, in partnership with Sales on our Outreach engagement stack.Own and improve automations within HubSpot, including lifecycle workflows, lead routing/scoring, campaign operations, and data hygiene.Build reusable systems — templates, modules, and workflows — that scale across campaigns and teams, not one-off fixes.Support reporting and attribution by automating data pulls, dashboards, and recurring analysis that currently require manual work.Work directly with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to identify high-friction, high-repetition processes worth automating, and document what you build clearly enough that others can use, maintain, and extend it.Act as an internal resource for "can AI do this?" questions across the GTM org.
Tools You'll Work WithExisting GTM stack: HubSpot (marketing automation, lifecycle workflows, landing pages) and Outreach (sales engagement, sequencing, prospect workflows).AI & automation tooling: LLM platforms (Claude Code, or similar) for building; automation/orchestration platforms like n8n, Zapier, or Make; sales intelligence and enrichment tools like Clay, Apollo, or ZoomInfo.Reporting & data: Excel/Sheets minimum for dashboards and ad hoc analysis; SQL and basic scripting (Python or JavaScript) are a plus.
Requirements 2-4 years of experience in marketing operations, sales operations/RevOps, growth, or a related GTM function.Demonstrated builder instinct — you can point to specific things you've built (an automation, an internal tool, a workflow, a script) and explain the problem it solved.Genuine, hands-on fluency with AI tools — using them to build and automate, not just to draft copy or summarize documents.Comfortable with ambiguity — you can take a vague "this is slow and annoying" problem and turn it into a scoped, shippable fix.Strong documentation instincts and clear communication with non-technical stakeholders.Experience with SalesForce, HubSpot, Outreach, or similar marketing/sales engagement platforms is highly desirable.Basic scripting comfort (Python or JavaScript) is a plus for connecting APIs and debugging integrations.Experience in cybersecurity, identity, or enterprise B2B SaaS GTM is a plus, as is familiarity with agent-builder frameworks or MCP-style tool integrations.
The Benefits of Working with HYPRCompetitive Salary & Equity offer with significant upside as we scaleGreat Medical/Dental/Vision coverage, as well as FSA/HSA, 401k available and moreGenerous equipment budget and customized workstation. You will have what you need to be successfulLong-term stability within a high-growth sector within identity access automationA mission driven culture. At HYPR you will never be spinning your wheels on tasks that won't make an impact. Everything we develop is cutting edge and vital to the success and security of our clients
Note:This job is hybrid with 3-4 days onsite at our NY Corporate HQ.HYPR is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
OTE: $95,000 - $130,000
Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of our total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at HYPR. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including location, qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other HYPRions. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at HYPR to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.
As the premium provider of authentication security, HYPR is committed to preventing identity fraud by safely and accurately verifying the identities of our employees. Accordingly, all new employees are required to participate in an automated identity verification process, which includes document verification, location detection, and facial recognition, on their first day of employment with the Company. To learn more about this identity verification process, please contact peopleops@hypr.com.
HYPR is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic under federal, state or local law.
Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state and/or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on HYPR. Please inform peopleops@hypr.com if you need assistance completing HYPR's application process.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

MSX has been a trusted partner to leading vehicle manufacturers, their retailers, and mobility organizations globally for more than 30 years. Our unwavering commitment is to help our clients transform their businesses and effectively manage operations in the areas of: Sales Performance; Repair Optimization and Compliance; Parts and Accessories Sales Performance; and Consumer Engagement. With our global teams, industry expertise, and the power of technology, we design and deliver tailored, sustainable, and innovative solutions and services that help our clients optimize their operations and captivate their customers.

Job Description

As an Amplify Focus Audience Strategist, you will act as an accountability partner in shaping dealers’ engagement with the Hispanic community. Your primary responsibility will be the development and implementation of integrated marketing initiatives that effectively resonate with Hispanic consumers. Key objectives will be driving vehicle sales and increasing brand loyalty. This position requires marketing expertise, preferably within the automotive industry, as well as a deep understanding of Hispanic culture, values, and consumer behavior. Knowledge of other multicultural markets, preferably African American and Asian markets, is also desired. In this role, you will collaborate with client's dealerships to help them understand consumer demographics and localities to create targeted advertising. You will act as a liaison to the leadership team, ensuring they understand the benefits of their investment in multicultural marketing.

Qualifications

Fluent Spanish speakerExperience working with a large Dealer group and/or dealership personnel at all levels including Dealer Principal/General Manager, Sales Manager, Sales Consultant and F&IKnowledge and understanding of various dealership processes and environmentsAbility to set clear, measurable goals and maintain dealer accountability through regular progress trackingStrong knowledge of digital marketing tools, platforms, and analyticsExcellent communication and relationship-building skillsProven track record of success in multicultural marketing- Hispanic a must, African American and Asian Preferred. Marketing/advertising media budget planningProficient with Excel (pivot and data interpretation) and Power PointMinimum 2 years' experience in digital marketing and business development in the automotive industry. Automotive experience strongly preferred. Bachelor's degree required

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team: 

The Marketing team at Agoda is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale, measurable marketing programs designed to improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers. The team combines a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists and data scientists, collectively building a team that thrives on data, creative ideas and technology. . The Marketing leadership fosters a great learning environment, providing the opportunity to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a diverse variety of backgrounds from across the globe.

Due to continued expansion, there are multiple analyst roles within the marketing team across different marketing channels. While the scope will vary depending on these channels, here are some examples: 

Experimentation and optimizing campaign performance: Experiment with ads/campaign structures and bidding& pricing strategies on partners such as Google, Bing, Tripadvisor, Trivago and other search engines. Adapt to new product features and roll out changes from successful tests.Modeling: Analyze vast amounts of data generated by experiments, develop predictive models using data science techniques (eg. understanding impact on bookings from large scale TV campaigns or demand elasticity from pricing optimization) and liaise with product teams on implementation roadmapReporting, analysis and insights: Building dashboards to track performance, derive insights, understand growth levers and communicate recommendations via presentations to stakeholders

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

Tableau, Power BIAbility to move fast and be efficient, making decisions on objective evidence rather than subjective gut feelInnate desire to take ownership, make an impact and influence outcomesExcellent organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to work independently

Experience in digital marketing or ecommerceExperience with A/B testing and other testing metricsStrong presentation and negotiation skillsSkills that foster collaboration and team spirit

rows.title: VIE - Data Analyst (H/F) - New York

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
CONTEXTE ET MISSION

Dans le cadre de l'expansion de sa Data Platform cloud, Hermès engage la transformation de son patrimoine data aux États-Unis. Vous rejoignez cette initiative à un moment charnière : celui où les fondations analytiques se construisent. Votre mission est de garantir que les données soient fiables, documentées et exploitables .

Le ou la VIE sera un interlocuteur clé entre les équipes métier US et l'équipe Analytics & AI de HDTI, contribuant à la fois à la fiabilisation des données et à leur valorisation via Power BI. Vous formerez également un binôme opérationnel avec le ou la VIE Data Engineer présent(e) sur le même programme : l'un construit les fondations, l'autre les valorise.

Ce poste requiert avant tout une forte compréhension fonctionnelle des données : savoir analyser un jeu de données, en comprendre le sens métier, identifier les anomalies et documenter avec rigueur. La maîtrise technique est un levier, la capacité d'assimilation des processus fonctionnels est indispensable.

MISSIONS PRINCIPALES

Relais standards & bonnes pratiques

 Agir en tant que relais local des standards, méthodologies et bonnes pratiques définis en matière d'analyse de données et de développement BI et en garantir l’adoption et le respect au sein de l'équipe US.

Exploration & rétro-documentation de l'existant

 Établir le diagnostic data de l'existant US. Produire des profils de données (data profiling) et documenter les anomalies et zones de risque, constituant ainsi la cartographie de référence du patrimoine data avant migration. Identifier les règles métier implicites dans les données existantes pour alimenter la modélisation cible. Construire la mémoire analytique du projet.

Analyse de qualité & détection des écarts (Gap Analysis)

 Comparer les données sources (plateforme locale) aux nouveaux data models Snowflake, périmètre, définitions, et produire une analyse d'écarts actionnables pour les équipes d'ingénierie. Formaliser les écarts constatés et proposer des règles de réconciliation ou de transformation. Suivre les indicateurs de qualité data tout au long du processus de migration, en assurant une visibilité continue sur l'état de fiabilité des données.

Développement de dashboards & reporting

 Livrer les premiers reportings opérationnels post-migration aux équipes métier US, avec un impact visible dès les premières semaines : vous traduisez la donnée en décision. Développer des dashboards Power BI sur le semantic layer de la nouvelle Data Platform, en respectant les standards de certification Hermès. Contribuer à l'adoption de la nouvelle plateforme par les équipes métier en rendant les données accessibles, lisibles et fiables.

Collaboration & documentation

 Travailler en lien étroit avec le Data Engineer VIE et les équipes Analytics & AI Paris pour assurer la cohérence des livrables. Documenter systématiquement les analyses, hypothèses et conclusions dans les outils de référence de l'équipe. Contribuer aux ateliers de qualification métier pour valider les règles de gestion et les définitions de données.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

 Diplôme Bac+4/5 en data, statistiques, économétrie, mathématiques appliquées ou école de commerce avec spécialisation data ou équivalent Première expérience (stage, alternance ou poste junior) en analyse de données ou BI dans un environnement structuré SQL avancé Power BI Capacité à réaliser du data profiling et à interpréter des indicateurs de qualité de données La connaissance de Snowflake ou d'un cloud data warehouse est un plus La maîtrise de Python ou R pour l'analyse exploratoire est appréciée Autonomie, rigueur, sens analytique, curiosité Aisance en anglais professionnel (écrit et oral) indispensable ; le français est un atout

CE QUE VOUS Y TROUVEREZ

 Une mission à fort enjeu sur un programme de transformation data stratégique . Un rôle de passerelle entre les équipes IT & métier US et les équipes data centrales, avec une visibilité forte dès le départ. Basé(e) aux États-Unis, vous évoluez dans un environnement à culture entrepreneuriale forte, avec une autonomie réelle et une exposition directe aux équipes métier locales dès le premier mois. Les VIE qui réussissent cette mission ont vocation à rejoindre les équipes Analytics & AI d'HDTI à l'issue de leur contrat, en France ou à l'international. Ce poste est un tremplin, pas une parenthèse.

Merci de vérifier que vous remplissez les conditions du V.I.E avant de postuler à l’offre d’emploi.

Vous pouvez être volontaire si vous remplissez les 5 conditions suivantes :

Avoir entre 18 et 28 ans à la date de l'inscription. Le départ en mission s'effectue au plus tard le jour du 29e anniversaire. Au-delà, aucune dérogation n'est accordée.

Être français ou ressortissant d'un pays de l'Espace économique européen

Être en règle avec les obligations de service national (journée de défense et de citoyenneté)

Jouir de vos droits civiques (droit de vote et casier judiciaire vierge)

Remplir les conditions d'aptitude physique exigées pour les personnes exerçant des activités de même nature dans l'organisme d'accueil

Plus de détail sur le lien suivant : https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F10040

Employeur responsable, Hermès s'engage en faveur de l'éthique, de la diversité et de l'inclusion.

Rejoignez l'aventure humaine Hermès et construisez votre parcours cousu main.

"Créateur, artisan et marchand d’objets de haute qualité, Hermès est, depuis 1837, une maison française, familiale et indépendante qui emploie près de 25 185 collaborateurs dans le monde. Animé par un esprit d’entreprendre continu et une exigence constante, Hermès cultive la liberté et l’autonomie de chacun grâce à un management responsable. L’entreprise perpétue la transmission de savoir-faire d’exception par un ancrage territorial fort dans le respect des hommes et de la nature – source de matières d’exception. Seize métiers artisanaux irriguent la créativité de la maison dont les collections rayonnent dans près 300 magasins dans le monde."
