rows.descriptionText:
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services.

About Parametric

Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings. Learn more here: https://www.parametricportfolio.com/about

This role is part of Parametric’ s hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.

Office Locations: Seattle, Boston, Minneapolis and Alpharetta, GA

Excellent opportunity for recent or soon to be 2027 graduates! Office Locations: Seattle, Boston, Minneapolis, Alpharetta

SUMMER COHORT STARTS - July 2027

About The Operations Analyst Program

The Operations Analyst Program is an early-career development opportunity for driven recent and soon-to-be graduates who want to launch a career at the intersection of investment management, operations, data, and technology. Analysts use analytical, technical, and collaborative skills to help deliver operational excellence, solve business challenges, and improve outcomes for clients.

As investment operations evolve through data, automation, and AI, analysts gain hands-on experience supporting business-critical investment processes while helping identify opportunities to improve how work gets done. Through ownership of operational processes and exposure to continuous improvement, data analytics, automation, workflow design, and AI, analysts strengthen controls, improve decision-making, and contribute to scalable solutions that support clients and business growth.

Over three weeks, Analysts begin as a cohort with an immersion in Parametric's investment strategies, operating model, and Operations organization. Following onboarding, analysts join teams supporting Market, Client, or Control functions, where they develop domain expertise, learn business-critical workflows, and build an end-to-end understanding of how Operations supports clients, portfolios, risk management, and business growth.

Operations teams are responsible for the execution, oversight, servicing, and control activities that support the investment lifecycle. Analysts work closely with teammates and stakeholders across the organization to execute processes accurately, resolve operational challenges, improve controls, and deliver exceptional client outcomes.

In addition to their core team responsibilities, analysts may collaborate with specialized teams within Operations focused on process transformation, analytics, workflow modernization, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. Partnering with subject matter experts across Market, Client, and Control functions to identify opportunities, redesign processes, and implement scalable improvements that enhance operational effectiveness. Through this partnership, analysts may gain exposure to transformation initiatives while continuing to build deep operational expertise.

The program is designed for people who are curious about how businesses operate, motivated to improve processes, and eager to continue learning. As business needs evolve, analysts may gain exposure to different Operations functions, participate in cross-functional initiatives, or contribute to transformation efforts, broadening their knowledge, experience, and skill sets.

What You'll Do And Learn

Learn Parametric's investment strategies, operating model, and business-critical Operations workflows, and understand how Market, Client, and Control functions support clients, portfolios, risk management, and business growth.Learn and execute business-critical investment operations workflows accurately and on time. Responsibilities may include activities such as cash and position reconciliation, trade lifecycle support, client servicing, corporate actions, account onboarding and maintenance, contracts, oversight activities, and billing, depending on team assignment.Develop an end-to-end understanding of assigned processes, including activities, decisions, systems, data flows, controls, handoffs, and upstream and downstream dependencies.Investigate exceptions, breaks, recurring operational issues, and client-impacting events using structured problem-solving and data analysis. Identify root causes, assess impacts, and recommend sustainable solutions.Partner with Operations teams, portfolio managers, traders, sales, product management, technology teams, external providers, and other stakeholders to resolve issues, improve handoffs, and support business priorities.Perform quality control and verification activities, maintain accurate records and documentation, and help ensure operational processes meet established policies, procedures, and control standards.Analyze operational and investment data to identify patterns, anomalies, trends, bottlenecks, and emerging risks. Build reports, dashboards, or analytical tools that turn data into actionable insights and improvement opportunities.Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, or redesign workflows and contribute to process mapping, requirements gathering, testing, implementation, and adoption activities.Collaborate with Automation, Reinvention & Collaboration (ARC) and other partners on process-improvement initiatives, workflow modernization efforts, analytics projects, automation solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities.Use or learn tools such as Excel, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Python, workflow automation platforms, process-modeling tools, and approved AI solutions, as appropriate to the assignment.Contribute to operational excellence, analytics, automation, or process-improvement initiatives and present findings, recommendations, and outcomes to team members and business partners.

What You'll Bring

Associate or bachelor's degree completed by the program start date. Relevant fields may include industrial, process, or systems engineering; operations research; supply chain; data science or analytics; computer science; information systems; mathematics; statistics; finance; accounting; economics; or a related analytical, business, or technical field. Candidates from other majors with relevant quantitative, technical, or process-improvement experience are also encouraged to apply.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down ambiguous issues, work with data, identify root causes, and form well-supported conclusions.A systems-thinking and continuous-improvement mindset, including curiosity about how people, processes, data, controls, and technology interact end to end and a desire to make work simpler, more accurate, efficient, scalable, and controlled.High attention to detail and a commitment to quality, sound judgment, risk awareness, responsible use of data and technology, and positive client outcomes.Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with teammates and stakeholders and communicate complex ideas in a clear and organized manner.Ownership, learning agility, adaptability, and the ability to prioritize effectively in a collaborative, deadline-driven environment.Experience using spreadsheets to organize and analyze information and communicate findings, or the ability to learn quickly.Strong interest in building a career at the intersection of investment management, operations, process improvement, data, and technology.Ability to work full-time (40 hours per week) by the program start date.

Preferred Qualifications

Coursework, internships, or project experience involving process mapping, continuous improvement, business analysis, data analysis, automation, workflow design, programming, analytics, or AI.Exposure to one or more tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Python, workflow automation platforms, process-modeling tools, version control platforms, or similar technologies.Familiarity with financial markets, investment management, or business operations. Prior investment operations experience is not required.Experience contributing to a cross-functional project, presenting recommendations, developing a prototype, or helping others adopt a new process, workflow, or technology solution.

Salary & Benefits: Set at $28.85 per hour ($60,000 annualized base), eligible annual bonus and for overtime. Cohort starts July, 2027!

rows.title: Coordinator, Marketing and Communications
rows.descriptionText:
Description

Position Title:  Coordinator, Marketing and Communications

 Position Classification:  Regular; Nonexempt; Full-Time; 40 hours/Week 

Reports to: Managing Director, Marketing and Communications

Location:  Employees in this role can work from our Boston, MA office, remotely within the U.S. or hybrid of these two options (less than 5% domestic and/or international travel)

 Please note that we do not sponsor U.S. work authorization for this role.Candidates must be able to legally work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship. 

Position Overview

The goal of the Marketing and Communications team is to grow support for PIH’s work and mission through dissemination of inspiring stories with the right message, to the right audience, utilizing channels efficiently. The Coordinator works closely with the leadership of the team to support, coordinate, and maintain key initiatives. The ideal candidate is a creative, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

Responsibilities

Project Coordination and Support (70%)

 Assist the MarComms Leadership in triaging incoming project requests and keeping existing project on track by utilizing Asana and other project management tools to build and monitor project tasks and provide regular updates and status reports.  Manage the day-to-day follow up with various PIH teams to secure approvals and delivery of required content asset.  Partner with Leadership to prepare comprehensive campaign/project wrap-up presentations to deliver results and key learnings.  Support with merchandise requests and order fulfillment. Maintain the PIH Merch Portal with a standard stock of available items. 

Communications (15%) 

 Maintain the MarComm’s SharePoint pages and global communications resource library. Partner with the Managing Director to disseminate information across the organization.  Using PIH’s content management system (CMS), coordinate regular editorial updates and implementation of campaign landing pages to ensure the website is up-to-date and visitors are engaged.  Assist with creation compelling PowerPoint/Canva presentations. 

 Administration (15%) 

Organize team meeting schedules and agendas. Capture notes and action items and spearhead follow up, as needed.Support and track PIH’s trademark and licensing agreements, contract reviews, invoice payments, credit card reconciliations, and reimbursements.Oversee and support travel logistics for team members as needed for team activities.

Qualifications

 Required Experience, Education, Licenses or Certifications 

 Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, or relevant field preferred  1-2years’ experience hands-on experience with coordination support, or relevant experience 

Skills

 Required: 

 Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint  Familiarity with Asana  Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and tight deadlines, while maintaining attention to detail and quality.  Excellent writing and communication skills.  Exemplary interpersonal skills; ability to collaborate effectively with culturally diverse staff across departments and country. 

Preferred

 Experience with Canva 

 Core Values and Competencies 

 Demonstrates the organization’s core values of: Commitment, Humility, Integrity and Pragmatic Solidarity/Accompaniment  Accountability – Able to accept responsibility for one's actions, outcomes, and those of their team.  Achieving results – Able to set realistic goals, put plans into action, monitor progress, evaluate outcomes, and apply lessons learned.  Adaptability – Able to adapt to change, to balance multiple demands, consider new approaches, and persist towards solutions in changing circumstances.  Teamwork – Able to work well with others to achieve common goals. Exemplary interpersonal skills; ability to collaborate effectively with staff across departments and countries. 

 This vacancy may be used to fill similar positions. 

 Organizational Profile 

Partners In Health (PIH) is a non-profit, global health organization that fights social injustice by bringing the benefits of modern medical science first and foremost to the most vulnerable communities around the world. PIH focuses on those who would not otherwise have access to quality health care. PIH partners with the world’s leading academic institutions to create rigorous evidence that shapes more sound and all-inclusive global health policies. PIH also supports local governments’ efforts to build capacity and strengthen national health systems.

As of today, PIH runs programs in 11 countries (Haiti, Kazakhstan, Lesotho, Liberia, Malawi, Mexico, Navajo Nation, Peru, Rwanda, Sierra Leone, United States), where it provides direct care to millions of patients, through public facilities and community engagement.

Partners In Health (PIH) is committed to the fundamental principle of equal opportunity and equal treatment for every prospective and current employee. rows.title: Digital Marketing Specialist, Affiliate
rows.descriptionText:
TJX Companies

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description

This is a HYBRID role, with a weekly in-person requirement in Framingham, MA.

Role Description

As the Affiliate Digital Marketing Specialist, you will support the strategy, execution, optimization, and reporting of Affiliate marketing programs across our .com brands. Working closely with internal teams, agency partners, publishers, and creators, you will help drive customer acquisition, engagement, traffic, and revenue while identifying opportunities to improve performance and grow the channel.

Key Responsibilities

Build Media and Digital Expertise Serve as an Affiliate expert, providing support on program development, structure, maintenance, and key reporting metrics. Monitor Affiliate channel trends and the competitive landscape to identify optimization opportunities and cost per acquisition strategies that drive campaign performance and growth. Share insights, best practices and recommendations with internal teams through ongoing knowledge sharing and education. Collaboration and Relationships Work collaboratively with internal and external partners to ensure programs are executed flawlessly and drive results. Establish relationships and collaborate effectively across internal stakeholder teams (Digital Planning, Brand Marketing, Measurement, Creative, Site Experience/Merch Planning) to deliver high-quality work. Collaborate with In-House buying team (paid search, paid social, online video) on cross-channel strategy and execution. Establish strong working relationships with Affiliate agency partners, publishers, and creator partners. Drive Results (Plan, Execute, Measure)  Support the Affiliate Marketing Manager and team with strategy development, planning, execution, optimization, and measurement of the Affiliate channel. Act as an Affiliate channel best practice advisor, proactively identifying opportunities and providing POVs and recommendations to optimize channel performance. Lead the development of the promotional offer and e-blast content schedule and newsletters, and support larger strategies and seasonal project plans.  Support the day-to-day program execution, including content development, optimizations, creative/asset needs, and invoice and budget management.  Develop creative briefs, communicate creative specifications and deadlines, and deliver creative asset guidelines and trafficking information to Brand Marketing and Creative teams. Analyze program performance across publisher, promotional, content, and creator segments to identify growth opportunities. Develop and maintain recurring performance reporting and dashboards highlighting KPIs, trends, insights, and optimization recommendations, while supporting attribution and broader measurement efforts. 

What We're Looking For

1-3 years of experience in Affiliate marketing, digital marketing, media, eCommerce or performance marketing Affiliate channel execution experience is preferred Related experience with a media agency, vendor or client-side media/marketing General knowledge of media planning (digital eCommerce channels is a plus) Experience working with digital analytics and reporting platforms (e.g., Adobe Analytics) Team player who is collaborative and an effective communicator Ability to interpret and analyze data and present it to a variety of stakeholders Results driven, detail oriented, and self-motivated Excellent project management skills Experience with Microsoft Office suite is required, particularly Excel Knowledge or familiarity with the social influencer marketing landscape is a plus Experience executing and measuring various forms of digital media is a plus Retail experience is a plus Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, communications or related field 

Benefits include Associate discount; 401(k) match; medical/dental/vision; HSA; health care FSA; life insurance; short/long-term disability; paid holidays/vacation /sick/bereavement/parental leave; EAP; incentive programs for management; auto/home insurance discounts; tuition reimbursement; scholarship program; adoption/surrogacy assistance; smoking cessation; child care/cell phone discounts; pet/legal insurance; credit union; referral bonuses. All benefits are subject to applicable plan or program terms (including eligibility terms) and may change from time to time. Contact your TJX representative for more information.

In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. TJX also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law.

rows.title: Senior Analyst, GenAI Marketing (Bangkok Based, Relocation Provided)
rows.descriptionText:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

Agoda’s Marketing organization is highly data-driven and uses experimentation, technology and analytics to create measurable value across markets and channels.

Marketing has successfully developed a strong bottom-up culture of AI adoption, with teams using GenAI to improve analysis, reporting, campaign operations, content development and other recurring workflows. We are now establishing a small Marketing AI Products team to take the next step: turning the most valuable cross-team opportunities into reliable, scalable and widely adopted products.

The team will focus on a small number of high-impact “lighthouse” initiatives while Marketing sub-teams continue to develop and own their everyday, team-specific AI use cases. Initial opportunity areas include experiment analysis, business reporting and monitoring, campaign operations, creative workflows and SEO/AEO content.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on analyst and product builder who can operate at the intersection of Marketing, data, product development and generative AI.

You will identify high-value workflows, translate business problems into clear product requirements, develop and evaluate solutions, and work with developers and Marketing teams to take successful ideas from prototype through deployment and adoption.

This is not a traditional reporting role or a purely coordination-focused product role. You will be expected to work directly with data and AI tools, understand users’ workflows in detail and take ownership of delivering measurable outcomes.

In This Role, You’ll Get To

Identify recurring Marketing workflows where AI can materially improve speed, quality, scalability or decision-making.Quantify each opportunity by establishing its current effort, pain points, user base and potential business value.Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user journeys, milestones and measurable success criteria.Build and test prototypes using SQL, Python, automation tools and generative AI technologies.Partner with developers, Technology teams and sponsoring Marketing teams to turn successful prototypes into reliable products.Design evaluation frameworks covering output accuracy, reliability, usability, safety and appropriate human review.Lead user research, pilots and iterative testing with analysts, channel specialists and other target users.Drive rollout, documentation, training and adoption in partnership with sponsoring teams.Measure hours saved, improvements in turnaround time and quality, adoption levels and downstream business impact.Maintain a prioritized portfolio of Marketing AI opportunities and communicate progress, learnings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.Monitor developments in AI capabilities and identify when existing products should be improved, expanded or retired.Contribute reusable tools, standards and playbooks that help Marketing teams build better AI-enabled workflows independently.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

4–6 years of relevant experience in analytics, product analytics, marketing strategy, business operations, consulting, product management or a related field.Bachelor’s degree or higher in a quantitative, technical or business discipline such as computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, economics or finance.Strong SQL skills and experience working independently with large or complex datasets.Hands-on experience with Python, scripting, workflow automation or similar technical tools.Experience defining hypotheses, designing experiments and translating results into actionable business recommendations.Strong product thinking, including the ability to understand user problems, define requirements and make pragmatic scope and prioritization decisions.Ability to break ambiguous problems into structured workstreams and move rapidly from analysis to execution.Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.Experience influencing stakeholders and communicating complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, dependable solutions.Ability to collaborate effectively across Marketing, Analytics, Product and Technology teams.Experience building GenAI applications, AI agents or automated analytical workflows.Familiarity with prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, APIs, model evaluation and human-in-the-loop workflows.Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Codex, Cursor, Claude Code or Google AI Studio.

It’s Great if You Have

Experience writing product requirements, managing a product backlog or taking an internal product from prototype to scaled adoption.Knowledge of digital marketing, performance marketing, experimentation, SEO/AEO, campaign operations or personalization.Experience establishing quality-assurance and monitoring processes for data or AI products.Experience deploying internal tools or working closely with software engineers on production systems.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will help launch and scale a small number of cross-Marketing AI products with clear adoption and value metrics. These products should deliver measurable improvements in employee productivity, output quality or business outcomes—and have clearly defined ownership, documentation, quality controls and maintenance plans.

rows.title: Financial Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Position Description:We are looking for an Operations Analyst to support daily reconciliations and data analysis within a Middle Office environment. This role is well-suited for someone with an operations background who is comfortable executing repeatable processes, working with data, and supporting senior team members.
Key Responsibilities:- Perform daily and ad-hoc operational reconciliations between internal systems and external data sources- Pull and validate data from custodians, vendors, and external websites- Update and maintain Excel-based reconciliation and control files- Identify, investigate, and document breaks and exceptions, escalating as appropriate- Support start-of-day and end-of-day operational control processes- Assist senior operations staff with reporting, data clean-up, and process support
Requirements:- 1-3 years of experience in operations, middle office, reconciliations, or similar support roles- Exposure to asset management, banking operations, or financial services environments- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, lookups, formulas)- Strong data analysis skills, experience working with high-volume operational data with the ability to work across diverse datasets and translate varied inputs into standardized outputs- Ability to synthesize key concepts and findings into clear, well-organized summaries
Nice to Have:- Experience with DUCO or other reconciliation platforms- Experience with Bloomberg- Experience with financial concepts like portfolio accounting and valuation, security master, corporate actions

rows.title: Analyst, Pricing (Bangkok Based, relocation provided)
rows.descriptionText:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Opportunity

Within Booking Holdings, an enhanced and more connected B2B business is being built within Booking Holdings consolidating the businesses of Booking.com, Priceline and Agoda into a single global division (“New B2B Business”)

About The Role

In this role, you will shape pricing and commercial strategies for partner opportunities, advise stakeholders on trade-offs, and drive value through execution and experimentation. You will work across Commercial, Product, Data Science, Marketing, and partner-facing teams, often in situations where alignment matters as much as the analysis itself.

What You'll Do

Own and evolve pricing strategies and optimization for B2B partner channels.Build and lead experimentation roadmaps, including test design, success measures, decision frameworks, and post-test actions.Evaluate pricing and growth opportunities through structured analysis, including elasticity, incrementality, cannibalization, and scenario modeling where relevant.Act as a trusted advisor to senior internal and external stakeholders; surface trade-offs, align priorities, and drive decisions to closure; Coordinate cross-functional execution across Commercial, Product, Data Science, Marketing, and operations teams.Turn complex findings into concise executive narratives, recommendations, and decision-ready materials; Manage strategic partner and vendor interactions when required, including presentations, working sessions, and follow-ups.

What You'll Bring

Experience applying quantitative analysis to commercial decisions in technology, e-commerce, travel, management consulting, internal strategy, or pricing.Strong business judgment and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous questions, evaluate trade-offs, and recommend a path forward.Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to influence without authority and build alignment across functions, seniority levels, and geographies.Fluency with data and analytical tools, including advanced SQL; experience with visualization tools such as Tableau or an equivalent platform.Practical experience designing or interpreting controlled experiments and translating results into decisions.A high-ownership, bias-for-action mindset and comfort operating in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment.A bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

It's a plus if you have

A background in using quantitative data for decision making within tech, ecommerce , management consulting, internal strategy, or pricing initiativesExperience building decision frameworks or analytical tools that are used repeatedly in live business decisions.Working knowledge of Python or R for modeling and scalable analysis.

What Success Looks Like

Become a trusted advisor whose recommendations are clear, rigorous, and commercially grounded.Turn pricing insights and experiments into decisions and coordinated execution.Build alignment across stakeholders, functions, and markets.Develop repeatable approaches that can scale across partners.

rows.title: Parametric - Operations Analyst Cohort, Summer 2027 Grads
rows.descriptionText:
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services.

About Parametric

Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings. Learn more here: https://www.parametricportfolio.com/about

This role is part of Parametric’ s hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.

Office Locations: Seattle, Boston, Minneapolis and Alpharetta, GA

Excellent opportunity for recent or soon to be 2027 graduates! Office Locations: Seattle, Boston, Minneapolis, Alpharetta

SUMMER COHORT STARTS - July 2027

About The Operations Analyst Program

The Operations Analyst Program is an early-career development opportunity for driven recent and soon-to-be graduates who want to launch a career at the intersection of investment management, operations, data, and technology. Analysts use analytical, technical, and collaborative skills to help deliver operational excellence, solve business challenges, and improve outcomes for clients.

As investment operations evolve through data, automation, and AI, analysts gain hands-on experience supporting business-critical investment processes while helping identify opportunities to improve how work gets done. Through ownership of operational processes and exposure to continuous improvement, data analytics, automation, workflow design, and AI, analysts strengthen controls, improve decision-making, and contribute to scalable solutions that support clients and business growth.

Over three weeks, Analysts begin as a cohort with an immersion in Parametric's investment strategies, operating model, and Operations organization. Following onboarding, analysts join teams supporting Market, Client, or Control functions, where they develop domain expertise, learn business-critical workflows, and build an end-to-end understanding of how Operations supports clients, portfolios, risk management, and business growth.

Operations teams are responsible for the execution, oversight, servicing, and control activities that support the investment lifecycle. Analysts work closely with teammates and stakeholders across the organization to execute processes accurately, resolve operational challenges, improve controls, and deliver exceptional client outcomes.

In addition to their core team responsibilities, analysts may collaborate with specialized teams within Operations focused on process transformation, analytics, workflow modernization, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. Partnering with subject matter experts across Market, Client, and Control functions to identify opportunities, redesign processes, and implement scalable improvements that enhance operational effectiveness. Through this partnership, analysts may gain exposure to transformation initiatives while continuing to build deep operational expertise.

The program is designed for people who are curious about how businesses operate, motivated to improve processes, and eager to continue learning. As business needs evolve, analysts may gain exposure to different Operations functions, participate in cross-functional initiatives, or contribute to transformation efforts, broadening their knowledge, experience, and skill sets.

What You'll Do And Learn

Learn Parametric's investment strategies, operating model, and business-critical Operations workflows, and understand how Market, Client, and Control functions support clients, portfolios, risk management, and business growth.Learn and execute business-critical investment operations workflows accurately and on time. Responsibilities may include activities such as cash and position reconciliation, trade lifecycle support, client servicing, corporate actions, account onboarding and maintenance, contracts, oversight activities, and billing, depending on team assignment.Develop an end-to-end understanding of assigned processes, including activities, decisions, systems, data flows, controls, handoffs, and upstream and downstream dependencies.Investigate exceptions, breaks, recurring operational issues, and client-impacting events using structured problem-solving and data analysis. Identify root causes, assess impacts, and recommend sustainable solutions.Partner with Operations teams, portfolio managers, traders, sales, product management, technology teams, external providers, and other stakeholders to resolve issues, improve handoffs, and support business priorities.Perform quality control and verification activities, maintain accurate records and documentation, and help ensure operational processes meet established policies, procedures, and control standards.Analyze operational and investment data to identify patterns, anomalies, trends, bottlenecks, and emerging risks. Build reports, dashboards, or analytical tools that turn data into actionable insights and improvement opportunities.Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, or redesign workflows and contribute to process mapping, requirements gathering, testing, implementation, and adoption activities.Collaborate with Automation, Reinvention & Collaboration (ARC) and other partners on process-improvement initiatives, workflow modernization efforts, analytics projects, automation solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities.Use or learn tools such as Excel, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Python, workflow automation platforms, process-modeling tools, and approved AI solutions, as appropriate to the assignment.Contribute to operational excellence, analytics, automation, or process-improvement initiatives and present findings, recommendations, and outcomes to team members and business partners.

What You'll Bring

Associate or bachelor's degree completed by the program start date. Relevant fields may include industrial, process, or systems engineering; operations research; supply chain; data science or analytics; computer science; information systems; mathematics; statistics; finance; accounting; economics; or a related analytical, business, or technical field. Candidates from other majors with relevant quantitative, technical, or process-improvement experience are also encouraged to apply.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down ambiguous issues, work with data, identify root causes, and form well-supported conclusions.A systems-thinking and continuous-improvement mindset, including curiosity about how people, processes, data, controls, and technology interact end to end and a desire to make work simpler, more accurate, efficient, scalable, and controlled.High attention to detail and a commitment to quality, sound judgment, risk awareness, responsible use of data and technology, and positive client outcomes.Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with teammates and stakeholders and communicate complex ideas in a clear and organized manner.Ownership, learning agility, adaptability, and the ability to prioritize effectively in a collaborative, deadline-driven environment.Experience using spreadsheets to organize and analyze information and communicate findings, or the ability to learn quickly.Strong interest in building a career at the intersection of investment management, operations, process improvement, data, and technology.Ability to work full-time (40 hours per week) by the program start date.

Preferred Qualifications

Coursework, internships, or project experience involving process mapping, continuous improvement, business analysis, data analysis, automation, workflow design, programming, analytics, or AI.Exposure to one or more tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Python, workflow automation platforms, process-modeling tools, version control platforms, or similar technologies.Familiarity with financial markets, investment management, or business operations. Prior investment operations experience is not required.Experience contributing to a cross-functional project, presenting recommendations, developing a prototype, or helping others adopt a new process, workflow, or technology solution.

Salary & Benefits: Set at $28.85 per hour ($60,000 annualized base), eligible annual bonus and for overtime. Cohort starts July, 2027!

rows.title: Analyst - Life Sciences
rows.descriptionText:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You’ll develop industry insights, stay updated on trends, and create innovative tools and solutions to enhance client impact.

Leveraging advanced analytics, proprietary tools, and cutting-edge data, you will uncover opportunities and deliver results through written reports, numerical analyses, and presentations.

You will collaborate in small teams, actively contributing to all aspects of client engagements, including gathering and analyzing data, testing hypotheses, and delivering actionable recommendations. You’ll present findings to clients, implement solutions alongside their teams, and apply your industry expertise to address complex challenges.

You will be part of the global Life Sciences Intelligence (LSi) Team as an Analyst – focused on Market Access, based in Boston, New York, New Jersey or Washington DC.

The team sits in a variety of global locations. Each member of this team is aligned to a set of domains (or topic areas) where they have an opportunity to deepen their expertise and serve clients as well as our client service teams. You will be working with colleagues in our market access domain and serving clients on topics such as access strategy at launch, pricing strategy, contracting analytics, gross-to-net optimization, channel strategy, capability building, organizational design, patient access & affordability, and evolution of US healthcare policy and its impact across the value chain.

McKinsey started serving life science clients back in the 1940s. Since then, the Life Sciences (LS) Practice has grown to be the second largest industry focused group in the firm, with nearly 1600 practitioners globally. The LSi team consists of over 100 professionals across analytics, knowledge, and capability and insights.

Your Qualifications and Skills

Undergraduate degree or master’s degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g. biology, chemistry)Previous experience (internship or full-time) within market access – either in the pharmaceutical industry or consulting preferredAbility to create work product-focused materials/outputs, which may include PowerPoint decks, Excel models, articles, or other written deliverablesExcellent organizational capabilities, including the ability to initiate tasks independently and see them through to completionProficient in rational decision making based on data, facts, and logical reasoningAbility to work or attend meetings outside of traditional business hours or take on projects with limited or no notice at timesAbility to travel to and work in varying environments that may be challenging and/or not easily accessible (e.g., factories, hospitals)Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
At John Hancock, data scientists collaborate with engineers, IT, and experts to build analytical models and data architectures for solving business problems within a modern MLOps framework!

The Data Scientist is accountable for delivering business value with data by focusing on key corporate objectives, including portfolio optimization, expense efficiency, growth acceleration, digital customer leadership, fraud detection, and high-performance of the team. The Data Scientist is responsible for crafting, building, and deploying business interpretable and performant analytics solutions and applications. Collaborates with data and ML engineers to build scalable self-service tools for the analytics team. The Data Scientist leverages and shares their deep knowledge of, and experience with, a wide variety of data analytics practices and methods. The Data Scientist helps others to improve their knowledge and understanding of the use of data and technology.

Position Responsibilities

Bridging between data assets, technology, and business expertise

Collaborate shoulder-to-shoulder with business experts. Understand the business, the associated processes, systems & data environment. Research, explore, and experiment with data driven business ideas. Research & leverage published material to gain a comprehensive understanding of data science practices and methods. 

Crafting and building business interpretable and performant analytics solutions

Develop and implement data analytics enabled solutions to improve and re-imagine business process, to generate insights, and support strategy development. Work on problems of diverse scope and complexity requiring the in-depth analysis of data. Quickly develop enough business insight to connect data sources across multiple diverse and complex systems. Generate relevant, actionable insights based on iterative data analysis, translating data-driven output into business language, and making appropriate recommendations to business partners. Work closely with business teams and data science engineers to collaboratively build and deliver rich data content for analysis. Deploy rich data and analytics content in business applications. Understand how the analysis of data impacts a broader business strategy, including the core drivers of business value. Prepare cases on the benefits of the analytics work. 

Elevate Data And Analytics Skills In The Business

Help business partners better understand the use of data, drawing on a detailed understanding of data analytics and predictive modeling. Identify and guide natural data champions to improve the profitable use of data. Learn salient business concepts from data champions and enable them to creatively use data assets. 

Required Qualifications

Masters or equivalent experience in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Machine Learning, AI, Statistics, or related field) Knowledge and expertise with SQL with Oracle, MySQL, and Relational Databases Skilled with Python or similar languages 2+ years of experience working in data science in a consumer product company collaborating with Machine Learning Scientists, Data Scientists, Research Scientists, Applied Scientists, or similar roles. rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Within DAGS, our AI/ML team drives innovation across disease areas by building biologically grounded and interpretable imaging pipelines. In Immunology, digital pathology plays a critical role in understanding tissue level immune mechanisms and supporting companion diagnostics. We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist with strong expertise in computer vision and biomedical imaging to develop scalable imaging foundation models and interpretable pipelines for immunology and oncology biomarker discovery.

What You’ll Do

Develop and train imaging foundation models for histopathology, with a focus on immune‑relevant tissue and cellular patterns. Build segmentation driven and cell‑centric pipelines (e.g., immune cell typing, spatial organization, microenvironment analysis). Design interpretable modeling workflows that link image derived features to biological hypotheses and clinical endpoints. Apply zero‑shot and weakly supervised learning methods to extract immune signals from H&E and IHC data. Collaborate closely with immunologists, pathologists, and translational teams to ensure biological relevance and interpretability. Support imaging biomarker development efforts, including applications toward companion diagnostics. Contribute to platform level imaging strategies, QC standards, and best practices within DAGS. Share findings through internal forums, publications, and scientific collaborations. 

You Should Have

PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genetics & Genomics, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Pharmaceutical Science, or related STEM field with 0+ years postdoctoral experience or Master’s degree with 4+ years of industry experience.Strong expertise in computer vision and medical image analysis and/or multimodal data. Experience building and/or applying models for segmentation, detection, and representation learning, ideally in histopathology. Familiarity with modern deep learning architectures (e.g., transformers, vision foundation models). Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch. Strong interest in immunology and tissue‑based biomarker discovery. Ability to communicate complex technical ideas to multidisciplinary scientific partners. 

Preferred Skills And Experience

Familiarity with clinical or translational imaging biomarker programs. Publications in venues such as MICCAI, CVPR, NeurIPS, ISBI, or related journals.

Biomedical Imaging, Computer Science, Computer Vision, Data Science, Data Segmentation, Deep Learning, Digital Pathology, Foundation Models, Image Analysis, Machine Learning (ML), Medical Imaging Analysis, Multimodal, Multimodal Analysis, PyTorch, Representation Learning, Transformer Model, Vision Transformer (ViT)

rows.title: Sustainability Data Collection & Analysis Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

The  Sustainability Data Collection & Analysis Specialist  supports Gilbane’s sustainability data management, reporting, compliance, and continuous-improvement activities. The role is responsible for maintaining reliable sustainability information, supporting data and reporting systems, troubleshooting data issues, and translating complex information into clear insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

The Sustainability Data Analyst serves as the primary owner of several core sustainability data-management processes, including ongoing data aggregator maintenance, audit support, compliance management, data collection and troubleshooting. The role also supports implementation of the data aggregator platform .

 Who are we?   

As a Top-10 ENR Contractor, Gilbane is a family-owned business with 45 offices that has been shaping communities since 1870. Consistently recognized as one of the most reputable construction management firms in the country, Gilbane is committed to delivering projects safely and on-time. You will have the opportunity to build schools, labs, hospitals, corporate offices, sports arenas and more! 

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Who are you? 

You are someone who acts inclusively, showing empathy and treating others with respect and dignity to uphold Gilbane’s core value of Caring and “People First” workplace culture. You seek to listen to understand and can convey information clearly. You’re a strong problem solver who can identify, prioritize, and implement alternatives for solutions, and you demonstrate adaptability by collaborating with others and supporting team members to achieve budget, timelines, and excellent quality. A self-starter who shows passion, commitment, and ownership all while delivering on business outcomes and driving results. You’re someone who identifies opportunities for new and improved ways of doing things that result in value-add solutions.  

Your core values match Gilbane’s: Integrity, Caring, Teamwork, Toughmindedness, Dedication to Excellence, Discipline, Loyalty, and Entrepreneurship.

What’s in it for you?   

Gilbane offers employees multi-dimensional training opportunities through a number of resources. While managing your responsibilities to projects, you will be able to enroll in trainings through our award-winning Gilbane University to build leadership and technical skills. In addition, you would work with an experienced team which provides you with the opportunity to learn new industry skills every day. You will represent, protect, and promote the sustainable interests of Gilbane, its partners, and its client in relevant matters. 

Responsibilities

 Sustainability Data Management and Systems 

 Support the implementation of the data aggregator tool , including coordination of data, system, and stakeholder needs.  Manage ongoing data aggregator maintenance to support effective sustainability data collection and reporting.  S up por t sustainability data collection and troubleshooting, working with data owners and stakeholders to identify and address data-quality, availability, and process issues.  Work with IT and other business partners to structure, stage, and integrate sustainability data for dashboards, reports, and analytical tools, including the development of new data pipelines where needed.  Support the administration and continuous improvement of sustainability data and data-visualization systems.  Document data sources, definitions, methodologies, workflows, controls, and reporting requirements in audit- ready for mat. 

 Compliance, Audits, and Process Improvement 

 Coordinate sustainability compliance management, including the organization and maintenance of supporting data and documentation.  Support sustainability audits by compiling , organizing, reviewing, and responding to requests for data and documentation.  Lead the ongoing c ollectio n of Gilbane’s envi ronmenta l tracking requiremen t s , incorporating evolving business, project, reporting, and compliance needs.  Help establish repeatable processes and quality controls that improve the completeness, consistency, traceability, and reliability of sustainability information.  Identify opportunities to automate recurring data-management , validation, and reporting activities. 

 Analytics, Reporting, and Visualization 

 Build interactive sustainability data visualizations, reports, and dashboards using MicroStrategy or comparable business-intelligence tools such as Tableau or SAS Visual Analytics.  Analyze sustainability data to identify patterns, trends, exceptions, risks, and opportunities.  Translate sustainability data into clear, decision-useful information for business leaders, project teams, and other stakeholders.  Respond to recurring and ad hoc data requests while maintaining appropriate documentation and quality controls.  Partner with sustainability team members, data scientists, IT, and other internal stakeholders to support research and analytics initiatives.  Learn and apply new analytical methods, technologies, and techniques as sustainability reporting and business requirements evolve. 

Qualifications

 Experience and Education 

 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data analytics, acc ounting, computer science, information systems, statistics, applied mathematics, environmental science, sustainability, engineering, business, or a related field.  T wo or more years of practical experience in data processing, programming, business intelligence, reporting, acc ounting , analytics, sustainability data, or a related discipline.  An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.  Experience working with environmental, sustainability, ESG, construction, or operational data is preferred. 

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

 Background in reporting, business intelligence, business analytics, or data management.  Experience with enterprise data-visualization software such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Power BI, SAS Visual Analytics, or a comparable platform.  Ability to understand different data structures and convert complex datasets into clear visualizations and business insights.  Experience with data pipelines, process automation, data validation, system implementation, or model deployment.  Experience with SQL, R, Python, or comparable analytical tools is preferred.  Experience with MicroStrategy and MicroStrategy Dossiers is highly desirable.  Experience with sustainability data-management or reporting platforms, including data aggregator s , is desirable.  Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, and problem-solving skills.  Ability to identify data-quality issues, investigate root causes, and coordinate practical resolutions.  Ability to manage multiple reporting, audit, compliance, and data-management priorities.  Strong business acumen and the ability to connect data activities to operational needs and business outcomes.  Strategic-thinking skills, including the ability to see the broader context, clarify objectives , identify relationships and trends, analyze information, and prioritize actions.  Ability to work collaboratively with sustainability professionals, project teams, business leaders, IT partners, consultants, and data owners. 

At Gilbane Building Company, we are committed to reducing our carbon footprint and promoting sustainable practices. Building safer, more environmentally sustainable, and inclusive communities is at the forefront of all we do. Join Gilbane Building Company and contribute to our mission of building a sustainable future. Apply now to make a difference in the construction industry.

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

This ranges from $70,000.00-$84,000.00 plus benefits and retirement program.

Gilbane offers an excellent total compensation package which includes competitive health and welfare benefits and a generous profit-sharing/401k plan. We invest in our employees’ education and have built Gilbane University into a top training organization in the construction industry. rows.title: Data Science & AI Innovation Postdoctoral Fellow
rows.descriptionText:
Summary

We are excited to invite applications for the Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program; a unique training opportunity designed for exceptional early-career scientists eager to tackle some of the most challenging problems in biomedical research and drug discovery.

As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will join the Cardiovascular and Metabolism disease area in Cambridge and pursue an innovative research project at the forefront of biomedical science and drug discovery. You will work alongside leading scientists in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while gaining exposure to the broader ecosystem that translates scientific discovery into medicines.

Our fellows are empowered to ask bold scientific questions, apply cutting-edge technologies, and develop approaches that have the potential to transform patient care.

About The Role

Internal Job Title: Discovery Postdoctoral Fellow

Position Location: Cambridge, MA, onsite

 This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Please note that relocation support is not available for this position. This is a full-time training position of up to three years in duration.

The start date for the 2026 Novartis BR Postdoctoral Fellowship Program cohort is October 1, 2026. Please confirm your availability to meet this date in your cover letter.

Research Opportunity

Cardiovascular disease remains a major unmet medical need and a strategic focus for Novartis. This fellowship offers a unique opportunity to develop and apply cutting-edge AI methods to integrate ECG, genomic, and proteomic data at an unprecedented scale. The Fellow will work with large, multimodal datasets from population biobanks, clinical studies, and real-world data to discover novel biomarkers, uncover disease mechanisms, and improve patient stratification. Through close collaboration with experts in data science, human genetics, and cardiovascular medicine, the Fellow will gain hands-on experience translating advanced analytics into insights that can inform the development of future therapies.

Key Responsibilities

As a Data Science & AI Innovation Fellow, you will:

Develop and apply multimodal AI/ML models and statistical methods to integrate ECG, genomic, and proteomic data for cardiovascular disease research.Analyze large-scale multimodal datasets from biobanks, clinical studies, and real-world data sources to identify novel biomarkers and disease mechanisms.Design, implement, and evaluate predictive and interpretable models linking physiological signals with molecular and genetic variation.Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, geneticists, clinicians, and cardiovascular researchers.Communicate findings through publications, conference presentations, and internal scientific seminars.

Why Join the Program?

The Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program is designed to develop the next generation of scientific leaders and power the future of medicine through rigorous research, and immersive learning experiences, including the implementation of AI tools in biomedical research.

Postdoctoral Research Fellows Benefit From

Guidance from accomplished scientific leaders and subject matter expertsAccess to advanced technologies, platforms, and research capabilitiesCollaboration across disciplines and organizational boundariesA global and diverse community of postdoctoral fellowsDedicated programming designed to help fellows thrive throughout their careers.Personalized experiential learning opportunities through a Postdoc Practicum that empowers fellows to explore new scientific domains, build cross-functional expertise, and expand their impact beyond their primary research project.Opportunities to present research, publish in leading journals, and build an international scientific network

We are entering a new era of biomedical research breakthroughs through the convergence of biology, technology, and artificial intelligence tools, and fellows are also supported in engaging with these emerging approaches.

This is a full-time training position of up to three years in duration.

Reimagining Medicine Together

At Novartis, our purpose is to reimagine medicine to improve and extend people’s lives. Through this program, you will grow as a scientist and future leader while contributing to discoveries that may ultimately benefit patients worldwide.

Essential Requirements

PhD (or equivalent doctoral degree) in a relevant scientific discipline completed prior to the fellowship start date. The program is intended for scientists immediately following their PhD training (PhD conferred in 2026 only).Demonstrated record of scientific achievement (publications, presentations, patents, or equivalent)Strong commitment to learning, innovation, and professional developmentStrong quantitative background in data science, statistics, machine learning, bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, biomedical engineering, or a related field.Programming proficiency in Python and/or R and experience working with large-scale datasets.Hands-on experience applying statistical or machine learning methods to biomedical, clinical, imaging, signal, omics, or other complex high-dimensional data.Experience developing and evaluating predictive models using modern data science approaches.Ability to work independently while thriving in a collaborative, multidisciplinary research environment.Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to diverse scientific audiences.

Desirable Requirements

Experience in statistical genetics or multi-omics analysisExperience analyzing physiological signals such as ECG, with deep learning and foundation models for biomedical data

How To Apply

Please submit your CV and cover letter by August 21, 2026.

In your cover letter, please describe your research interests, career aspirations, and how participation in the Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program will support your long-term development.

Compensation & Benefits

The starting salary for this position is 87,000 USD per year.

US-based employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package including health, life, and disability coverage, a 401(k) plan with company contribution, and a generous time-off package.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Please note that relocation support is not available for this position.

The start date for the 2026 Novartis BR Postdoctoral Fellowship Program cohort is October 1, 2026. Please confirm your availability to meet this date in your cover letter.

Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

rows.title: Senior Data Scientist, Imaging Foundation Models
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Within DAGS, our AI/ML team drives innovation across disease areas by building biologically grounded and interpretable imaging pipelines. In Immunology, digital pathology plays a critical role in understanding tissue level immune mechanisms and supporting companion diagnostics. We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist with strong expertise in computer vision and biomedical imaging to develop scalable imaging foundation models and interpretable pipelines for immunology and oncology biomarker discovery.

What You’ll Do

Develop and train imaging foundation models for histopathology, with a focus on immune‑relevant tissue and cellular patterns. Build segmentation driven and cell‑centric pipelines (e.g., immune cell typing, spatial organization, microenvironment analysis). Design interpretable modeling workflows that link image derived features to biological hypotheses and clinical endpoints. Apply zero‑shot and weakly supervised learning methods to extract immune signals from H&E and IHC data. Collaborate closely with immunologists, pathologists, and translational teams to ensure biological relevance and interpretability. Support imaging biomarker development efforts, including applications toward companion diagnostics. Contribute to platform level imaging strategies, QC standards, and best practices within DAGS. Share findings through internal forums, publications, and scientific collaborations. 

You Should Have

PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genetics & Genomics, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Pharmaceutical Science, or related STEM field with 0+ years postdoctoral experience or Master’s degree with 4+ years of industry experience.Strong expertise in computer vision and medical image analysis and/or multimodal data. Experience building and/or applying models for segmentation, detection, and representation learning, ideally in histopathology. Familiarity with modern deep learning architectures (e.g., transformers, vision foundation models). Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch. Strong interest in immunology and tissue‑based biomarker discovery. Ability to communicate complex technical ideas to multidisciplinary scientific partners. 

Preferred Skills And Experience

Familiarity with clinical or translational imaging biomarker programs. Publications in venues such as MICCAI, CVPR, NeurIPS, ISBI, or related journals. 

#EligibleforERP

Required Skills

Biomedical Imaging, Computer Science, Computer Vision, Data Science, Data Segmentation, Deep Learning, Digital Pathology, Foundation Models, Image Analysis, Machine Learning (ML), Medical Imaging Analysis, Multimodal, Multimodal Analysis, PyTorch, Representation Learning, Transformer Model, Vision Transformer (ViT)

rows.descriptionText:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

This is an opportunity for a creative Operations Research Analyst to join MITRE’s Operations Analysis department. We are a large group of over 60 operations research professionals, including over 20 PhDs, who provide thought leadership on a variety of strategic and technical issues, perform analysis that enable our sponsors to make more effective decisions, lead internal research and development activities to bring new technical capabilities into the public sector, and serve as trusted third-party advisors to government sponsors on a variety of technical topics.

In short, we apply our problem-solving skills to complex interdisciplinary problems that occur within or at the intersection of organizations, operations, and technology. We support sponsor projects across the defense and public sectors including military logistics, radio-spectrum frequency management, health care delivery, cybersecurity analytics, fraud detection, satellite planning, homeland security and civilian aviation. We apply advanced analytic techniques such as longitudinal analysis, large-scale integer programming, metaheuristics, agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, predictive modeling, mathematical modeling, forecasting, machine learning, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, Bayesian analysis, and different types of simulation to solve the nation’s toughest problems. And our research pushes the boundaries on topics such as complex scheduling, medical image analysis, and identifying changes in data streams.

If you are passionate about project-based analytical work in the public interest, you have found the right place.

Your Impact

You’ll develop industry insights, stay updated on trends, and create innovative tools and solutions to enhance client impact.

Leveraging advanced analytics, proprietary tools, and cutting-edge data, you will uncover opportunities and deliver results through written reports, numerical analyses, and presentations.

About The Operations Analyst Program

The Operations Analyst Program is an early-career development opportunity for driven recent and soon-to-be graduates who want to launch a career at the intersection of investment management, operations, data, and technology. Analysts use analytical, technical, and collaborative skills to help deliver operational excellence, solve business challenges, and improve outcomes for clients.

As investment operations evolve through data, automation, and AI, analysts gain hands-on experience supporting business-critical investment processes while helping identify opportunities to improve how work gets done. Over three weeks, Analysts begin as a cohort with an immersion in Parametric's investment strategies, operating model, and Operations organization. Following onboarding, analysts join teams supporting Market, Client, or Control functions, where they develop domain expertise, learn business-critical workflows, and build an end-to-end understanding of how Operations supports clients, portfolios, risk management, and business growth.

Operations teams are responsible for the execution, oversight, servicing, and control activities that support the investment lifecycle.
