Are you ready to kickstart your career with a leading global company? 

We are looking for ambitious individuals seeking real-world Electrical & Automation experience in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

At Nestlé USA, we’re modernizing how food gets made—safely, sustainably, and at scale. Our E&A Engineer Development Program is a two-year, hands-on program designed to develop the next generation of E&A Engineers who will power the factory of the future and support our bold digital ambition.

Program Overview

Program Design: 

Approximately 24 months at a designated Electrical & Automation Center of Excellence (COE) factory (one primary location for the duration of the program) Structured curriculum, mentorship, and development experiences—including regular connection with corporate E&A SMEs Upon successful completion, participants transition into a full-‑time Electrical & Automation Engineer position at one of our U.S. factories or distribution centers 

What You’ll Do (Core Responsibilities)

Make an impact from day one by: 

Technical & Hands‑On Learning 

Building foundational E&A skills through hands-on‑ work, structured training, and guided practice with experienced E&A leaders Supporting process improvements by gathering data, documenting findings, and assisting senior engineers with quality, safety, and efficiency initiatives Assisting daily operations & maintenance of electrical power, instrumentation, and control systems—including early exposure to digital tools that improve reliability 

Compliance, Documentation & Sustainability 

Helping maintain accurate electrical and automation documentation and supporting change control processes Supporting energy and water saving initiatives and assisting in tracking results Learning asset management fundamentals, including equipment condition, lifecycle, and capital planning support 

Capital Projects & Digital Exposure 

Contributing to capital investment projects—from scoping and vendor support to commissioning, testing, and documentation Gaining real-world exposure to industrial automation & controls (PLCs/SCADA, instrumentation, industrial networking) Learning how data drives predictive/automated decision making 

Additional Program Experience

You will support the design, implementation, and maintenance of electrical, automation, MES, and digital systems. Activities may include:

Troubleshooting control systems and supporting project execution Assisting with technical documentation, specifications, procurement, programming support, assembly, and commissioning Providing technical support and training to operators and technicians Collaborating with cross-functional teams to support organizational goals 

Program Timeline 

Phase 1—First ~4 months: Foundational Manufacturing & Nestlé Understanding 

You’ll build a strong technical and business foundation through:

Immersive learning and cross-functional rotations Shadowing and hands-on exposure to Engineering & Maintenance, Supply Chain, Finance, Human Resources, Industrial Performance, SH&E, Quality, and Production Leading meaningful projects that deliver real value 

Phase 2—Last ~20 months: Deeper E&A Technical Skill-Building 

You’ll transition into more advanced Electrical & Automation skill-building and leadership development, including:

Mentorship and networking with senior leaders Scenario-based leadership training and Nestlé leadership practices Deep E&A skill development in areas such as: Power distribution Motor & power controls Factory automation standards Electrical safety & arc flash Instrumentation and calibration MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems) Advanced process controls Robotics, IIoT, and digital technologies Data analytics 

Program Completion 

You’ll transition into a full‑time Electrical & Automation Engineer role at a Nestlé USA factory or distribution center—ready to make a significant impact.

Eligibility Requirements

Education 

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or other related engineering discipline (completed or expected by June 2027). Preferred cumulative GPA: 3.0+ 

Experience (Preferred)

Electrical & Automation internship or co‑op Leadership experience (student orgs, athletics, community) Manufacturing experience Demonstrated problem solving experience 

Additional Requirements

Available to start June 21, 2027 Ability to relocate to one of our Electrical & Automation Center of Excellence factory locations across Nestlé USA for the approximately two-year program Available locations are: Jonesboro, AR and Waverly, IA Ability to be placed in one of our Nestlé USA factories or Distribution Centers at the end of the program into an Electrical & Automation Engineer position Limited travel for training events Willingness to work any shift which may include first, second, third, weekends, holidays, extended shifts (e.g., 10-hour or 12-hour schedules), as required throughout the program Ability to work in ambient conditions that may be cold, wet, or warm Strong communication, analytical, and leadership potential Team-oriented mindset, resilience, adaptability, and willingness to “fail forward” Ability to connect the dots across complex systems and think end-to-‑end Comfortable leading in a factory environment Comfortable with ambiguous situations and challenging assignments 

Why Nestlé 

Join a company committed to your growth. At Nestlé, you’ll be part of an inclusive, supportive culture that:

Encourages innovation and continuous learning Celebrates achievements Invests in your development through mentorship, on-‑the-job learning, and leadership exposure Provides exposure to global standards, digital tools, and next generation factory modernization Provides opportunities to grow your career across the world’s largest food and beverage company 

Perks:  

At Nestlé, we value our employees and offer a range of benefits to support their well-being and professional growth, including: 

Relocation package (for eligible candidates)  Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, mental wellness programs, and financial health benefits  Immersion into a dynamic and inclusive work culture  Mentorship and professional coaching from experienced leaders  As an influential industry leader in consumer-packaged goods, Nestlé offers you the chance to make a difference in the community through engaging in community service events  

The pay rate for this position is $92,000. Please note that the pay rate provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with Company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at About Us | Making an Impact | Nestle Careers

rows.title: Director, Manufacturing (Operations) Quality & Food Safety (Yogurt/Shakes/Kids)
rows.descriptionText:
About The JobThis role is responsible for category Quality & Food Safety performance in manufacturing in Danone owned factories. The main purpose of the Category QFS Manufacturing role is to ensure operational QFS excellence.
Job ResponsibilitiesTo be a main point of contact with the factory QFS organization ensuring sufficient time and leadership to develop QFS capability within factory teamsTo establish a 2 way stream of feedback to and from US factories, category teams and global QFS to ensure a strengthening of standards and increased performance.To be accountable for the implementation of the Danone QFS product and operational QFS standards across all the factories (Danone owned or Co-Manufacturers) within the designated category.To ensure the Quality Management System within the factories meets the needs of the product and consumer.To drive within each factory a QFS culture of transparency, continuous improvement and zero-defect minded executional excellence.To monitor end-to-end QFS performance and consumer satisfaction metrics, reporting, data and insights analytics and make strategies for addressing gaps and performance issues as well as recognizing good performanceTo co-design with factories and supply chain change projects (CapEx and OpEx) to drive food safety compliance and consumer satisfaction.To be an IWS expert and lead delivery of the Quality PillarTo develop the capabilities within the category QFS team and in the factories to deliver & execute the digital and IWS agenda. 
The role covers all end-to-end QFS design and operational activities, within the designated category within the US.
Key DeliverablesLeadershipLead by example with a servant leadership focus enabling a culture of teamwork and trust across all teamsDevelop highly competent factory QFS organizations that are technical and capable of implementing strong quality management systemsEstablish a category network linking factories, technical expertise and global QFS teams to drive best practice, shared learnings and ultimately category performanceEstablish strong, collaborative relationships with Factory Directors, Operations, R&I, C&P and Supply Chain teamsWork openly and proactively with zone QFS teams and categories to drive overall performanceDevelop strategies for continuous QFS improvement in designated category but also input to US + Canada FS strategyComplianceEnsure implementation of food safety and quality policy, procedures and standards in factories and in quality in design processesDeliver the implementation of reference analytical tools and methods in factory laboratoriesEnsure audit non-conformances are followed up and closedGovernance & ReportingEnsure transparency in reporting issues, KPIs and QFS risks using the Danone systems and standardsFully interrogate KPIs and consumer feedback to evaluate product performance and protect brand integrityEscalate and manage issues and potential QFS risks timely, to appropriate stakeholders while fully securing product, brand integrity and consumer safety. This includes risks due to factory team capability, performance or product non-conformance.Ensure robust action plans created from a deep root cause analysis are in place and follow up on action closure. Physical Demands & Work EnvironmentThis role will require traveling on a regular basis to plants
The salary range for this position is $143,000 - $206,000 USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone North America additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

What to Expect:

Are you a driven and ambitious professional eager to make a lasting impact in Human Resources? Nestlé invites you to embark on an exciting journey through our esteemed HR Development Program (HRDP). Our goal is to cultivate a talented pool of exceptional HR Business Partners, poised to become future leaders in our factory and distribution center locations.

Over 24 months, you will gain invaluable exposure working in diverse manufacturing and distribution facilities across multiple U.S. cities. You will receive in-depth learning experiences led by our top HR Specialist groups, including People Analytics, Labor & Employee Relations, Total Rewards, Employment Law, and our various Talent specialists. These learnings will be put into practice immediately during your time in the program.

At Nestlé, our HRDPs serve as strategic partners, leveraging their HR expertise to tackle real-world business challenges and contribute significantly to the success of our iconic product lines. You will play a key role in driving employee development, managing employee and labor relations, interpreting policies and contracts, overseeing compensation administration, staffing, and ensuring legal compliance.

What sets our program apart is the responsibility entrusted to our trainees, coupled with extensive support. You will benefit from the guidance of dedicated direct report managers, a seasoned HR Leadership mentor, and a peer ambassador. This comprehensive network will empower you to excel, facilitating your growth into a well-rounded HR professional.

Our program offers a blend of structured learning experiences and hands-on opportunities, equipping you with a diverse skillset upon completion. Join us on this dynamic journey that will shape your future as an HR leader. Apply to Nestlé's HR Development Program today and make your mark in the world of HR.

Program Breakdown: 

Dive into cutting-edge strategic immersion experiences across multiple vital HR areas, such as recruitment, compensation, talent management, people analytics, organizational development, and employee benefits. Immerse yourself in the world of HR as you learn and apply essential HR Business Partner activities, gaining a solid foundation in the daily responsibilities of an HR Generalist in a factory or distribution center setting. This is your chance to make a real impact and shape the culture with our associates and leaders. Take charge of exciting HR projects from various specialist groups, showcasing your skills and expertise. This includes delivering a quarterly presentation to the esteemed HR Leadership Team, where you'll present your findings and recommendations. Foster open and effective communication with employees, serving as a trusted advisor and liaison between associates and management. Provide guidance on policies and procedures to maintain a productive and positive work environment. Drive the development and implementation of people processes that attract, train, and retain top talent, aligning with the organization's short and long-term business goals. Offer mentorship and support to supervisors in navigating people management and development challenges. Build strong and collaborative relationships with business partners, employee client groups, and, where applicable, union management. Foster an inclusive and diverse work environment that values teamwork and collaboration. Demonstrate skills in performance management, employee communications, employee relations processes, and local HR initiatives and priorities. Ensure flawless execution of these critical HR functions, contributing to the overall success of the site and organization. 

Graduation Placement Assignment (Program Completion)

Upon completing your 24 month program, you'll graduate from our dynamic HR Development Program and step into a full-time HR Generalist role where you’ll continue building your career in factory HR. These positions offer a comprehensive and immersive experience, tailored to the needs of ambitious professionals like you. Harness your diverse experiences and insights to excel in driving HR success and shaping the future of HR at Nestlé.

Bachelor’s degree completed and available to start the program by June 2027 Preferred majors include but are not limited to: Business Administration, Human Resources, Labor and Employment Relations, or related fields. Minimum GPA of 3.0 preferred Previous experience in a customer-facing environment and/or HR internship preferred Willingness to relocate throughout program and career Willingness to support off shift coverage and work extended hours as needed Sponsorship for work visas are not available for this program 

Knowledge & Skills: 

Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills; ability to analyze data and make data driven decisions Ability and eagerness to navigate ambiguous situations as well as exhibits professional maturity Excellent communication (oral and written) and interpersonal skills Ability to prioritize workload and self-manage projects, handle multiple tasks, and meet strict deadlines Strong problem solving and decision-making skills Ability to work with all levels of employees and management within the organization Previous experience working in a manufacturing environment preferred, but not required Must possess strong presentation and training skills Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Access). Preferred experience with an HRIS system (such as SAP, SuccessFactors) 

Program Benefits:

Exposure to senior leadership through project presentation. Collection of support resources included: Direct Report Manager, Senior HR Mentor, and Peer Ambassador Opportunity to network with various divisions and employees across the company. Total Rewards Package including base salary, supplemented corporate housing for first rotation (if applicable), comprehensive benefits, 401k with employer matching, relocation assistance, and more Volunteer in a community service opportunity with one of Nestlé’s Share Valued Organizations (e.g. Boys & Girls Club of America & Nestlé Adopt-A-School Program)

Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skill and abilities as well as geographic location. No Relocation Assistance Offered

Job Number #175288 - Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Role Summary:

As the Customer Management Specialist on the Target team, you’ll be at the heart of our operations — using data, crafting compelling narratives, and delivering insights to propel our omnichannel business forward within this retail environment. In this role, you’ll work alongside a dedicated team that is passionate about driving growth for our strong brands.

What to Expect:

Are you a driven and ambitious professional eager to make a lasting impact in Human Resources? Nestlé invites you to embark on an exciting journey through our esteemed HR Development Program (HRDP). Our goal is to cultivate a talented pool of exceptional HR Business Partners, poised to become future leaders in our factory and distribution center locations.

Over 24 months, you will gain invaluable exposure working in diverse manufacturing and distribution facilities across multiple U.S. cities. You will receive in-depth learning experiences led by our top HR Specialist groups, including People Analytics, Labor & Employee Relations, Total Rewards, Employment Law, and our various Talent specialists. These learnings will be put into practice immediately during your time in the program.

At Nestlé, our HRDPs serve as strategic partners, leveraging their HR expertise to tackle real-world business challenges and contribute significantly to the success of our iconic product lines. You will play a key role in driving employee development, managing employee and labor relations, interpreting policies and contracts, overseeing compensation administration, staffing, and ensuring legal compliance.

What sets our program apart is the responsibility entrusted to our trainees, coupled with extensive support. You will benefit from the guidance of dedicated direct report managers, a seasoned HR Leadership mentor, and a peer ambassador. This comprehensive network will empower you to excel, facilitating your growth into a well-rounded HR professional.

Our program offers a blend of structured learning experiences and hands-on opportunities, equipping you with a diverse skillset upon completion. Join us on this dynamic journey that will shape your future as an HR leader. Apply to Nestlé's HR Development Program today and make your mark in the world of HR.

Program Breakdown: 

Dive into cutting-edge strategic immersion experiences across multiple vital HR areas, such as recruitment, compensation, talent management, people analytics, organizational development, and employee benefits. Immerse yourself in the world of HR as you learn and apply essential HR Business Partner activities, gaining a solid foundation in the daily responsibilities of an HR Generalist in a factory or distribution center setting. This is your chance to make a real impact and shape the culture with our associates and leaders. Take charge of exciting HR projects from various specialist groups, showcasing your skills and expertise. This includes delivering a quarterly presentation to the esteemed HR Leadership Team, where you'll present your findings and recommendations. Foster open and effective communication with employees, serving as a trusted advisor and liaison between associates and management. Provide guidance on policies and procedures to maintain a productive and positive work environment. Drive the development and implementation of people processes that attract, train, and retain top talent, aligning with the organization's short and long-term business goals. Offer mentorship and support to supervisors in navigating people management and development challenges. Build strong and collaborative relationships with business partners, employee client groups, and, where applicable, union management. Foster an inclusive and diverse work environment that values teamwork and collaboration. Demonstrate skills in performance management, employee communications, employee relations processes, and local HR initiatives and priorities. Ensure flawless execution of these critical HR functions, contributing to the overall success of the site and organization. 

Graduation Placement Assignment (Program Completion)

Upon completing your 24 month program, you'll graduate from our dynamic HR Development Program and step into a full-time HR Generalist role where you’ll continue building your career in factory HR. These positions offer a comprehensive and immersive experience, tailored to the needs of ambitious professionals like you. Harness your diverse experiences and insights to excel in driving HR success and shaping the future of HR at Nestlé.

Program Overview

Program Design: 

Approximately 24 months at a designated Electrical & Automation Center of Excellence (COE) factory (one primary location for the duration of the program) Structured curriculum, mentorship, and development experiences—including regular connection with corporate E&A SMEs Upon successful completion, participants transition into a full-‑time Electrical & Automation Engineer position at one of our U.S. factories or distribution centers 

What You’ll Do (Core Responsibilities)

Make an impact from day one by: 

Technical & Hands‑On Learning 

Building foundational E&A skills through hands-on‑ work, structured training, and guided practice with experienced E&A leaders Supporting process improvements by gathering data, documenting findings, and assisting senior engineers with quality, safety, and efficiency initiatives Assisting daily operations & maintenance of electrical power, instrumentation, and control systems—including early exposure to digital tools that improve reliability 

Compliance, Documentation & Sustainability

Immersive learning and cross-functional rotations Shadowing and hands-on exposure to Engineering & Maintenance, Supply Chain, Finance, Human Resources, Industrial Performance, SH&E, Quality, and Production Leading meaningful projects that deliver real value

You’ll transition into more advanced Electrical & Automation skill-building and leadership development, including:

Mentorship and networking with senior leaders Scenario-based leadership training and Nestlé leadership practices Deep E&A skill development in areas such as: Power distribution Motor & power controls Factory automation standards Electrical safety & arc flash Instrumentation and calibration MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems) Advanced process controls Robotics, IIoT, and digital technologies Data analytics 

Program Completion 

You’ll transition into a full‑time Electrical & Automation Engineer role at a Nestlé USA factory or distribution center—ready to make a significant impact.

Education 

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or other related engineering discipline (completed or expected by June 2027). Preferred cumulative GPA: 3.0+

Electrical & Automation internship or co‑op Leadership experience (student orgs, athletics, community) Manufacturing experience Demonstrated problem solving experience

Encourages innovation and continuous learning Celebrates achievements Invests in your development through mentorship, on-‑the-job learning, and leadership exposure Provides exposure to global standards, digital tools, and next generation factory modernization Provides opportunities to grow your career across the world’s largest food and beverage company

rows.descriptionText:
Job Location

MASON BUS AND INNOVATION CTR

Job Description

Research and Development (R&D) at Procter & Gamble, the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world, includes a diverse group of roles that contribute to the innovation and development of our products. It encompasses roles in product research, formulation, testing, and scientific analysis. You will find variety and excitement starting Day 1.

This internship is specifically designed for individuals working towards a PhD who are developing proficiency in their field. As an intern or co-op in management, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals in a supportive environment. This is a 12-week paid internship, designed to provide you with a solid foundation for future career growth. The internship will take place from May (potentially early June) to August of 2027. Join us at P&G, where your contributions will play a vital role in shaping the future of consumer products!

The Opportunity:

Procter & Gamble Beauty Care Global Product Stewardship is looking for a PhD student Intern to help build the data foundation needed to scale life cycle assessment (LCA) across Beauty Care. You will develop and organize life cycle inventory data, turning information from different sources and formats into consistent, model-ready datasets to enable Beauty Care business to generate sustainability insights more efficiently and use life cycle thinking in product and portfolio decisions, supporting P&G climate goals.

The Ideal Candidate Has:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a practical approach to complex technical data.Interest in and comfort with working with incomplete or ambiguous information and turning it into clear, consistent data structures.Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain technical work to different audiences.Good organizational skills and a disciplined approach to documenting assumptions, methods, and decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Identify and fill important life cycle inventory (LCI) data gaps and clearly document assumptions, data quality, and sources.Organize unstructured and semi-structured cosmetic-industry LCI data into standardized formats that can support scalable LCA workflows.Develop practical approaches for cleaning, harmonizing, versioning, and maintaining data over time.Test the structured data in selected Beauty Care products for scalability.Look for ways to simplify data transfer into LCA tools and recommend improvements that could support future automation.Work with data covering product formulation, raw materials, packaging, manufacturing, distribution, and consumer use, as needed.Capture key learnings that can support broader use of the approach across Beauty Care sector and other business units in P&G.

Job Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

Currently pursuing a PhD in Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Ecology, Sustainability Science, Data Science, or a related field with a focus on life cycle assessment, environmental modeling, product sustainability, or data management.Understanding of LCA principles, including cradle-to-grave modeling, life cycle inventory data, and environmental impact indicators.Experience organizing, cleaning, and harmonizing structured and unstructured technical data.Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.Available to work a 12-week internship from May/early June to August in the summer of 2027. Ability to work onsite 4-5 days a week in office at our Mason location. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

Familiarity with LCA software and databases such as SimaPro, GaBi, openLCA, or ecoinvent.Experience using Python, Databricks, SQL, or similar tools for data analysis.Familiarity with data quality, metadata, traceability, and version-control practices.Interest in consumer products, eco-design, digital sustainability, or scalable environmental assessment. 

What We Offer

Meaningful work from Day 1 – You will take ownership of a real business challenge by providing clear technical input to support climate goals, with the opportunity to influence how LCA data are managed and used.Mentorship and learning – You will work closely with experienced technical leaders and receive regular coaching throughout the internship.Visible business impact – Your work will enable Beauty Care teams make faster, better-informed product and portfolio decisions.A collaborative environment – You will work across disciplines and build practical experience in LCA, data management, digital workflows, and technical communication.

Innovate, your way.

Merchandising at Primark

Our merchandising team turn strategic goals into vast opportunities. Here, your insights will maximise our growth as a business and ensure we continue to stay at the forefront in the world of retail fashion.

What You’ll Get

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Let’s talk lifestyle.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension, and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You'll do as Data Governance Analyst – Smart Retail Ordering (SRO)

We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities:

Support the rollout of data governance practices within the Smart Retail Ordering (SRO) programme, working with Data Owners and stakeholders across technology, retail, and supply chain functions to establish clear data ownership and accountability.Develop and maintain data definitions, business glossaries, standards, and governance documentation for critical SRO data elements.Improve the quality, consistency, and usability of product, supplier, inventory, and ordering data through effective data quality management and Master Data Management (MDM) practices.Monitor data quality, manage data issues, conduct root cause analysis, investigate discrepancies, and perform validation and quality checks across data platforms.Support data lineage and traceability initiatives, providing greater transparency and confidence in ordering, inventory, and stock management decisions.Partner with business and technology teams to embed governance principles into new SRO processes and systems, while delivering training and guidance to promote best practices in data management.Drive continuous improvement by preparing ad hoc reports and data extracts, identifying and implementing process enhancements, transforming data analysis processes for greater accuracy and scalability, and supporting governance reviews, audits, and risk management activities.

What You’ll Bring 

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:

Proven experience in data governance, data quality, or data management, with a strong understanding of retail buying, merchandising principles, and retail, supply chain, merchandising, or operational data.Strong ability to work effectively with both business stakeholders and technical teams, building collaborative relationships and driving alignment across functions.Highly analytical, with experience identifying, investigating, and resolving data quality issues to support accurate and reliable business information.Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment, adapting to changing priorities while maintaining high standards of delivery.Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence audiences at all levels.Demonstrates a high level of integrity, professionalism, diplomacy, and tact, supported by strong planning, organisational, prioritisation, and multitasking skills to deliver work within agreed timelines.

Excited? Good. Because it’s energising to put your skills to work, in a growing global business committed to encouraging people to express themselves – and feel a sense of belonging. Apply to be part of Primark’s future, today… and enjoy career growth, our way.  

About Primark 

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business a over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

rows.title: Senior Manager, Culture Marketing Seeding
rows.descriptionText:
Position Overview

At adidas, we never launch a product unless we consider it perfect.

Our brand teams bring together creativity, cultural insight, product expertise, and operational excellence to create meaningful connections with consumers. Through thoughtful product seeding, we put the right product in the hands of influential talent, partners, and cultural voices who help shape how adidas shows up in sport, fashion, and culture.

As Senior Manager, Culture Marketing Operations, you will lead the development and execution of Culture Marketing seeding strategy in partnership with the Director of Culture Marketing Seeding. You will own product planning, inventory governance, operational frameworks, and performance measurement to maximize product investments and enable scalable support of adidas' global talent, partner, and influencer networks.

Working across Global Brands, Communications, Business Units, Product Marketing, Market teams, agencies, and vendors, you will drive alignment from seasonal planning through execution. This role is strategically important to strengthening operational discipline, improving visibility into seeding performance, and ensuring resources are deployed against the brand's most important cultural opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

 Seeding Strategy: Lead the development and execution of Culture Marketing seeding strategy aligned with brand priorities, cultural relevance, and consumer impact. Allocation Governance: Establish seeding frameworks, allocation principles, and prioritization models that maximize product investment and support strategic talent and partner relationships. Product Planning: Own end-to-end forecasting, allocation, inventory management, and product lifecycle oversight across Culture Marketing seeding initiatives. Inventory Management: Drive accurate inventory tracking, reconciliation, reporting, and governance while continuously improving seeding processes and tools. Seasonal Planning: Partner with Global Brands, Communications, Business Units, Product Marketing, and Market teams to develop seasonal seeding and gifting plans aligned with product and campaign timelines. Cross-Functional Execution: Lead planning and delivery of key seeding initiatives, aligning stakeholders, resources, timelines, and business objectives. Agency and Vendor Management: Manage external agency and vendor partners against established scope, budget, service levels, and performance expectations. Analytics and Reporting: Develop performance measurement and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into inventory health, seeding impact, operational efficiency, and business opportunities. Financial Management: Manage seeding budgets, forecasting, and spend tracking while maintaining financial discipline, compliance, and responsible stewardship of company resources. Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the Seeding team through clear objectives, accountability, collaboration, and capability building that supports evolving business needs.

Required Qualifications

 Strong knowledge of the sports industry with a demonstrated passion for fashion, streetwear, and relevant cultural trends. Strong strategic planning and prioritization skills with the ability to balance long-term objectives and immediate business needs. Strong understanding of inventory management, product allocation, and operational planning. Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and build alignment across a complex matrix organization. Data-driven approach to decision making with the ability to translate insights into clear business actions. Strong financial acumen, including experience with budgeting, forecasting, spend management, and vendor oversight. Strong attention to detail with a results-focused approach to execution. Ability to prioritize and oversee multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated leadership capabilities with the ability to establish accountability, foster collaboration, and develop team capabilities.

Preferred Experience

 Experience supporting product seeding, gifting, influencer, talent, or Culture Marketing programs within a global consumer brand environment. Experience partnering across Brand, Communications, Product Marketing, Business Units, and regional or Market organizations. Experience developing reporting, analytics, or performance measurement frameworks for product investment and operational programs.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role operates in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment requiring coordination across multiple internal teams and external partners. Work model, location, and travel expectations are not specified in the source material.

REPORTING STRUCTURE

This role works in close partnership with the Director of Culture Marketing Seeding and leads, coaches, and develops the Seeding team. The position has significant cross-functional exposure across Global Brands, Communications, Business Units, Product Marketing, Market teams, agencies, and vendor partners.

We’re seeking a strategic and experienced leader to drive EA’s global tax controversy and transfer pricing strategy. As our Director, Tax Controversy, you will own the company’s U.S. federal audit and controversy efforts (with opportunity to expand to controversy work outside the US), lead Advance Pricing Agreement (APA) strategy and negotiations, and build trusted, long-term relationships with tax authorities.

You will be in a highly visible role requiring deep technical expertise, strong judgment, and the ability to influence outcomes in complex, high-stakes situations relating to U.S. international and domestic taxation and transfer pricing, with proven success managing IRS tax controversies in a fast-paced, digital business environment.

You will bring a proven track record of successfully leading tax audits and disputes, shaping controversy strategy and enabling the team to operate it, and partnering across the business to align tax positions with EA’s global operating model. This role reports directly to the Senior Director, Transfer Pricing & Controversy. You will work a hybrid role, requiring three days per week in an EA office

Tax Controversy & Audit Management

 In collaboration with the Senior Director, Transfer Pricing & Tax Controversy, lead EA’s U.S. federal tax audits, controversy strategy, manage IRS examinations and assist with negotiation and settlements. Develop and execute audit defense strategies supported by robust technical documentation and analytics. Ability to advise on the interpretation of IRS Code and Regulations by the IRS Exam Team and Counsel assigned to EA’s case. Prepare strong, technically supported responses to audit queries and documentation requests. Manage and assist with negotiating Advance Pricing Agreements (APAs) and maintain documentation for U.S. uncertain tax positions (FIN 48). Provide strategic input on cross-border transactions, IP integration, entity rationalization, and business expansions. Partner with Legal, Finance, and Treasury to assist in implementing tax-efficient global structures while ensuring compliance. Represent EA in discussions with tax authorities, demonstrating professionalism, transparency, and strategic negotiation skills.  Collaborate effectively across the organization — including Finance, Legal, Accounting, People Experience, and business units — to ensure tax alignment with operational goals. Mentor and develop team members globally, fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusion, and technical excellence. Support process and system improvements leveraging automation and data analytics and participate in strategic initiatives related to EA’s ongoing digital and operational transformation.

Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA, JD, or LLM in Taxation strongly preferred. 10+ years of tax consulting, compliance, and reporting experience in Big 4 and/or U.S. multinational corporate tax department, with focus on U.S. and domestic international tax (experience with R&D credit helpful). Proven success leading IRS tax audits and controversies (controversy experience outside the U.S. also helpful). In-depth knowledge of U.S. international tax provisions (GILTI/NCTI, FDII/FDDEI, BEAT, FTC) and OECD developments (BEPS, Pillar Two) would be beneficial. Experience with digital economy taxation, IP structuring, and transfer pricing. Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills with the ability to influence senior leadership and tax authorities. rows.title: Client Development Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision, 1 Voice

Overview

How You’ll Make an Impact

We’re looking for a Client Development Manager to join our London‑based Commerce team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving incremental revenue growth through a Tier 1 B2B retail media partnership, with a particular focus on activating and scaling investment from the retailer’s long‑tail supplier base.

This is a quota‑carrying position, with success measured by incremental revenue delivered from secondary markets and long-tail suppliers. Working with the commercial lead on the retailer partnership, you will own the end‑to‑end commercial engagement — from identifying opportunities, implementing processes, workflows and shaping scalable solutions, to ensuring delivery, reporting, and budget utilisation. This is a hybrid role based in our London office (4 days a week)

Responsibilities

What You’ll Achieve

 Uncover retailer business needs and translate them into scalable, turnkey commercial solutions that unlock incremental investment from long tail suppliers. Rapidly develop a strong understanding of the retailer’s B2B landscape, enabling efficient, low friction engagement that minimises effort required from the client. Build and maintain effective relationships with a high volume of stakeholders across both the retailer and its supplier ecosystem, creating meaningful engagement despite scale and complexity. Communicate the Epsilon Retail Media Network (RMN) value proposition clearly and credibly across diverse audiences, tailoring messaging in real time based on marketing knowledge and language capability. Lead and coordinate multiple internal cross teams to deliver against client commitments, managing upwards and laterally with confidence and clarity to ensure nothing falls through the cracks. Partner closely with project management resources to ensure seamless delivery, clear accountability, and consistent execution across all workstreams. Deliver timely proof of activity for all campaigns and initiatives eg. Reporting and screenshots

Qualifications

Who You Are

What you’ll bring with you:2 – 4+ years’ experience in consultative sales, marketing, or client management, gained client‑side, within ad solutions, direct marketing, or agency environments.Strong experience across core marketing disciplines, including strategy, analytics, media performance, and forecasting.Exceptional relationship‑building skills, with the ability to operate effectively across multiple seniority levels and stakeholder types.High levels of self‑motivation, with a proven ability to identify new opportunities, market gaps, and growth levers.Outstanding organisational capability, with the ability to bring structure and prioritisation to complex, fast‑moving environments.A solid quantitative mindset, with confidence using data, metrics, and analytical tools to inform decisions.Strong data storytelling ability — translating performance metrics into clear narratives, opportunities, and upsell recommendations, even when results are challenging.Great communication and inter-personal skillsConfidence working cross‑functionally with multiple internal teams to deliver outcomes that work for both the client and Epsilon.Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel and PowerPoint, alongside sales and CRM tools such as Salesforce.

Why you might stand out from other talent:Naturally people‑focused: credible, engaging, and effective at building trust quickly.Comfortable juggling multiple priorities without losing momentum, accuracy, or composure.Process‑driven and detail‑oriented, with experience in project management and the ability to build structured workflows that support scale and consistent delivery.Optimistic, resilient, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and a “can‑do” mindset.
Additional Information

When You Join Us, We’ll Create Something EPIC Together

Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we’ve provided marketers from the world’s leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels.

Epsilon’s comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. rows.title: Lead Integrations Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
We’re Pret: proud makers of freshly made food, organic coffee, and big ideas. Across 750+ shops and 20+ countries, our teams are shaping the future of Pret through innovation, inclusion, great customer service and a shared passion for doing the right thing. We’re growing fast on our mission to be the employer of choice in hospitality, everywhere we operate – so this an exciting time to hop on board.

We Believe in Growing Good Things

Growth is at the heart of everything we do. From the freshly hand-made food we create every day, to supporting our teams, we help our people grow in confidence, skills and to pursue their unique paths. Pret is where passionate, hardworking, wonderful people (like you!) find what they need to shine. And the proof is in the pudding – over 80% of our Managers started on the shop floor! So did 20% of our Support Centre teams, including our CEO, Pano.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for passionate team players to bring joy to our customers every day. As a Lead Integrations Engineer, you’ll set the standards and patterns the Integrations Engineers follow across our Azure integration stack (APIM, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid), line-manage the team, and personally deliver the most complex and highest-risk flows in the estate. All new integration assets at Pret are being built on Azure; the legacy MuleSoft Anypoint estate is in a controlled wind-down through this programme. You will own that migration end to end and keep the legacy MuleSoft flows safely operational and well-led until they retire. Expect to spend roughly half your week in code, building, debugging, reviewing pull requests, pairing with engineers and the other half on architecture, standards, vendor conversations, team leadership and stakeholder engagement.

This is the key technical leadership role for integrations at Pret. Reporting to the Head of Data & Integrations, you will lead Pret's Integrations team and own the target architecture that connects our SaaS platforms, including Workday, Oracle Symphony, NetSuite and e-commerce systems, with our data, finance and operational platforms.

You will also be responsible for building the team's most complex integrations yourself, using the same tools and technologies as the rest of the team. We are not looking for a hands-off manager.

This role is for a senior engineer who has grown into leadership without losing their technical edge. You will have led an integrations team working across both MuleSoft and Azure and understand first-hand what it takes to migrate an integration estate from one platform to the other without disrupting the business.

If your last hands-on Azure integration build was three years ago, this is probably not the role for you. But if you still enjoy tackling a challenging Function App on a Friday afternoon while also developing and mentoring a high-performing team, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

Act as the technical owner for the integration’s estate: the single accountable engineering voice on integration architecture, standards and delivery, reporting to the Head of Data & Integrations. Line-manage the Integrations Engineers (FTE and FTC): own performance, development, one-to-ones, and the team's engineering culture. Own the integration architecture for Pret's SaaS source systems and internal services, including Workday, Oracle Symphony, NetSuite, ecommerce platforms and others. All new build is on Azure. Personally design and build the hardest, highest-risk integrations on the Azure integration stack (APIM, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid). Lead the team through the controlled wind-down of the legacy MuleSoft Anypoint estate: keep it safely operational while in use, sequence and migrate flows onto the Azure stack on the programme timeline and decommission cleanly. Define and enforce integration patterns and standards across the team: API design, event-driven flows, retry / error handling, idempotency, observability, security all anchored on Azure-native services. Produce reference implementations on the Azure stack that the team builds from APIM API templates, Function App patterns, Service Bus topologies, deployment pipelines. Run a healthy engineering practice in the team: review every non-trivial pull request, pair on the hardest pieces, unblock the team in code where needed, and grow more junior engineers. Build and maintain the team's engineering toolchain on Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, test frameworks, observability dashboards in Application Insights and Log Analytics. Work with the Data Engineering on the boundary between integration and data engineering, which data lands where, in what shape, on what cadence. Define and maintain the API and integration catalogue: what we have, who owns it, what it does, what SLA it runs to. Manage supplier and vendor relationships across the integration stack, including Microsoft, the MuleSoft wind-down, and any third-party connectors. Be the senior technical voice in vendor and SaaS conversations on integration capability. Act as senior technical escalation point and on-call backstop for major integration incidents, including evenings and weekends where required. Expect to be the one in the flow on Sunday night when a Workday-to-NetSuite job has fallen over. Report progress, risks and architectural decisions clearly to the Head of Data & Integrations and to programme leadership. Stay current with developments in Azure integration services and bring practical, working recommendations back to the team ideally as proof-of-concept code. 

Essential

Experience and Skills required

6+ years' experience in integration / API engineering, with a recent track record of personally designing AND building production integrations on Azure. This is a builder-manager role. Proven experience leading an integrations team across both MuleSoft and Azure — line-managing or technically leading a team of integration engineers through the delivery and operation of a real estate on both platforms, including hiring, performance management and developing engineers. Demonstrable experience leading an integration estate off MuleSoft Anypoint and onto Azure: sequencing the migration, keeping the legacy flows stable and supported through the transition, and decommissioning cleanly. Note: our MuleSoft estate is in a controlled wind-down. We need someone who can lead and operate it safely to retirement, not someone whose primary strength is new MuleSoft build. Deep, current, hands-on experience building production integrations on the Azure stack: APIM, Logic Apps, Function Apps (C# or Node.js), Service Bus, Event Grid, and the supporting Azure platform (Key Vault, Managed Identity, Application Insights, Log Analytics). You should have committed Azure integration code in the last 12 months. Strong API design skills (REST, JSON, OpenAPI) and event-driven patterns implemented on Azure services with examples of what you've built, not just designed. Demonstrable experience designing AND personally building integrations with enterprise SaaS systems ideally including Workday, Oracle Symphony, NetSuite, Salesforce or comparable systems. Strong understanding of API security on Azure, OAuth 2.0, JWT, mutual TLS, Managed Identity, Key Vault, APIM policies applied in real implementations you have built or led. Demonstrable experience setting and enforcing engineering standards across a team of integration engineers by example and by code review, not by document alone. Strong commercial awareness understands Azure consumption cost drivers, vendor commercials and TCO of integration choices. Excellent written and verbal communication; able to write a clear architecture decision record AND a clean pull request description, and to brief senior stakeholders in plain language. Comfortable working flexibly during critical delivery windows or major incidents, including evenings and weekends where required. Right to work in the UK without sponsorship. 

Desirable

Microsoft Azure certifications, particularly the Azure Solutions Architect Expert or the Azure Developer Associate. MuleSoft certification (MCD / MCIA) alongside current Azure delivery. Experience personally building Azure integrations with Workday, Oracle Symphony or NetSuite. Experience migrating an integration estate off another legacy platform (BizTalk, Tibco, Boomi or similar) as well as MuleSoft. Experience with event-driven architectures at scale on Azure. Experience defining Azure landing-zone or platform-level standards (networking, identity, observability) for an integration estate. Experience in retail, hospitality, QSR or omnichannel. 

About You

 Be kind, honest and generous: bring genuine warmth and your authentic self to work every day. Bring your passion: share our passion for food and exceptional customer service. Spread joy every day: small acts of kindness are a big part of what makes the Pret experience special.

We offer

 Competitive Salary and 20% bonus potentialGold Card: We love making people’s day through our food and drinks. That goes for our teams too. That’s why everyone gets a Gold Card. When you’re in the office, your food and drinks are on us. And when you’re not, you can use your Gold Card to get up to 5 Barista-made drinks a day, and 50% off everything else (food, snacks, bottled drinks – the lot).

A few more perks

You’ll get 33 days of annual leave (including flexible Bank Holidays), increasing to 38 days the longer you’re with us.Free private medical cover, with the option to add family or partner at an additional cost 4% of your pension contribution matched by Pret, rises to 5% after 5 yearsLife assurance at 3x annual salary Loyalty award for 5, 10, 15, 20 years’ service Flexible Benefits Platform packed with lifestyle discountsSeason ticket loans Healthcare cash plan Financial wellbeing provisions Free mortgage services Sabbatical after 3 years Opportunities to support our charity, The Pret Foundation

We also offer

 Individual ways to grow - We offer lots of opportunities for learning, whether you join us for a short stint or the long game, you’re good to grow with us. Including fully funded professional qualifications, leadership development and mentoring. Diversity and belonging - Everyone is welcome at Pret, we want you to feel confident and valued for who you are and to truly belong. Pace and variety - Our work is fast paced with lots of variety, you’ll build a diverse skill set and learn a lot! Community and purpose - We’re proud to make a difference through The Pret Foundation, from tackling homelessness to reducing food waste and creating positive change for people and communities.

Our values

 Happy Teams Happy Customers  Amazing Standards Every day  Never Standing Still  Doing The Right Thing 

 The interview journey 

Every interview process at Pret begins with the same two stages. First, you’ll have a relaxed 30-minute conversation with our recruitment team so we can get to know you and your experience. Next, you’ll be invited to a one-hour, in-person interview with the hiring manager at our Head Office in London Victoria.

Depending on the role and function, there may be additional stages. These could include time spent in one of our shops, completing a task, or meeting a senior leader.

 Before you apply 

This role is based at Pret’s Support Centre in London Victoria, where we work in a hybrid way - typically three days a week in the office.

We’d love to get to know you, not a robot, so please do not rely on AI to complete your application.

 Deadline to apply for this role: 21st September 2026 -  Please note due to a high volume of applicants we may close the role early, apply early to avoid disappointment.

rows.title: Senior Manager, People Analytics & HR Insights - Remote, US
rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com.

Job Summary

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on Senior Manager to lead Circana's People Analytics and HR Data work and help build a scalable, high-impact people analytics capability that enables better decisions, stronger workforce outcomes, and measurable business impact.

Reporting into Employee Experience & Technology, this role will shape and advance our people analytics strategy by defining key workforce metrics, delivering trusted insights, and helping evolve the organization from historical reporting toward predictive and prescriptive analytics. A key responsibility will be leading the design and delivery of enterprise people scorecards that leadership will rely on to track workforce health and progress against our people strategy.

This role combines building the future state of people analytics while strengthening and stabilizing the HR data foundation. Working closely with HR leaders, HR Operations, HR Business Partners, Technology, Finance, and other stakeholders, this individual will ensure data and analytics are reliable, actionable, and aligned to business priorities.

A central focus of the role is strengthening HR data governance and quality across UKG and related systems. Through clear standards, ownership, and scalable processes, this role will help elevate HR data into a trusted strategic asset for the enterprise.

This is a senior individual contributor role focused on strategy, execution, and influence rather than direct people management.

The ideal candidate brings a blend of HRIS expertise, analytics capability, business partnership, and change leadership, and is comfortable balancing hands-on execution with longer-term strategy.

Key Responsibilities

HR Data Strategy & Governance

Partner with HR Operations, HR Business Partners, and Technology teams to establish and sustain HR data governance, including data ownership, stewardship, quality standards, and accountability. Establish scalable governance processes and global data standards that improve data quality, consistency, and long-term sustainability. Drive clear ownership and accountability for HR data across HR teams and employee self-service processes. 

Data Quality Remediation & UKG Pro Optimization

Lead ongoing efforts to assess, clean, and remediate HR data within UKG Pro and related systems. Partner with HR Operations and Technology to diagnose and address root causes of data quality issues, not just downstream reporting impacts. Recommend and implement UKG best practices, enhancements, and reporting improvements that strengthen data integrity. 

Analytics, Reporting & Insights 

Establish a trusted and consistent reporting environment that gives HR and business leaders confidence in workforce data and insights. Define, prioritize, and maintain key workforce metrics across:Workforce Planning and HR Business Partner supportTalent Acquisition and Internal MobilityTotal Rewards (Compensation and Benefits)Compliance and RiskGlobal Inclusion and Belonging AnalyticsDesign, develop, and maintain enterprise people scorecards and dashboards that support leadership decision-making. Translate complex workforce data into clear, compelling insights tailored to a variety of stakeholders. 

Analytics Maturity & Future-State Roadmap

Shape and drive a multi-year roadmap, in partnership with HR leadership, to advance people analytics from descriptive and diagnostic reporting toward predictive and prescriptive insights. Mature the scorecard environment from manual reporting to automated reporting and proactive anomaly detection. Identify opportunities to apply analytics to critical business questions such as attrition risk, hiring effectiveness, pay equity, workforce planning, and internal mobility. Evaluate and recommend analytics, reporting, and BI tools that extend HRIS capabilities and support analytics maturity. Partner with Technology and Finance to align people analytics with broader enterprise data strategies. 

Partnership & Change Leadership

Serve as a trusted advisor to HR leadership, HR Business Partners, and HR Operations teams. Lead change management efforts that drive adoption of data standards, scorecards, reporting practices, and new ways of working. Develop training, communications, documentation, and stakeholder engagement plans that increase understanding and accountability. Influence behavioral change by helping stakeholders understand the business value of data quality, consistency, and governance. Balance rigor with pragmatism while building trust and adoption across the organization. 

Required Qualifications

Experience & Expertise

5–7+ years of experience in people analytics, HRIS analytics, workforce analytics, or related HR data environments. Strong hands-on HRIS experience required; UKG Pro experience strongly preferred. Experience implementing and managing data governance, data quality, or HR data management programs. Experience stabilizing HR data environments, particularly in post-implementation, growth, or transformation settings. Strong understanding of core HR domains, including workforce planning, talent, total rewards, compliance, and inclusion analytics. 

Technical & Analytical Skills

Advanced experience in HR reporting, workforce analytics, trend analysis, and insight generation. Experience with BI and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms. Familiarity with data modeling concepts, integrations, and broader enterprise data ecosystems. Experience evaluating or recommending analytics platforms, reporting tools, or people analytics solutions. 

Leadership & Influence

Demonstrated success operating as a strategic partner rather than a purely operational contributor. Strong consulting and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and navigate complex stakeholder environments. Strong change management instincts, including driving adoption and behavior change among stakeholders who do not directly report to you. Ability to balance near-term execution with long-term vision and continuous improvement. Demonstrated leadership potential and the ability to drive outcomes through influence. Previous people leadership experience is considered an asset; however, this is primarily a senior individual contributor role. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading post-implementation HR data remediation or governance efforts. Experience helping organizations mature from ad hoc or descriptive reporting toward predictive or prescriptive analytics. Experience developing executive-facing workforce scorecards or dashboards. Background partnering closely with senior HR and business leaders in a matrixed environment. Experience aligning HR analytics with broader enterprise, technology, or financial analytics strategies. Experience working in global organizations with varied data standards and practices. Previous people leadership experience. 

What Success Looks Like (12 Months)

HR data in UKG Pro is trusted, standardized, and governed with clear ownership and accountability. Measurable improvements in HR data quality, consistency, and reporting reliability. Leaders rely on workforce reporting and analytics with confidence. Sustainable processes and governance standards prevent future data degradation. Enterprise people scorecards are live, trusted, and actively used by leadership to monitor workforce health and progress against people strategy objectives. A clear people analytics roadmap is established, with early movement toward predictive insights and automation. HR is increasingly viewed as a data-driven strategic partner to the business. 

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location: This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote, US

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $100,000 - $130,000 USD. This job is also eligible for bonus pay. 

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees. 

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission. 

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description. 

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

Overview

How You’ll Make an Impact

Epsilon is building the next generation Retail Media Network (RMN) platform to power onsite advertising at scale, leveraging services from our industry-leading platform that already serves billions of offsite ads across the open web. Our vision is a unified platform for both onsite and offsite ads, delivering low-latency, high-throughput performance across the board. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Core Platform Engineering team, someone with a self-starter mindset who thrives with minimal direction, can quickly grasp business and technical goals, and takes ownership from concept through delivery. This is a high-impact role where you’ll shape the architecture, optimize performance, and ensure our systems are built for scale, reliability, and innovation. You’ll be at the forefront of building a next-generation advertising platform that combines the speed and sophistication of programmatic ad serving with the personalization and commerce power of retail media. Your work will directly shape how millions of users experience advertising across top retailers and brands.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Achieve

Design, implement, and maintain high-performance, low-latency services for advertising.Collaborate with product, platform, and operations teams to integrate new capabilities into the platform.Optimize system performance, fix production issues, and eliminate bottlenecks across the stack. Contribute to frontend integrations (SPAs, dashboards, tools) when needed, ensuring seamless workflows for internal and external users.Partner with data engineering teams to design and integrate event tracking, analytics, and reporting pipelines.Champion code quality, testing standard processes, and CI/CD automation.Deliver mission-critical enhancements enabling fast, accurate, and scalable ad delivery.Build robust, future-proof services and interfaces that empower rapid feature development.Improve system observability, monitoring, and fault tolerance.

Qualifications

What You’ll Bring with you:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience).6+ years of experience in backend and/or full stack software development.Strong backend expertise in Java, with experience in high-performance, distributed systems.Experience with streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Pulsar).Proficiency with relational databases (SQL) and NoSQL data stores.Understanding of low-latency, high-throughput architectures and clean software design principles.Experience building SPAs with TypeScript and modern frameworks (Angular, React, or similar).

Why You Might Stand Out From Other Talent

Master’s degree or 10+ years software engineering experience.Experience in ad tech, especially ad serving, RTB, or programmatic platforms.Familiarity with cloud-native environments (AWS, Kubernetes, Docker).Experience with large-scale event tracking, data pipelines.

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision, 1 Voice.

When you join Epsilon, we’ll create something EPIC together. rows.title: Data Triage Manager
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

Numerator is looking for a Data Triage Manager to lead our Data Triage team within the Product Business Intelligence organization. This is a dual-focused role in which you will act as both the people leader for the team and the product owner for the data triage function. You will work with an established and rapidly evolving platform that handles millions of requests and massive volumes of events and other data, and you will be accountable for how quickly and reliably data quality issues are surfaced, prioritized, and resolved.

This position blends people leadership, product management, and hands-on technical judgment. As a people manager, you will coach, develop, and grow a team of analysts responsible for identifying, diagnosing, and driving resolution of data quality issues. As a product owner, you will define the roadmap and priorities for data triage—turning recurring problems into scalable, systemic solutions and partnering closely with Product, Data, and Engineering teams. You'll set the standards, processes, and metrics that keep our data trustworthy, and you'll translate what the team learns into insights that inform decisions across the business.

What You'll Do: 

People Management

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data triage analysts—setting goals, managing performance, and supporting career growth in a fast-paced environment Establish and scale the processes, workflows, and best practices the team uses to diagnose and resolve data quality issues Own team capacity and workload, ensuring the most impactful issues get the right attention at the right time 

Product Ownership

Own the roadmap and priorities for the data triage function, balancing urgent production needs against longer-term scalability and prevention Translate recurring data quality problems into clear requirements, and partner with Product, Data, and Engineering teams to drive durable solutions Define and track the key metrics for data quality and triage performance—issue volume, time to resolution, recurrence—and use them to guide decisions and communicate impact Explore opportunities to adopt and integrate AI into the team's tooling and workflows—using it to accelerate triage, automate repetitive work, and improve data quality at scale 

Technical & Analytical

Work alongside the team to identify and diagnose data quality issues, communicating findings and potential production impacts clearly Identify opportunities for analytical and process improvement, and contribute to the design and implementation of solutions and automation 

Cross-functional & Communication

Provide regular reporting and insights that support operational planning and strategy execution Communicate results and business impacts to both technical and business audiences Support senior leadership by preparing analyses that inform business growth initiatives Help create and maintain dashboards and scorecards, ensuring accurate and timely data delivery 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

BS in Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Physics, or other behavioral and/or equivalent quantitative science 8+ years of experience in data analytics, data operations, or a closely related field 3+ years of experience managing or leading data or analytics teams Experience in a product management or product-owner capacity, including owning a roadmap and prioritizing across competing needs Working proficiency in SQL—enough hands-on technical ability to investigate data and partner credibly with engineering, without needing to operate as a full-time engineer Familiarity with building or maintaining internal dashboards and reporting tools such as Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar platforms Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across teams, deliver results autonomously, tackle complex problems with sound judgment, and lead both people and projects in a dynamic, fast-changing environment Strong analytical skills with an ability to identify trends and translate data into actionable insights Effective communication skills tailored to both technical and non-technical audiences Passion for data and curiosity in uncovering meaningful questions and opportunities through analysis Curiosity about AI and a demonstrated interest in adopting and integrating new AI tools and techniques to improve how work gets done
