rows.descriptionText:
Explore the world of Barclays as a Summer Intern

Spend 10 weeks diving into real projects, gaining hands-on experience, and shaping your future. You’ll receive full support, take on meaningful responsibilities, and build lasting connections—all while discovering what makes our culture unique.

If you're in your penultimate year and ready to grow, learn, and make an impact, this is your opportunity to belong and thrive.

Our Expert Programme

You'll join our expert programme, a 1 year targeted, fast-track programme designed to give you depth and breadth of experience. Participating in job-based bespoke training from the start enabling you to go fully-equipped into your role as you develop specialist technical expertise.

Why the Technology Developer programme?

As a Developer, you’ll help design, build, test and maintain systems used across Barclays. This is more than writing code; you’ll play a role in solving complex problems for clients and customers. You may work with technologies including Java, C++, C#, Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, containers, DevOps, cloud, machine learning, scripting and real-time systems.

rows.title: Senior Audit Manager - Enterprise-wide Risk Management (ERM) and Governance Audit
rows.descriptionText:
In compliance with applicable laws, HSBC is committed to employing only individuals who are authorized to work in the United States. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S., as HSBC will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

Our purpose — Opening up a world of opportunity — explains why we exist. At HSBC, we use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth and perspectives to open up new kinds of opportunity for our more than 40 million customers. We bring together people, ideas and capital that nurture progress and growth, helping to create a better world — for our customers, our people, our investors, our communities and the planet we all share.

As Senior Audit Manager - Enterprise-wide Risk Management (ERM) and Governance Audit, you will lead audit coverage of ERM and Governance in the US. The ERM and Governance Audit team is responsible for audit coverage of the management of the ERM function and Corporate Governance across HSBC Group, including the management of operational and resilience risks. This is achieved through both direct audit coverage and providing subject-matter expertise to monitor and direct the audit coverage across Global Internal Audit.

As Senior Audit Manager - Enterprise-wide Risk Management (ERM) and Governance Audit, you will:

 Lead a team of 3 audit managers, overseeing delivery of all US audits in the ERM and Governance Audit Plan Interact with local regulators regarding GIA coverage of relevant activities, notably 2LOD oversight of operational and resilience risks Manage the relationship with relevant stakeholders in the US on major plans, projects, strategic developments, and industry trends, both to understand and provide input to emerging risks and issues and assess the impact on the planned schedule of audits. Co-ordinate GIA coverage of applicable regulatory requirements, such as Heightened Standards, across multiple audit teams in the US Effectively manage some individual audits and activity through planning and delivery of the annual audit plan within expected timeframe, standards, methodology, budget, and best practices Confirm that audit findings and recommendations are understood and appropriately addressed Demonstrate knowledge of the applicable business and regulatory environment impacting ERM and Governance, including developing trends, risks, controls, and expectations Support a strong risk and conduct culture across the Group and promote awareness and sound operational and strategic decision-making Critically analyses and determine key drivers of change for area of coverage and assess how these will impact GIA’s engagements Identify audit process improvements to increase productivity and efficiency without impacting effectiveness

Qualifications And Experience

You’ll likely have the following qualifications to succeed in this role:

 Extensive relevant work experience in the Financial Services Sector, with prior experience in internal audit, consultancy, or external audit preferred, but not essential Experience of team management Knowledge of the applicable regulatory requirements in the US and business processes related to ERM and Governance Relevant accounting, audit, analytical, financial, project management, quantitative, risk, and technology skills, qualifications or certifications Undergraduate or graduate degree in business, accounting, mathematics, or social sciences. Preference given to qualified accountants, CIA, CISA, CFE, or ACAMS Fluency in English Willingness to travel Experience in defining and utilizing data-driven techniques including data analytics, process mining & AI is desirable but not essential Analytical and critical thinker, who can effectively manage competing priorities and complex challenges to deliver positive outcomes and apply technology or expertise to business issues or operational problems

rows.title: Staff Software Engineer - AV Labs
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race-and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match.

As a Staff Software Engineer , you will be at the forefront of Physical AI , building advanced autonomy algorithms to add rich semantics to our massive driving data . You will set the technical direction for the development and implementation of algorithms that enables better data mining, deep scene understanding, and causal modeling of ego vehicle behavior in an environment full of subtle negotiations . You aren't just solving known problems; you are identifying the next generation of challenges in AV, designing the architectural foundations to solve them, and raising the bar for technical excellence across the entire engineering organization.

What The Candidate Will Do

Set the technical roadmap and lead the delivery of state-of-the-art Machine Learning systems:

 Algorithm Development: Lead the strategy for development of autonomy algorithms and that extract high-fidelity semantic meaning from complex urban edge cases to enrich our L4 data lake .  Architecture & System Design: Architect complex onboard systems, including management of upstream sensor dependencies and evaluation metrics for the stack..  Technical Mentorship & Influence: Mentor senior and lead engineers, fostering a culture of rigorous experimentation and engineering excellence. You will influence the technical direction of multiple teams.  Platform Evolution: Define the requirements for high-quality large evaluation datasets and objective metrics to evaluate the performance of the system.  Cross-Organizational Leadership: Act as a bridge between AV Labs and other Uber engineering units to ensure that autonomous technology is successfully integrated and deployed at scale. 

 Basic Qualifications 

 8+ years of working experience in the Robotics or Autonomous Systems industry.  Proven experience leading large-scale technical projects from conception to production.  Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.  Expert-level proficiency in Python and Linux environments. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 PhD degree in Computer Vision, Game Theory, Robotics, or Machine Learning with a focus on Autonomous Driving.  Extensive experience with C++, CUDA, and high-performance system optimization.  Deep understanding of the Robot Operating System (ROS) or similar autonomous middleware.

rows.title: Staff Scientist, Tech - Science
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role And Team

As a Staff Scientist at Uber, you will solve the complex, global-scale puzzle of how millions of people and things move in the real world. Operating as a technical multiplier at the high-stakes intersection of digital systems and physical movement, you will navigate extreme ambiguity, set scientific strategy, and make critical decisions with imperfect information. Whether you are architecting next-generation marketplace mechanisms or defining experimentation guardrails, you will thrive in an environment where high performance and massive scale are inextricably linked.

You will join the Rider Pricing and Incentive team, which owns the real-time algorithms powering our mobility business. In this role, you will define the scientific strategy for measuring marketplace performance and optimizing complex pricing systems. Beyond building models, you will develop data insights to identify high-impact opportunities and influence executive roadmaps. You will also drive execution by providing technical guidance to junior scientists and partnering cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams to deliver high-impact, productionized results.

What You'll Do

 Set Scientific Vision: Define the 1-2 year scientific strategy and technical roadmap for real-time rider pricing, identifying high-impact opportunities.  Lead the Architecture and Design: Define the scientific frameworks and next-generation pricing algorithms that ensure our models are modular, extensible, and observable at global scale.  Act as a Technical Multiplier: Elevate team-wide technical execution by identifying opportunities for system efficiency, model performance, and reduction of technical debt across software and science pipelines.  Influence Senior Leadership: Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Business Executives, translating complex data and technical findings into clear strategic recommendations.  Own Technical Trajectory: Direct the evolution of critical pricing systems, balancing short-term needs with long-term scalability and efficiency.  Establish Scientific Guardrails: Set experimentation standards and statistical frameworks across multiple teams, driving organization-wide adoption of best practices in causal inference and marketplace testing. 

Basic Qualifications

 Ph.D., M.S., or B.S. in Economics, Operations Research, Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative fields.  Minimum of 6+ years (M.S./Ph.D.) or 8+ years (B.S.) of industry experience building, deploying, and scaling quantitative models in production environments.  Deep expertise in statistical inference, advanced experimental design (e.g., switchbacks, cluster-randomized trials), and quantitative economic modeling.  Proficiency in SQL and Python working with large-scale distributed data tools (e.g., Spark, Presto). 

Preferred Qualifications

 Domain Mastery: Recognized expertise in marketplace design, pricing algorithms, industrial organization, ML system design, or large-scale optimization in high-throughput environments.  Technical Vision: Proven track record of anticipating scientific or system bottlenecks 12+ months in advance and building foundational frameworks to address them.  Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated success leading multi-quarter, org-wide initiatives that moved major marketplace or financial metrics in production.  Executive Impact: Ability to synthesize complex statistical or economic insights into compelling strategic narratives for senior leadership. 

For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $216,000 per year - USD $240,000 per year.

For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $216,000 per year - USD $240,000 per year.

Engineering at Uber means building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. As a Senior Software Engineer (ML Data & Backend) , you will architect mission-critical systems that power the foundation of trust across our global marketplace-from ensuring millions of earners are paid accurately and on time to scaling the simulation platforms that drive billions in pricing decisions. The problems here are complex, the systems are massive, and the pace is fast. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Science, and Ops to translate ambiguous business requirements into production-ready technical roadmaps.  9+ years of experience building developing ML models to solve business problem.  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.  Familiar with modern AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Tensorflow).  Hands-on experience developing foundational models or Large Language Models (LLMs) for user facing applications, marketplace systems, recommendation engines, ad-tech platforms, or e-commerce/shopping infrastructures at scale.  Solid understanding of core machine learning algorithms, their applications, and the underlying systems/infrastructures required to train and serve them. About The Role And Team

As a Staff Scientist at Uber, you will solve the complex, global-scale puzzle of how millions of people and things move in the real world. Operating as a technical multiplier at the high-stakes intersection of digital systems and physical movement, you will navigate extreme ambiguity, set scientific strategy, and make critical decisions with imperfect information. Whether you are architecting next-generation marketplace mechanisms or defining experimentation guardrails, you will thrive in an environment where high performance and massive scale are inextricably linked.

You will join the Rider Pricing and Incentive team, which owns the real-time algorithms powering our mobility business. In this role, you will define the scientific strategy for measuring marketplace performance and optimizing complex pricing systems. Beyond building models, you will develop data insights to identify high-impact opportunities and influence executive roadmaps. You will also drive execution by providing technical guidance to junior scientists and partnering cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams to deliver high-impact, productionized results.

What You'll Do

 Set Scientific Vision: Define the 1-2 year scientific strategy and technical roadmap for real-time rider pricing, identifying high-impact opportunities.  Lead the Architecture and Design: Define the scientific frameworks and next-generation pricing algorithms that ensure our models are modular, extensible, and observable at global scale.  Act as a Technical Multiplier: Elevate team-wide technical execution by identifying opportunities for system efficiency, model performance, and reduction of technical debt across software and science pipelines.  Influence Senior Leadership: Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Business Executives, translating complex data and technical findings into clear strategic recommendations. Establish Scientific Guardrails: Set experimentation standards and statistical frameworks across multiple teams, driving organization-wide adoption of best practices in causal inference and marketplace testing.

 Ph.D., M.S., or B.S. in Economics, Operations Research, Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative fields.  Minimum of 6+ years (M.S./Ph.D.) or 8+ years (B.S.) of industry experience building, deploying, and scaling quantitative models in production environments.  Deep expertise in statistical inference, advanced experimental design (e.g., switchbacks, cluster-randomized trials), and quantitative economic modeling.  Proficiency in SQL and Python working with large-scale distributed data tools (e.g., Spark, Presto).

 Domain Mastery: Recognized expertise in marketplace design, pricing algorithms, industrial organization, ML system design, or large-scale optimization in high-throughput environments. rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

As part of one of Uber's fastest-growing business units, Uber for Business (U4B), you'll join the founding team responsible for building and scaling Catering. Catering is a strategic priority across both Uber for Business and Delivery Operations, with the potential to unlock significant new growth for the Uber Eats marketplace as well as expanding how enterprise customers use Uber.

Working alongside the U4B Head of Catering, you'll play a central role in turning the new product's strategy into scalable execution across the Globa-enabling our Sales organization, building feedback loops across sellers, clients, Product, and Operations, and generating the insights that shape our roadmap and go-to-market strategy. Sitting at the intersection of Product, Sales, Operations, and Analytics, you'll help define how Catering scales from a small pilot product into a core part of Uber's business.

What You'll Do

Voice of Customer Programs: Build and operationalize processes to systematically collect, synthesize, apply a strategic prioritization perspective, and then communicate the perspective to Product and cross-functional stakeholders. Operational Program Execution: Support cross-functional initiatives and product launches by driving operational readiness, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring key milestones are delivered. Sales Enablement: Translate product strategy into clear, actionable guidance for our U4B Sales organization through training, playbooks, enablement materials, and ongoing communications. Data & Insights: Build reporting, perform analyses, and generate insights that help evaluate product performance, identify opportunities, and inform strategic recommendations. Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Analytics teams to ensure strong alignment and execution across initiatives. 

Basic Qualifications 

Experience: At least 4 years of experience in project/program management, operations, strategy, analytics, or a related field. Technical & Analytical Skills: Proficiency in SQL (or a similar query language) with experience using data to support business decisions and performance analysis. Strategic Thinking: Strong business acumen with the ability to translate high-level strategy into scalable programs and operational processes. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience creating and translating messages to cross-functional stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications 

B2B Sales Ops and/or Sales Strategy: Experience with enterprise customer needs, sales enablement, and go-to-market motions. rows.title: Senior Manager, Launch Excellence
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

At Uber, great products are only as good as the experiences they create - and customer experience doesn't begin when a ticket arrives. It begins the moment a new feature or product launch decision is made.

Ensuring that customer experience is at the forefront of the design and build of every new product feature, enhancement, or net new launch means we must influence product design upstream - before painful experiences occur or support issues arrive at our doorstep.

This is the foundational belief behind this role. The Senior Manager, CX Launch Excellence - Mobility, will be the single point of contact responsible for defining the governance model and best practices to enable the right PoCs from CommOps to be embedded as a strategic partner across the Product Development Lifecycle. From PRD through go-to-market to hypercare, this person ensures that a consistent process is followed for every product, feature, and operational change so that the change and/or rollout ships with a customer experience that is excellent from day one - at every maturity level.

This is not a reactive support role. The primary accountability for this role is launch governance and CX readiness standards - defining the frameworks, gates, and operating model that determine how customer experience teams engage in the product development process.

What You'll Own

 Build the Definitive Playbook for CX Participation in the Product Development Lifecycle: Define and own the end-to-end standard for how Community Operations engages across every stage of product development - from PRD through product development checkpoint reviews to launch and hypercare for Mobility. 

Design a tiered engagement model that distinguishes the right level of CX involvement based on product portfolio type: core product lines, growth initiatives, or emerging bets. Every product that ships a customer experience must meet the bar - and this role sets that bar.

Build and maintain the master playbook covering intake criteria, readiness gates, go/no-go frameworks, escalation triggers, and accountability structures. So there is never ambiguity about where CX stands in the process. Establish clear principles: CX is not a reviewer at the end of the pipeline but a co-designer from the beginning.

 Own and Govern the Intake Process - The "Front Door" for Cross functional partners : Design and operate the intake and triage system that captures all customer-impacting changes across Mobility - product launches, feature iterations, quality testing, platform rollouts. Define the criteria and guardrails that determine which changes require full CX readiness reviews, which require lightweight checkpoints, and who is accountable for driving each gate. Create the organizational mechanisms - forums, decision rights, SLAs, tooling - that ensure every change traverses a standard readiness process with full visibility, no matter how fast the business moves. This person is the single point of accountability for XFN partners (including Product) knowing exactly when to loop in CX and what to expect when they do.  Embed CX as a Strategic Partner in Every Launch: Act as the primary counterpart for Mobility Customer Experience, Product Insights & Rollout, Product Ops, and Customer Obsession teams as they seek to not only review launches, but to shape them. Establish clear engagement rules, decision paths, and escalation protocols so upstream teams know exactly how and when to plug in CX - making the partnership predictable, high-trust, and efficient. Build relationships with product/product ops teams to drive this forward.  Define and Drive Support Readiness Standards Across the Portfolio: Translate every upstream product, ops, and policy change into concrete CX readiness requirements: content, macros, workflows, training, tooling, escalation paths - with clear owners and delivery timelines. Track and ensure CX feedback has been formally acknowledged and resolved before launch gates are cleared. Hold go/no-go authority at defined readiness gates with clear escalation paths to senior leadership when standards are not met, ensuring CX readiness is never treated as optional, including structured pre-launch testing protocols that validate support readiness before go-live.  Partner with Analytics and S&P: Work with the Analytics and Insights team to build dashboards and alerting that make launch health and readiness gaps visible to leadership - and actionable before they become incidents. Advocate for customer experience metrics to be embedded in product launch success criteria from the outset. Use data, agent feedback, and customer signals to systematically identify structural upstream causes of defects - and drive resolution through product and policy, not just support responses.  Lead Through Influence and Build Organizational Capability: Operate as a senior leader who drives clarity, builds structure, and governance standards across Product, CX, Product Insights & Rollout/Product ops - primarily without direct authority. Build and govern a networked model of CX readiness owners across personas; set the standards and ways of working while enabling execution. Scale "launch excellence" as an organizational capability - not just a team function - by embedding frameworks, tools, and habits across Community Operations. 

Why This Role Matters

Every product in Uber's Mobility portfolio ships a customer experience. And right now, CX is too often looped in too late - after the design is locked, the product development checkpoint reviews process is well underway, and the support readiness is not embedded into the design. This role changes that permanently.

The person who fills this seat will build the infrastructure - the playbook, the intake process, the governance model, the standards - that ensures CX is never an afterthought. They will be the reason Mobility launches are smoother, right CX inputs are shared during design and build so features are desgined to be defect free, and customers feel the quality of what we build from day one.

Basic Qualifications

 Minimum 6 years of experience in technical program management, product ops, product management, strategy & operations, or similar roles  Bachelors Degree 

Preferred Qualifications

 10+ years of experience in technical program management, product operations, or strategy & operations, specifically within customer support or service operations supporting platforms with >10M active users.  Track record of building and deploying at least 2 end-to-end launch governance frameworks or operational playbooks from 0-to-1 (initial build through full operational rollout).  Prior experience at a consumer technology, mobility, marketplace, travel, or e-commerce company with >$500M in annual revenue or equivalent operational scale.  Governance, Launch Gates & Cross-Functional Operations  Demonstrated management of go/no-go launch gate decisions across 10+ major product feature rollouts.  Experience engaging upstream during the Product Requirement Document (PRD) or initial design phase for at least 50% of managed product launches.  Proven track record of leading cross-functional alignment across 5+ distinct stakeholder departments (including Product, Engineering, Legal, Operations, and Product Ops) without direct report authority.  Experience authoring metric frameworks and partnering with analytics teams to build executive-facing dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, SQL-based tools) for tracking launch health KPIs.  Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience configuring, deploying, or managing content governance for AI-powered support tooling (e.g., LLM virtual assistants, intelligent routing, or agent-assist systems).  Experience reviewing technical design documents, system flowcharts, and architecture specs with Engineering and ML/AI teams to extract support readiness requirements.  Experience writing executive-level decision memos, QBRs, or go/no-go scorecards presented directly to VP-level leadership

At HSBC, we use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth and perspectives to open up new kinds of opportunity for our more than 40 million customers. Science and Engineering at Uber mean building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will work at the high-stakes intersection of economics, statistics, and computer science to build the intelligent systems that power our global marketplaces. Unlike purely analytics roles, this is a production-focused position where you will turn "messy" behavioral data into scalable, machine-readable insights and automated decision-making engines.

You will join a high-stakes environment where the work is fast-moving, and the systems you build directly affect how millions of people and things move across our global platforms every single day. Collaborating closely with Product and Engineering, you will lead high-visibility projects from conceptualization to global productionization, navigating technical debt and shifting priorities along the way. If you are a systems-thinker who stays calm under pressure and is motivated to build production-grade models that solve unstructured problems without a textbook solution, this is where you'll grow.

What You'll Do

rows.title: Senior Product Owner
rows.descriptionText:
Embark on a transformative journey as a Senior Product Owner. At Barclays, our vision is clear –to redefine the future of banking and help craft innovative solutions. In this role, you will shape the future of customer engagement through innovative marketing technology solutions. In this high-impact position, you will drive the strategy and delivery of industry-leading MarTech capabilities that enable personalized, data-driven experiences, helping Barclays deepen customer relationships and support its long-term growth goals. You'll have the unique opportunity to influence enterprise-scale platforms, collaborate with senior stakeholders across the organization, and drive strategic customer experience outcomes through market-leading MarTech platforms across the Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem and beyond.

To be successful as a Senior Product Owner, you should:


Drive and oversee the product vision, roadmap, and backlog, ensuring alignment with marketing, customer communication, and enterprise targetsExcel at prioritization and sound judgment by balancing business value, customer experience, risk, compliance, and technical feasibilityTranslate business and marketing requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable outcomes for Agile delivery teamsBuild considerable relationships across business and technology teams to drive stakeholder alignment, collaboration, and executionApply Agile and data-driven practices to continuously improve customer experiences, platform adoption, operational efficiency, and product performance


Other Highly Valued Skills Include


Deep knowledge across Adobe Experience Cloud, Adobe Campaign, AEM, Tealium, Transactional Databases, CMS, customer communication, personalization, and analytics platformsConsiderable technical acumen with APIs, integrations, cloud technologies, data flows, and enterprise platform architecturesExperience in banking or financial services, with knowledge of security, compliance, data privacy, governance, and large-scale digital transformation programs


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is located in our Whippany, NJ office.

Minimum Salary: $170,000

Maximum Salary: $230,000

The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above include only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.

Barclays employees are eligible for a suite of competitive and generous employee benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k), life insurance, and other paid leave for qualifying circumstances.

This position is eligible for an incentive award.

Purpose

The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.

Accountabilities


Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product & its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization’s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements.  Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully. Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog. Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy. Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience. Acceptance Criteria Definition & Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value. Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives. Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on-going readiness and 'run' activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals. Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions. 


Vice President Expectations


To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: Senior Product Manager - Search, Discovery & Open Innovation
rows.descriptionText:
Dr. Martens is more than a brand - it’s a global icon with over 60 years of attitude, heritage, and cultural impact. We’re a thriving, values‑driven business powered by diverse thinkers, bold doers, and people who bring their whole selves to work. If you’re ready to make your mark, you’re in the right place.

At DM, our values guide everything we do: Be Yourself, Act Courageously, Show You Care. They’re not just words - they’re how we turn passion into progress.

WHERE YOU SIT

As our Senior Product Manager – Search, Discovery & Open Innovation, you’ll be part of the Consumer & Brand team working closely with brilliant people across the business and reporting into Head of Global Customer Product. You’ll be right at the heart of fast‑moving projects that shape how we show up for our consumers - today and tomorrow.

WHERE YOU CONTRIBUTE

This role is not a delivery role but a design leadership and craft role.

The Senior Product Manager owns the Search & Discovery experience as a product across channels, defining how customers find, explore, and engage with Dr. Martens across digital and physical touchpoints. This includes not only search, navigation, and discovery online, but also how discovery is supported through retail, campaigns, content, and emerging interfaces.

This role also leads open innovation for the entire product team, identifying and scaling new technologies, partnerships, and capabilities that enhance discovery and create competitive differentiation as we move towards a more premium positioning.

Sitting at the intersection of product, experience design, technology, data, brand, and commercial, this role ensures discovery is seamless, intuitive, and elevated across the full customer journey.

Core Accountabilities

As our Senior Product Manager – Search, Discovery & Open Innovation, you will be responsible for:

Owning the global Search & Discovery experience, defining the product strategy, customer value proposition and roadmap across digital and physical touchpoints to make product discovery intuitive, inspiring and relevant. Setting the vision and principles for discovery, translating customer needs, market context and data into focused priorities while ensuring consistent, differentiated and premium experiences across channels. Driving continuous product improvement, optimising search relevance, navigation, merchandising logic and discovery journeys through experimentation, testing and iteration to reduce friction and improve commercial outcomes. Leading innovation and emerging technology, exploring and scaling new capabilities including AI-powered search, recommendations, conversational interfaces and innovations from start-up ecosystems. Building a connected, insight-led discovery ecosystem, partnering with Experience Design, Technology, Data, Retail, Commercial and markets to create strong feedback loops and ensure customer behaviour continuously informs product decisions, while role-modelling the practical use of AI in product thinking and leadership. 


Key Skills & Capabilities

Put simply, the key things we’re looking for are:

Strong Search & Discovery expertise, with deep knowledge of search, navigation, taxonomy, filtering, recommendations and digital commerce discovery experiences. Strong product strategy and prioritisation capability, able to define and communicate a clear vision and roadmap based on customer needs, data, experimentation and commercial outcomes. A data-driven and innovative mindset, confident using analytics and customer behaviour to identify opportunities, test new ideas and balance BAU delivery with emerging innovation. Strong AI and emerging technology capability, with experience applying AI to areas such as search, personalisation, recommendations or insight generation, and a responsible, practical approach to using AI in product development. Exceptional cross-functional influence and communication, able to work with senior Technology, Experience, Data and Market stakeholders globally, simplify complex concepts and drive alignment and decisions.


WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Hybrid workingWelcome free pair of Docs‘Buy as you Earn’ Share scheme 65% off all Docs50% off AccessoriesPension Scheme through AvivaLife Assurance 25 Days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays Private healthcare2 paid volunteer days per year


READY TO FILL YOUR BOOTS?

If you’re excited to own your impact, shape the future of an iconic brand, and grow your career in a place that champions individuality - we’d love to hear from you.

Application closing date: Wednesday 2nd of September 2026

At Dr. Martens, we are committed to creating an environment in which we can all be our best and bring our authentic selves to work. We encourage applications, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, or disability. Diverse and inclusive teams have a positive impact on our brand; helping us to speak authentically to our consumers.

We strive to develop a business where our people can thrive and feel empowered to express themselves. Because we believe everyone should feel supported and included whatever their role in the Dr. Martens community.

Marriott International is seeking a visionary and strategic Senior Director, Global Select + Midscale Brands to shape the future of assigned brands within a rapidly evolving portfolio. rows.title: Sr Analyst, Marketing Operations
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

You will be part of the Marketing Strategy & Analytics department within Williams-Sonoma, Inc. (WSI). The Audience Strategy & Enablement team partners with marketing teams across all WSI brands — including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, and more — to drive smarter targeting, measurement, and customer engagement through data and technology.

About The Role

This is a high-visibility role sitting at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and emerging AI — and an opportunity to shape how a leading omni-channel retailer uses automation and intelligence to drive measurable marketing outcomes.

You will partner closely with Digital Marketing, Customer Relationship Marketing (CRM), and Loyalty teams to turn data into action — building scalable solutions, surfacing insights, and identifying opportunities to automate and accelerate how our marketing organization operates. As AI capabilities evolve, you'll play a meaningful role in piloting and scaling agentic workflows that extend the reach of our marketing data team.

The ideal candidate is analytically rigorous, naturally collaborative, and energized by translating complexity into clarity for business stakeholders.

Responsibilities


 Partner with Digital Marketing, CRM, and Loyalty teams to deliver targeting solutions, performance analysis, and workflow automation that drive measurable outcomes.  Build and maintain data pipelines that connect ecommerce, clickstream, CRM, and third-party data sources to marketing use cases.  Identify high-ROI opportunities to automate repetitive marketing processes and translate them into scalable solutions.  Surface actionable insights from complex datasets and communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.  Evaluate and scale ReAct agents, Custom GPTs and agentic workflows to support workflows across Marketing Operations. 


Criteria


 2+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data engineering, or a related field — ideally supporting a consumer brand or agency.  Strong SQL skills and comfort working in cloud data environments (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks).  Proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation.  Solid grasp of the digital marketing ecosystem — paid media, ad tech, CRM, and how data flows across channels.  Experience with data visualization or BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Domo, Power BI).  A track record of translating ambiguous business questions into structured analyses with clear recommendations.  Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field or equivalent work experience.  Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks, including tool use, memory management, task decomposition and routing across multi-step agentic workflows.  Experience in retail or e-commerce supporting omni-channel marketing teams preferred.  Hands-on experience deploying AI agents in a business context, including building semantic context layers, prompt and output evaluation, knowledge grounding and iterative testing against defined success metrics preferred.  Familiarity with Python / R libraries for time series and causal analyses or marketing measurement methodologies (MMM, MTA) preferred.  This role requires being onsite in the San Francisco, CA office Monday through Thursday. 


Our Culture & Values 

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First 

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands  A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities  Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer  Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits  Tax-free commuter benefits  A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health 


Continued Learning


 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University  Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities  Resources for self-development  Advisor (Mentor) program  Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series 


 WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration). 

 This role is not eligible for relocation assistance. 

 Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances. 

 The expected starting pay range for this position is $100,000 - $120,000. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities. 

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

rows.title: AWS Cloud Architect (contract)
rows.descriptionText:
Please note that this is a contract role providing services to Hilton through Talent Solutions. If you are selected for this role, you will be employed by Talent Solutions and will not be an employee of Hilton. Contract workers are not employees of Hilton or any of its subsidiaries, nor will they be eligible for Hilton benefits.

Hybrid role in our McLean, VA or Memphis, TN office working onsite 3 days/week***

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced cloud architect to join our HSM Digital Solutions team. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in designing and building a next-generation cloud data lake and modern data platform that powers procurement analytics, digital products, and AI-driven capabilities. Reporting to the Senior Manager of HSM Digital Solutions, you will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, data engineering professionals, and external vendors to deliver scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud data solutions. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of a sophisticated data ecosystem within a globally recognized hospitality organization, driving meaningful impact through innovation and technical excellence.

Responsibilities

 Design and document AWS cloud database architectures that support performance, scalability, availability, security, governance, and cost optimization requirements. Lead the modernization and migration of legacy on-premises databases and data platforms to AWS cloud services. Architect and optimize data solutions using AWS services such as Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, Amazon Redshift, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Amazon Athena, AWS Database Migration Service, and related monitoring and security services. Define database patterns for transactional, analytical, integration, and reporting workloads, including OLTP, OLAP, and data lake architectures. Develop architecture standards, reference patterns, design decision records, runbooks, deployment playbooks, and operational best practices. Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, security, governance, resiliency, and compliance requirements are met across all data solutions. Develop migration plans, proof-of-concepts, cutover strategies, rollback plans, validation approaches, and post-migration optimization activities. Partner with security and governance teams to implement encryption, IAM, network isolation, auditing, logging, data retention, access controls, and compliance requirements. Drive performance tuning and optimization through data modeling, indexing, partitioning, query tuning, workload management, capacity planning, and observability practices. Implement and promote automation, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, schema migration practices, and repeatable deployment patterns for database-backed solutions. Develop dashboards and operational metrics for database health, cost, usage, SLAs, reliability, and platform performance. Collaborate with application, integration, analytics, and reporting teams to translate business requirements into practical database and data platform solutions. Review and provide recommendations on cloud architecture designs developed by vendors and solution partners. Evaluate and recommend new technologies to support cloud data platform modernization and AI-enabled business initiatives.

Skills

 Deep expertise in AWS cloud database and data platform services, including Amazon RDS, Aurora, Redshift, DynamoDB, S3, Glue, Athena, and AWS Database Migration Service. Strong knowledge of database architecture patterns for OLTP, OLAP, and data lake workloads. Proficiency in infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment practices. Experience with data modeling, indexing strategies, query optimization, and workload management. Solid understanding of cloud security principles, including IAM, encryption, network isolation, auditing, and compliance frameworks. Ability to design and implement high availability, disaster recovery, and resiliency strategies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience reviewing vendor and partner architecture designs and providing actionable recommendations. Familiarity with AI and machine learning-enabled data platform capabilities and emerging cloud technologies.

Qualifications

 3+ years experience as a cloud architect or senior database architect with a focus on AWS cloud environments. Demonstrated experience leading cloud migration projects, including legacy database modernization and platform transitions. Experience developing architecture documentation, standards, and operational best practices in an enterprise environment. Background working cross-functionally with business stakeholders, engineering teams, security teams, and external vendors. Experience building and monitoring operational dashboards and performance metrics for cloud data platforms. AWS Certified Solutions Architect or equivalent AWS certification strongly preferred. AWS Certified Database Specialty certification is a plus. Additional cloud or data platform certifications relevant to the role are welcomed.

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to make a lasting impact on the digital transformation of a world-class hospitality organization. You will be at the forefront of building a modern, AI-ready data platform that drives strategic decision-making and innovation across the business. If you are passionate about cloud architecture, data engineering, and delivering solutions at scale, this role offers the challenge, visibility, and collaborative environment to help you do your best work.

Pay Rate Range

65 - 76 USD hourly

rows.title: Fulfillment Planning Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Supply Chain Fulfillment Planning Analyst supports fulfillment center and supply chain operations by analyzing data, developing reports, assisting with forecasting and workforce planning, and providing performance insights. The role converts operational data into actionable recommendations that improve throughput, service levels, labor utilization, cost efficiency, and overall network readiness.

Working closely with Operations, Planning, Finance, Transportation, Technology, and site leadership, the analyst identifies trends, risks, and improvement opportunities while creating reporting tools that support informed decision-making. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment, using data-driven analysis to monitor supply chain performance, optimize processes, support planning activities, and enhance operational effectiveness.

What You Will Do

Develop, maintain, and distribute recurring and ad hoc reports that support supply chain, fulfillment center, and operational planning decisions. Analyze operational data to identify trends, patterns, variances, risks, and opportunities related to volume, labor, productivity, throughput, service, and cost performance. Support forecasting and workforce planning by translating business volume expectations into actionable facility-level insights and staffing considerations. Partner with facility leaders, regional operations, Finance, Transportation, Planning, Technology, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, understand business challenges, and recommend data-driven solutions. Build and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and analytical processes that improve visibility of operational performance and reduce manual reporting effort. Monitor performance against plan, highlight variances, diagnose root causes, and escalate risks that may impact service, labor readiness, throughput, or network balance. Create clear summaries, presentations, and recommendations for leadership using Excel, PowerPoint, and data visualization tools. Support continuous improvement by identifying reporting gaps, data redundancies, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to automate or streamline analytical work. Maintain data accuracy, validate inputs, troubleshoot reporting issues, and partner with Technology teams when system or data integrity concerns arise. Work independently to manage priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality analytical support in a fast-paced supply chain environment. Communicate complex data, assumptions, and recommendations in a clear, concise, and actionable manner to cross-functional partners and leadership. Stay current on supply chain analytics, workforce planning, forecasting, reporting tools, and industry best practices to continuously strengthen analytical capabilities. 

Skills You Will Need

Supply Chain & Fulfillment Operations Knowledge: Understanding of fulfillment center operations, labor planning, logistics flow, productivity, throughput, service levels, and operational performance metrics.

Data Analysis & Insight Generation: Ability to analyze large datasets, identify trends and root causes, evaluate variances, and translate findings into practical business recommendations.

Forecasting & Workforce Planning: Understanding of volume forecasting, labor modeling, capacity planning, and operational readiness concepts.

Reporting & Data Visualization: Proficiency building reports, dashboards, scorecards, and presentations that clearly communicate operational performance and business risks.

Technical Proficiency: Strong Microsoft Excel skills required, including formulas, pivot tables, variance analysis, and data manipulation; experience with PowerPoint required; exposure to tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, Access, Anaplan, Business Objects, or cloud-based data tools preferred.

Problem Solving & Critical Thinking: Ability to work through ambiguous business questions, evaluate multiple scenarios, identify root causes, and recommend actionable solutions.

Communication & Influence: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical or analytical information in a simple, clear, and compelling way to operational and senior leadership partners.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to build productive partnerships across Operations, Planning, Finance, Transportation, Technology, and facility teams to drive aligned business outcomes.

Business & Financial Acumen: Ability to connect operational performance, labor planning, productivity, and cost impacts to broader business objectives.

Organization & Prioritization: Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, work independently, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.

Continuous Improvement Mindset: Ability to identify inefficiencies, automate manual processes, improve reporting accuracy, and support long-term process enhancements.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Analytics, Data Science, Finance, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field preferred. Two or more years of related experience in supply chain, fulfillment operations, logistics, workforce planning, data analytics, reporting, finance, or business analysis preferred. Comfortable working with large and complex datasets, validating information, identifying inconsistencies, and forming accurate, thoughtful analysis. Self-motivated, thorough, accurate, and able to work with minimal supervision while maintaining strong attention to detail. Able to communicate and collaborate effectively across multiple levels of the organization, including facility leaders, cross-functional partners, and senior leadership. Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and business needs. 

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some Additional Benefits We Offer Include

Merchandise discountsPerformance-based incentivesAnnual merit reviewEmployee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial adviceTuition reimbursement

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

rows.title: Sr. Director, Compensation
rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The People Team

The People Team is responsible for shaping every aspect of the employee experience at eBay. We drive business performance through talent acquisition, learning and development, compensation, benefits, people operations, employee experience, and people technologies. We are committed to creating an environment where employees can thrive while enabling the business to achieve its strategic objectives globally.

The Opportunity

eBay is seeking an accomplished and strategic Senior Director, Compensation to lead the vision, strategy, governance, design, communication, and execution of our global broad-based compensation programs. This is a highly strategic leadership role responsible for ensuring eBay’s compensation programs support employees around the world, reinforce trust and transparency, and strengthen our ability to attract, retain, and engage top talent.

In this role, you will work closely with senior business leaders, the People Leadership Team, People Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, People Analytics, Legal, and other cross-functional partners to align compensation programs with eBay’s business objectives, talent strategy, and compensation philosophy.

Reporting to eBay’s VP, Total Rewards, Global Mobility, and M&A, you will lead a high-performing global team of compensation partners who combine analytical rigor with strong business partnership.

What You Will Do

Compensation Strategy & Program Design

Set the long-term vision and multi-year strategy for eBay’s global compensation programs, ensuring our compensation philosophy continues to differentiate eBay in a highly competitive market for talent while anticipating future workforce and regulatory trends.Drive the design, implementation, communication, and continuous improvement of compensation programs globally, ensuring alignment with eBay’s business objectives, talent strategy, compensation philosophy, and competitive talent needs.Serve as an enterprise thought leader on compensation, translating external market trends, competitive intelligence, workforce insights, and evolving regulations into forward-looking strategies and clear, actionable business recommendations.Oversee recognition program strategy and effectiveness, ensuring programs reinforce eBay’s culture, performance expectations, and employee experience.Foster strong collaboration across People, Finance, Legal, Talent Acquisition, People Analytics, regional teams, and external partners to deliver scalable, equitable compensation solutions with measurable impact. 


Business Partnership & Compensation Delivery

Act as a trusted advisor to senior executives, People leaders, and cross-functional partners, helping shape workforce and talent decisions through thoughtful compensation strategies that balance business and people priorities, market competitiveness, sound governance, and employee experience.Navigate complex, ambiguous business challenges by balancing competing priorities, bringing clarity to high-impact compensation decisions, and making informed tradeoffs. Lead compensation partner support for annual and mid-year compensation planning, ensuring strong governance, leader enablement, effective execution, and consistent application of eBay’s compensation philosophy.Advise on compensation-related activities, including strategic new hire compensation, promotions, domestic and international transfers, retention plans, and other critical talent decisions.Drive innovation by leveraging emerging technology, responsible AI practices, and market practices to enhance eBay’s approach to compensation, simplify processes, and improve the employee experience.Partner with Executive Compensation and Total Rewards leadership on executive offers, annual executive pay review, executive separations, and Compensation and Human Capital Committee materials, as needed.Own the compensation communication and education strategy, with a focus on leader enablement, employee understanding, transparency, accessibility, and effective program adoption.


Governance, Analytics & Compliance

Establish and maintain compensation governance, including decision rights, approval frameworks, exception management, program documentation, audit readiness, and alignment with eBay’s compensation philosophy.Define and use compensation analytics, market benchmarks, pay equity insights, workforce trends, and program effectiveness metrics to guide strategy, decision-making, and continuous improvement.Lead or influence job architecture, leveling, and job evaluation initiatives to support scalable organization design, career frameworks, market alignment, and internal equity.Monitor global legal and regulatory developments impacting compensation, including pay transparency, pay equity, incentive compensation, and compensation reporting requirements; partner with Legal and People teams to ensure compliant and equitable practices.Balance global compensation philosophy and governance with locally relevant, compliant, market-competitive solutions across regions.


Leadership & Enterprise Initiatives

Build, coach, and lead a high-performing global compensation partner team, strengthening business partnership, analytical capability, technology-enabled practices, execution discipline, and talent development.Lead compensation-related due diligence, integration planning, and execution associated with M&A activity.Lead, participate in, and partner on broader global Total Rewards programs, projects, and initiatives.


Who You Are

Strategic, curious, and agile leader with 15+ years of experience designing, managing, and evolving compensation programs in complex, global organizations.Trusted advisor and influential partner who builds strong relationships with senior business leaders, People Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, People Analytics, Legal, and cross-functional stakeholders.Strong compensation strategist with deep understanding of broad-based compensation, incentives, market pricing, job architecture, pay equity, pay transparency, and global compensation practices.Data-driven decision maker who uses market data, workforce insights, pay equity analysis, and program metrics to develop clear recommendations and drive action.Executive communicator who can translate complex compensation topics into clear business cases, leadership recommendations, and employee-facing messages.Enterprise leader equally comfortable defining long-term strategy, influencing executive stakeholders, and being hands-on to solve complex problems and ensure disciplined execution.Experienced people leader who can coach, develop, and inspire high-performing global or matrixed teams.Proven ability to lead organizational change, build alignment across diverse stakeholders, and successfully implement transformational initiatives at enterprise scale.Strong project and process leader with the ability to manage complex initiatives, prioritize effectively, and deliver high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.High-integrity operator who can balance governance, business judgment, confidentiality, and client service in ambiguous or sensitive situations.Proficiency with compensation analytics, Excel, PowerPoint, and global people systems.


Additional Requirements

Bachelor’s degree.Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.


Additional Details

The applicable base pay range for this position is dependent on work location. The base pay range in the San Francisco Bay Area, New York City Metro and Seattle Metro is expected in the range below:

$240,000 - $320,400

The base pay range for all other U.S. work locations is expected in the range below:

$185,600 - $271,300

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.
