Job Title: Data Architect 
Who You'll Work WithOur Data Architecture & Engineering teams helps organizations modernize their data ecosystems and build the foundations required for analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and Generative AI. We partner with clients to design scalable, secure, cloud-native data platforms that enable better decision-making, operational efficiency, and innovation. Slalom maintains strategic partnerships and deep expertise across the leading cloud and data platforms, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Databricks, and Snowflake. Our Data Engineering teams regularly work across multiple technologies, and we also have Centers of Excellence dedicated to each of these platforms. While expertise across all platforms is not required, your experience, interests, and strengths will help determine which team and opportunities are the best fit for you.
What You'll DoAs a Data Architect, you will help clients design and deliver modern, scalable data platforms that enable analytics, AI, machine learning, and Generative AI solutions. Working closely with client stakeholders, engineers, and Slalom teams, you will guide architecture decisions while remaining connected to delivery and implementation.You will:Design and evolve cloud-native data architectures, including data lakes, lakehouses, data warehouses, and real-time data platforms.Translate business objectives into scalable, secure, and maintainable data solutions.Lead architecture and technical design efforts from discovery through implementation.Partner with engineering teams to deliver modern data platforms across AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, and related technologies.Design and operationalize AI-ready data foundations that support analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic AI workloads.Apply AI-enabled engineering practices to improve quality, productivity, and delivery outcomes.Facilitate architecture workshops, technical discovery sessions, and stakeholder alignment.Mentor engineers and architects, helping grow technical capabilities and foster a culture of learning and innovation.Collaborate with Slalom's Data Engineering teams and platform Centers of Excellence to share best practices and advance delivery excellence.Support business development activities, including solution design, client conversations, and technical pre-sales efforts.
What You'll BringYou are a collaborative architect who enjoys solving complex business challenges through modern data and AI solutions. You combine strong technical expertise with the ability to communicate effectively across stakeholders, helping organizations transform data into business value.Required Experience8+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or related technical disciplines.Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms and modern data architectures.Strong understanding of data lakes, lakehouses, data warehouses, streaming architectures, and data governance concepts.Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and a desire to continue expanding your expertise across the broader cloud ecosystem.Experience leading architecture efforts from discovery through implementation while remaining engaged in delivery.Strong communication, consulting, and stakeholder management skills.Passion for mentoring others, continuous learning, and emerging technologies.Technical ExperienceWe recognize that great architects develop expertise in different technology ecosystems. We do not expect candidates to have deep experience in every platform we support.Experience in many of the following areas is preferred:Cloud platforms and modern data ecosystems, including AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, and related services.Data engineering and analytics technologies, including distributed processing, batch and streaming architectures, data integration, orchestration, and modern data platform design.Development and engineering practices using technologies such as Python, Java, SQL, APIs, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and containers.Data management disciplines including data modeling, governance, metadata, quality, security, and platform operations.AI, machine learning, and Generative AI solutions, including AI-enabled engineering practices, MLOps, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector technologies, and agentic AI architectures.Designing, building, and operationalizing data platforms that support analytics, AI, ML, and Generative AI workloads at enterprise scale.Nice to HaveCloud, Databricks, Snowflake, or platform-specific certifications.Experience with multi-cloud environments and data platform modernization initiatives.Experience supporting AI transformation, data strategy, or technical pre-sales activities. Hybrid/In office: We are hybrid but there are expectations that if your team leader requires you onsite that you are able to meet those expectations/requirements

rows.descriptionText:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

The People Team drives our values of being kind, smart and creative across Snap's global workforce. We work together to empower our teams to hire thoughtful and passionate innovators, help people do their best work, grow their careers and build healthy and productive workspaces in a safe, and cohesive community. Together, we are Talent, Total Rewards, IDEA (Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Awareness), HR Tech, People Analytics, People Services, Council, Learning & Development, and Employee Relations.

We’re looking for an Employee Relations Business Partner to join the People Team at Snap Inc! This role can be based in our Santa Monica, CA; Bellevue, WA or New York office.

What you’ll do:

Conduct thorough investigations of complaints of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation and other complex employee relations matters including preparing investigative reportsManage reasonable accommodation requests from intake through resolution including leading interactive process discussions and making determinations Assist with employee handbook updates and rollouts and contribute to policy developmentPartner with ER Manager for anti-harassment training and other regulatory training including completion of audits Prepare, track and maintain ER metrics for accommodations and investigations and assist with reports for senior managementAnalyze investigation and accommodation case activity to determine trends/recommendationsProactively and strategically support ER programs at SnapOther duties as assigned

Knowledge, skills & abilities:

Excellent written and communication skills as well as interpersonal skillsDetail-oriented with strong analytical and problem solving skillsWell-developed critical thinking and decision making skillsAbility to work independently and collaboratively within a team environmentPossess empathy and understanding of need to maintain confidential and sensitive informationBasic knowledge of employment laws and applicable policies 

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree5+ years of Employee Relations, Human Resources, or related work experience

Preferred Qualications:

Master’s in Human Resources or J.D. 

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable).

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

The TikTok Video team works on the systems behind the For You Feed, TikTok’s personalized recommendation experience. We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

Candidates who pass resume screening will be invited to participate in Our Company's technical online assessment.

 Build globalized large-scale recommendation system; Build extremely efficient and reliable data pipelines for candidates generation, ranking system, profile generation, training examples generation, realtime online training, etc; Coach AI to perform release process and production operations, including online anomaly detection and diagnose, release safeguards, etc.

rows.descriptionText:
We are looking for an experienced engineer to lead performance autotuning on MTIA — Meta's custom training and inference accelerator. You will lead the MTIA Software Performance Autotuning team (part of Infra Foundations) and own how we extract maximum performance from our hardware, automatically and at scale.Every kernel, every compiled graph, and every runtime configuration has a large space of possible implementations — tile sizes, scheduling, memory layouts, fusion decisions, precision choices — and the right one depends on the chip, the model, and the shape. Hand-tuning does not scale. The team's core mission is to make MTIA fast by default: building the search infrastructure, cost models, and tuning methodology that finds the best configuration without a human in the loop. As a technical leader, you will define our autotuning strategy, architect the search and benchmarking infrastructure, and partner closely with compiler, kernel, runtime, and product (e.g., Ads Ranking, Recommendation Systems, GenAI) teams to turn performance headroom into shipped speedups.Autotuning operates across the full MTIA software stack — FX graphs, compiler, kernels, runtime, PyTorch — which means lots of cross-team collaboration. We partner closely with machine learning engineers across Ads, Instagram/Facebook, and Meta Superintelligence Labs teams whose models run on MTIA.

Meta is seeking an experienced Production Systems Engineer to join our Fleet Systems Engineering (FSE) team. Our servers and data centers are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure operates efficiently to deliver our innovative services. rows.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Noom is on a mission to help people live better, longer. We’re a consumer-led digital health company, connecting people to content, coaching, community, and clinicians, to build lasting habits and live healthier lives. We’re a high-growth organization powered by science, technology, and world-class talent. When you join Noom, on any team, you’ll see the impact of your work on the world.

Our Growth Marketing Team

Noom’s Growth Marketing team helps introduce millions of people to products that support healthier, longer lives. We combine creative thinking, rigorous measurement, and rapid experimentation to efficiently acquire customers and unlock new opportunities for growth. We work closely with teams across Noom to translate customer insights into high-performing campaigns and experiences.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to own and scale Noom’s paid social program. This is a highly visible, hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can independently set strategy, manage significant media investment, and make data-driven decisions based on metrics such as LTV, CAC, and incrementality. You’ll optimize established channels while also building paid social strategies for new Noom products and audiences.

You’ll have meaningful ownership over a growing area of Noom’s portfolio, partnering closely with Creative, Growth Product, and Analytics and regularly communicating performance, insights, and recommendations to senior and C-suite leaders.

What You’ll Do

Own paid social strategy, execution, optimization, and budget allocation across Meta, Pinterest, Snapchat, and Reddit, managing more than $100K in monthly spend.Improve customer acquisition and LTV-to-CAC performance through structured experimentation, measurement, and channel optimization.Identify opportunities to scale existing channels and test new platforms, audiences, creative approaches, and campaign structures.Build paid social strategies for new Noom products and translate business objectives into actionable acquisition plans.Partner with Creative, Growth Product, and Analytics to improve campaign performance across the full customer journey.Communicate insights and recommendations to senior leaders while independently driving cross-functional workstreams forward.

What We’re Looking For

Deep, hands-on paid social experience within a direct-to-consumer, ecommerce, or similarly performance-focused business.Advanced knowledge of Meta and experience with additional platforms such as Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit, Youtube, and TikTok.Strong command of direct-response marketing, including CAC, LTV, conversion, incrementality, and performance optimization.Experience managing meaningful media budgets and using approaches such as marketing mix modeling or multi-touch attribution to inform investment decisions.A proactive, independent operator who can set direction, anticipate next steps, and effectively partner across the organization.A confident communicator who can translate complex performance insights for senior and C-suite leaders, with some experience managing or mentoring others.

What Makes This Job Amazing

Own a critical growth channel. You’ll have end-to-end ownership of Noom’s paid social strategy, investment, and performance.Make a visible business impact. Your work will directly influence customer acquisition, growth efficiency, and the success of Noom’s expanding product portfolio.Build what comes next. You’ll scale established channels while creating paid social strategies for new products and audiences.Shape the program. You’ll have the autonomy and senior-level exposure to define and implement your vision for paid social.

What You’ll Earn And Enjoy

Pay that reflects your impact. Compensation benchmarked to the market and shaped by your impact and value.Investment in your future. A 401(k) with company match to help you build long-term financial security.Time to truly recharge. Paid holidays, generous time off, Summer Fridays, and a company-wide Summer Break week so the whole team can unplug together.Care that covers it all. Access to top-tier medical plans for you and your family, including a premium-free plan option, alongside dental, vision, and life insurance.Support for growing families. Paid parental leave to give you the time and flexibility to focus on what matters most.And more to help you thrive. Stock awards, a performance-based bonus, and exclusive access to Noom's products, so you can grow with us, win with us, and enjoy what we build.

The base salary range for this position is $134,000–$175,000. Actual compensation is determined by job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

This role is eligible for our NYC or Princeton office locations, operating on a hybrid schedule (2 days per week on-site).

More About Noom

Noom is a leading whole-person health platform on a mission to help people live better, longer. We combine personalized medication with the science of behavior change and psychology, to help people build lasting habits and live longer, healthier lives. With nationally-recognized, holistic programs spanning weight, diabetes prevention, GLP-1 support, menopause, longevity, and more, we serve millions through health plans, employers, and direct-to-consumer offerings. As a trailblazer in the world of health and wellness, Noom makes healthy living easy, fun, and deeply rewarding.

We're more than a health tech company—we're a movement. This belief extends to our culture: we empower our people to think big, act boldly, and take pride in their contributions to shaping the future of health. We've been named one of the Best Places to Work by Inc., Fortune, Glassdoor, and Quartz—including honors for technology and diversity.

Join us in shaping the future of health. You'll be part of a passionate, mission-driven team working to make the world a healthier place—one habit at a time.

To help protect against potential hiring scams, please be aware that all email communications from the Noom Talent team and/or hiring managers will come only from an @noom.com email address. Please ignore any messaging or communication from other domains (e.g. @noom.team). Noom will never ask you for personal payment, require you to purchase equipment, conduct an interview process or messaging exchange via Microsoft Teams, or extend a job offer without the completion of a multi-step interview process featuring a combination of phone, Zoom, and in-person interviews, as well as references. If you are unsure about the validity of a Noom job posting on another website, we strongly encourage you to apply directly through our website.

rows.title: Sr. Manager, Creative Strategy, Hers
rows.descriptionText:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About The Role

At Hims & Hers, we know that telling empathetic, engaging, and uplifting stories about health is how we make people comfortable on the path to better health. We also know that creative is the key to an effective modern growth engine: what grows brands is brilliantly executed ideas across channels.

We’re hiring a Senior Manager of Creative Strategy to drive that engine at Hers: someone who understands and respects the creative process, and can tie it back to the analytical thinking and metrics at the core of modern brands. You’ll turn customer insight and performance data into ideas that help millions of people discover and engage with our products across Meta, YouTube, TikTok, and emerging channels.

You’ll lead a dedicated creative pod, partnering closely with editors, producers, media buyers, and creative leaders to develop, test, and scale high-performing creative across channels, and you’ll help build the systems that allow winning ideas to move quickly across categories and campaigns. The best candidates are just as comfortable reviewing performance dashboards as they are developing the next winning creative concept.

You Will

Own the creative strategy for the Hers brand across performance marketing channels, ensuring every campaign reflects the brand while driving measurable business results.Use performance data, customer insights, and market trends to develop creative hypotheses, concepts, scripts, and production-ready briefs.Shape creative that helps women feel informed, supported, and confident throughout their healthcare journey while delivering work that is emotionally resonant, stigma-free, and unmistakably Hers.Establish a high bar for creative strategy and briefing, ensuring every concept is grounded in customer insight, a clear hypothesis, and measurable success criteria.Lead a multidisciplinary creative pod, partnering closely with editors, producers, and studio teams to develop high-quality creative.Create fast, effective feedback loops across Creative, Growth, and Media Buying to continuously improve performance.Partner with Growth, Creative, and Analytics leaders to rapidly test, learn, and iterate using performance data to continuously improve creative effectiveness.Partner with Product, Clinical, Legal, and Brand teams to ensure creative accurately reflects our products while meeting regulatory requirements.Lead regular performance reviews, providing visibility into wins, key learnings, strategic pivots, and new growth opportunities.Capture and scale what works by building repeatable creative frameworks that can be adapted across products, audiences, and markets.Operate confidently within healthcare marketing guardrails, partnering across Legal, Medical, and Marketing teams.

You Have

First and foremost: a strong portfolio of performance creative that has won at scale on paid social: you can show the work, the data behind it, and the customer insight that made it win.5+ years of experience in creative strategy, content strategy, or performance creative (ideally in-house at a high-growth ecommerce or DTC brand) including experience leading teams and building creative functions.Deep expertise developing creative for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other performance channels, with a strong understanding of platform-specific creative best practices.Deep data fluency: you are comfortable in ad performance data, can identify actionable patterns yourself, and let evidence lead creative decisions.Experience managing multidisciplinary creative teams and collaborating across marketing, design, and product functions, including with remote or distributed post-production teams.Strong ownership mindset with the ability to move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information, and continuously iterate based on performance.Exceptional business acumen with the ability to connect creative decisions to customer behavior, business performance, and long-term brand growth.

Bonus If You Have

Experience in telehealth, healthcare, weight loss, or another regulated or sensitive categoryExperience standing up in-house creative teams or transitioning work from external agenciesExperience adapting and localizing winning creative across international marketsFamiliarity with UGC and creator-driven production models, including remote capture

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we’ve tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it’s supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we’re not just here to move money— we’re here to move our global customers forward.

We’re looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that’s you and you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About the Role:

Remitly is building the Remitly Global Card, a card and wallet that give customers a single, trusted place to hold, spend, and move their money, launching across multiple geographies. As a Staff Engineer on the Global Card team, you will set the technical direction for the product end to end: the screens customers see, the APIs behind them, and the services that issue cards, hold balances, and move money. You will take the lead on large, cross-team initiatives, serve as a senior technical voice across product and engineering, and hold the correctness and trust bar a regulated money product demands, all on a team that moves fast and builds with AI in the loop every day, where agentic coding tools are part of how we work, not a side experiment. You will report to the Engineering Director and work in a hybrid capacity from our Arlington, VA office.

You Will:

Own the technical direction and architecture of the Global Card product, from customer-facing web and mobile surfaces to the services and integrations that issue cards, hold balances, and move money, taking the lead on large, cross-team initiatives.Design and build for scale, solving ambiguous and complex problems using full stack technologies (React, GraphQL, Java/Kotlin) in a regulated environment where reliability, security, and compliance shape engineering decisions.Partner with product, design, analytics, and engineering leaders to shape the Card roadmap, advise domain-level planning, and lead design reviews.Make AI-native engineering a durable practice on the team: set the bar, own the team's automation as a maintained portfolio, and extend those standards to teams you work closely with.Evolve engineering excellence standards (reliability, observability, security, quality) and resolve the long-standing problems that limit scale before they become bottlenecks.Raise the engineering bar by mentoring engineers at multiple levels through design and code reviews, and expanding team knowledge and skills.Stay hands-on across TypeScript, React/React Native, Java/Kotlin, and Go, and set the standard in code review.

You Have:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.8+ years of professional software development experience, with experience building and operating systems end-to-end.4+ years of hands-on React or React Native development experience, and experience building customer-facing experiences at product scale.Proficiency in TypeScript/React (or similar) plus a backend language (Node.js, Java, Kotlin, Go, or Python).Experience leading team and cross-team design reviews, and designing for extensibility.Experience using AI throughout the software development lifecycle, from authoring agents to drafting technical specs and prototypes, and helping others apply it well.Experience with distributed, large-scale systems and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).Bonus: Experience in FinTech, lending, or payments. industry where reliability, security, and compliance shape engineering decisions.

Compensation Details

The starting base salary range for this position is typically $208,000 - 260,000 USD Annual. In the U.S., Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Benefits:

Flexible paid time offHealth, dental, and vision + 401k plan with company matchingPaid parental, medical, military and family care leaveMental Health & Family Forming BenefitsEmployee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)Continuing education

Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster. For corporate team members, we have an in-office expectation of at least 50% of the time monthly, typically achieved by coming in three days a week. This creates a consistent, meaningful overlap that supports team norms and business needs. Managers also have the flexibility to set higher expectations based on their team's specific needs. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

Remitly is an E-Verify Employer

rows.descriptionText:
Noom is on a mission to help people live better, longer. We’re a consumer-led digital health company, connecting people to content, coaching, community, and clinicians, to build lasting habits and live healthier lives. We’re a high-growth organization powered by science, technology, and world-class talent. When you join Noom, on any team, you’ll see the impact of your work on the world.

Our Product Team

Product at Noom sits at the intersection of science, technology, and human behavior. Our teams translate deep behavioral science and clinical expertise into intuitive, engaging digital experiences that help millions of people achieve better health outcomes.

Within Product, the Noom Health team owns the strategy, development, and optimization of the programs and capabilities that drive member outcomes across our enterprise partnerships.

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to join Noom Health, Noom’s fast-growing suite of enterprise offerings. This is a true crossover role spanning Noom Health’s intervention sets: you’ll build member-facing experiences that keep people engaged in the Noom app while ensuring every feature supports meaningful outcomes for the health plans and employers that sponsor our programs.

Reporting to the Director of Product, B2B, you’ll lead a portfolio of initiatives from strategy and problem definition through development, launch, and ongoing optimization. Success requires a strong understanding of consumer engagement, along with the ability to connect the member experience to measurable partner value.

You Will

Act as a domain expert in the needs of our members and enterprise customers, including health plans, PBMs, employers, channel partners, and internal stakeholders across Commercial, Client Success, and Clinical teamsDevelop product strategies, roadmaps, milestones, and success metrics that balance member needs, business goals, and partner requirementsBring strong consumer instincts to the product experience, with a keen understanding of what drives engagement, reduces friction, builds habits, and keeps members active over timeLead cross-functional teams across Product, Design, Engineering, Data, QA, and Clinical Operations through the full product development lifecycle, from discovery through launch and iterationTranslate ambiguous member, customer, and business problems into clear product requirements, prioritized solutions, and actionable plansMeasure and improve product capabilities through experimentation, quantitative analysis, user feedback, and program performance dataPartner with external vendors and technology partners to define integration requirements and deliver scalable product experiencesCollaborate closely with Commercial and Client Success teams to understand customer needs and ensure successful implementation and adoption of new capabilitiesLeverage a powerful suite of proprietary AI-enabled product development tools that unlock the capabilities of PMs to drive rapid impact

About You

You've probably lived on both sides of this fence before—maybe you cut your teeth on a consumer product thinking about activation and retention, then moved into B2B or enterprise and had to learn how to translate user behavior into a partner's ROI story, or vice versa.

If you're energized by holding both the member experience and the partner outcome in your head at the same time, this role may be for you!

Meaningful member impact. You’ll expand and improve programs that help people build healthier habits and achieve life-changing outcomes.High ownership and visibility. You’ll own revenue-relevant capabilities within one of Noom Health’s fastest-growing areas.Influential partnerships. You’ll work directly with major health plans, employers, and PBMs on some of the most important challenges in digital health.The ability to move quickly. You’ll use powerful AI-enabled tools to accelerate product development and turn ideas into impact.Mission-driven work. You'll be part of a company where every feature you build supports healthier lives at scale.

What You’ll Earn And Enjoy

A 401(k) with company match to help you build long-term financial security.Time to truly recharge. Paid holidays, generous time off, Summer Fridays, and a company-wide Summer Break week so the whole team can unplug together.Care that covers it all. Access to top-tier medical plans for you and your family, including a premium-free plan option, alongside dental, vision, and life insurance.Support for growing families. Paid parental leave to give you the time and flexibility to focus on what matters most.And more to help you thrive. Stock awards, a performance-based bonus, and exclusive access to Noom’s products, so you can grow with us, win with us, and enjoy what we build.

The base salary range for this position is $164,000–$215,000. Actual compensation is determined by job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

This role is eligible for our NYC or Princeton office locations, operating on a hybrid schedule (2 days per week on-site).

More About Noom

Noom is a leading whole-person health platform on a mission to help people live better, longer. We combine personalized medication with the science of behavior change and psychology, to help people build lasting habits and live longer, healthier lives. With nationally recognized, holistic programs spanning weight, diabetes prevention, GLP-1 support, menopause, longevity, and more, we serve millions through health plans, employers, and direct-to-consumer offerings. As a trailblazer in the world of health and wellness, Noom makes healthy living easy, fun, and deeply rewarding.

rows.title: Senior Data Science Manager, Pricing
rows.descriptionText:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 3 days in office)

Pricing at Marshmallow

The Pricing team shapes how we understand risk and make pricing decisions that support sustainable growth. It plays a critical role in Marshmallow’s ambition by protecting loss ratio performance and turning complex data into clear commercial action.

We work closely with claims, finance, product and other teams, to build a holistic view of risk and keep our pricing approach effective as we scale. The team acts as a key bridge between technical analytics and business strategy, helping Marshmallow stay ahead of market conditions and make confident decisions, even where data is sparse or uncertain.

The team works across modelling, business strategy and stakeholder communication. The challenge is balancing technical judgement with clear storytelling for very different audiences. It’s a team with high impact, high visibility and plenty of momentum.

What You'll Be Doing

Owning Marshmallow’s loss ratio view across our portfolio to understand performance and recommend commercial actions, factoring in both internal drivers and wider market, and economic conditions.Leading conversations with internal and external stakeholders on pricing performance and risk trends, translating analytical outputs into clear pricing and portfolio insights for non-technical stakeholders.Managing and developing a small group of pricing data scientists while raising the quality of their work.Driving cross-functional investigation into claims and risk signals with partners across the business.Shaping how pricing data scientists are deployed across workstreams as the team’s operating model evolves.

Who You Are

You’re commercially minded and enjoy connecting the dots between pricing decisions, financial outcomes and wider market conditions, not just the underlying data.You’re comfortable using judgment in ambiguous situations, working with sparse or less credible data and making clear, well‑reasoned assumptions.You’re naturally curious about why key metrics move, and you like to step back, challenge assumptions and tell a clear story behind trends and performance.You collaborate easily with different teams (e.g. claims, finance, reserving) and communicate complex ideas in a concise, business-focused way.

What You'll Bring

Experience as a data scientist and/or data science manager in a risk-focused domain such as pricing, credit decisioning or fraud.Experience operating in commercially driven environments where performance metrics guide decisions.Experience forming clear, commercially grounded views off the back of technical analysis and communicating these clearly to senior stakeholders.Experience making sound decisions when data is incomplete or imperfect, and comfortable operating under genuine uncertainty.A collaborative approach, working seamlessly with adjacent functions, to connect pricing insights to broader business performance.

Perks of the job

Bonus scheme designed to reward high performancePrivate medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with OlivaPersonal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a yearMonthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose25 days holiday plus bank holidays4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

Our process

Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)Past Experience interview with Hiring Manager (60 mins)Systems Design & Technical interview with a couple of the team (90 mins)Culture interview (60 mins)

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

CRM sits within the User Experience team, helping Marshmallow build more effective, joined-up communication with our customers across the business. CRM is a meaningful driver of impact for the organisation, with clear opportunities to improve how we engage customers and measure the value of that work.

This role will help shape how CRM is used at Marshmallow by building strong foundations, enabling others to use the platform effectively, and creating the governance needed to make customer communications work better across multiple teams. We’re looking for someone who is excited by ownership, enjoys working cross-functionally, and wants to help scale CRM in a thoughtful, high-impact way. This is an individual contributor role with deep platform and governance ownership, rather than a people-management track. Your impact and progression come from the scale and quality of the systems, frameworks, and cross-team relationships you build, not from growing a team.

London (hybrid, 3 days in office)

Please note we are not in a position to offer sponsorship and/or a visa for this position.

What you'll be doing

Own and evolve Marshmallow’s CRM operations capability, helping shape how the platform is used across the organisation.Build strong governance frameworks for CRM activity, including how campaigns are prioritised, sequenced, and managed across teamsEnable and support stakeholders across the business to use CRM effectively, increasing adoption while maintaining quality and consistency.Partner cross-functionally with teams across the organisation to identify opportunities, align on priorities, and improve customer communications.Use data and testing insights to inform decisions, optimise performance, and ensure CRM activity is driving measurable impactDrive high-quality campaign execution through strong operational processes, audience segmentation, scheduling, and platform management.

Who you are

You’re a self-starter who is comfortable with a high level of autonomy and enjoys taking ownership of ambiguous, high-impact work.You’re curious and collaborative, and you like working with lots of different stakeholders to move work forward.You’re someone who believes in enabling others, not gatekeeping expertise, and you’re motivated by helping teams do better work togetherYou’re commercially minded and pragmatic, with a strong instinct for where to focus your time to unlock the most value

What you'll bring

Experience working in CRM operations or CRM management within an in-house, tech-led business, with a strong understanding of growth-focused customer communications.Recent hands-on experience with Braze is preferable for the role, alongside practical experience building and managing CRM campaigns, segmentation, metadata, scheduling, and audience setupProven experience creating CRM governance and enabling other teams to use CRM effectively across an organisationStrong data literacy, including analysing campaign or email test performance, pulling audiences and segments, and working independently with data rather than relying entirely on analyst support.Confidence in using data tools or AI-assisted analysis to generate insights and support decision-making.

Perks of the job

Bonus scheme designed to reward high performancePrivate medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with OlivaPersonal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a yearMonthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose25 days holiday plus bank holidays4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

Our Process

We Break It Up Into a Few Stages

Initial call with our Talent Acquisition Manager (approx. 40 mins via Zoom)A past experience interview with our Hiring Manager (60 minutes via Zoom)An Onsite task, where we would like to see how you think on your feet (120 minutes in-person)Culture interview with one of our senior Marshmallow leads (60 minutes via Zoom)

Background checks

As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and trustworthy environment, we’ll carry out standard background checks, including a DBS and a Cifas check. These help ensure there are no ongoing criminal proceedings and support the prevention of fraud and other forms of serious misconduct. If anything of concern is identified, it may affect your eligibility for certain roles or services. Feel free to ask our Talent Acquisition team if you have any questions about this!

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

rows.title: Senior Manager, Field Quality
rows.descriptionText:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP believes in the power of humans to transform how they feel, perform and age; we serve the aspiring!

WHOOP is seeking a Senior Manager, Field Quality to lead field quality across our Hardware and Accessories & Apparel (A&A) portfolio and oversee our Failure Analysis function and Quality Lab. Reporting to the Vice President of Hardware Quality, you will translate the broader quality strategy into scalable programs, operating mechanisms, and measurable outcomes that improve product quality and the member experience. You will connect field performance, member feedback, failure analysis, manufacturing and supplier data, and product insights to identify emerging risks, drive root cause and corrective action, and ensure learnings from the field influence future product and process decisions.

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role requiring both deep quality expertise and the ability to lead through others. You will build and develop a high-performing team, establish clear quality metrics and escalation mechanisms, and partner across Supplier Quality, NPI Quality, Hardware Engineering, Accessories and Apparel, Reliability Engineering, Supply Chain, Global Operations, Membership Services, and our manufacturing and supplier network to drive continuous improvement across the WHOOP product ecosystem.

Responsibilities

Lead the field quality strategy and execution across Hardware and Accessories & Apparel, establishing KPIs, operating mechanisms, and cross-functional programs that identify emerging quality issues, prioritize risk, and drive measurable improvements in field performance and member experience.Own the Failure Analysis function, Early Field Failure Analysis (EFFA) program, and Quality Lab, establishing scalable processes and technical capabilities to rapidly characterize failures, determine root cause, and translate findings into actionable design, manufacturing, supplier, and process improvements.Build a closed-loop quality system connecting the field back to product development and manufacturing, synthesizing field returns, member feedback, reliability results, manufacturing trends, supplier performance, and failure analysis insights to identify systemic issues and influence upstream quality strategy and product decisions.Lead cross-functional resolution of complex and high-impact quality issues, partnering with Analytics, Supplier Quality, NPI Quality, Hardware Engineering, Accessories and Apparel, Reliability Engineering, Supply Chain, Global Operations, Membership Services, contract manufacturers, and suppliers to establish containment, root cause, corrective and preventive actions, and verification of effectiveness.Establish data-driven field quality management and executive visibility, defining metrics, escalation criteria, and review mechanisms in partnership with Analytics that enable teams and leadership to understand quality performance, make informed trade-offs, anticipate risk, and focus resources on the highest-impact opportunities.Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Field Quality and Failure Analysis team, setting clear priorities and performance expectations, developing technical and leadership capability, and creating scalable systems that enable the organization to operate with increasing autonomy, speed, rigor, and accountability.

Qualifications

 10+ years of experience in field quality, quality engineering, failure analysis, reliability, manufacturing quality, or a related discipline supporting consumer electronics, wearable technology, apparel/accessories, medical devices, or other complex consumer products.Demonstrated experience leading teams and complex quality programs across multiple products or product categories, with the ability to translate broad quality objectives into clear priorities, operating mechanisms, and measurable outcomes.Deep expertise in structured problem-solving and failure analysis methodologies, including root cause analysis, 5 Why, 8D, FMEA, DOE, Pareto analysis, CAPA, and related quality tools.Experience building or leading failure analysis capabilities and laboratories, including the effective application of analytical techniques and equipment to characterize product failures and drive root cause determination.Strong analytical acumen with experience using field performance, return, manufacturing, supplier, and customer/member data to identify trends, assess risk, prioritize investigations, and influence decisions.Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence technical and business stakeholders across Engineering, Product Development, Operations, Supply Chain, manufacturing partners, and suppliers in a fast-paced global environment.Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $200,000 - $245,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

The Lead will work with the broader team to drive high quality research and thought leadership, serve as the public face of Wood Mackenzie on these key areas of industry growth, lead product initiatives, and drive commercial success.

About you and how you can excel in this role

Successful analysts in Wood Mackenzie’s Power & Renewables practice are thoughtful, intellectually curious, creative and comfortable presenting to public audiences and interacting with small and large groups of executives.

Department: Royalty Tracking & BI
Reporting To: Director of Tracking & BI

As a Junior Tracking Analyst on our Royalty Tracking & BI team, you'll play a key role in supporting our Writer & Publisher Relations, Finance, Royalties, and Copyright teams by transforming data into valuable insights. You'll ensure revenue from global affiliates is accurately tracked and help identify new opportunities to maximise revenue across new and existing markets. You should be able to make sense of ambiguous business queries and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to clarify and align on deliverables. You create, improve and maintain actionable dashboards that solve business problems.You conduct ad hoc investigations, create reports, and deliver insights to Senior Management.You support income royalty analysis for external clients and internal queries.You maintain and improve processes tracking income over time.You investigate income gaps and payment anomalies with your cross-functional peers.You keep updated on incoming statements from PROs, CMOs, and direct licences to inform revenue performance.You assist with audit investigations, delivering accurate analysis and commentary.You enhance your technical skills and domain knowledge to apply in ongoing projects.You collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and address business challenges.What You'll Bring

Introductory call with a member of our Recruitment Team.Interviews with the hiring manager and team.Final stage interview which includes an onsite task. Feedback at each stage.We aim to complete the full interview process from initial application to offer within three working weeks. rows.title: Research Scientist, Robotics Pre-Training and Data Quality, DeepMind
rows.descriptionText:
Minimum qualifications:

PhD in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.Experience with algorithmic architectures, data sources, and training and inference techniques for generative multimodal models, especially for robotics applications (e.g., VLAs, WAMs).Experience optimizing models and systems (e.g., performance tuning, experimentation, and debugging).

Preferred qualifications:

Practical experience in "hill-climbing" model performance (e.g., iteratively improving training recipes and model benchmarks).Experience working with simulators and real-world robotic platforms (e.g., dexterous manipulation, multimodal sensing).Experience with benchmarking, different data sources, data labeling strategies, and data mixture optimization for robotics foundation models.A passion for bringing research from the lab to robust, real-world robotic systems.Proven ability to build and maintain the software tools for rapid iteration on research ideas.

About The Job

As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

For this position, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about solving robotic problems in the real world and eager to get direct with foundation model training.

In this role, you will have experience with robot policy training using imitation learning and related techniques, alongside experience navigating the realities of pre-training. You should be enthusiastic about—and experience with—practical considerations such as data quality, mixture optimization, data labeling, systematic benchmarking, scaling ladders, performance hill-climbing. You will manage large volumes of multimodal data and optimizing data mixtures for training general, non-robotics frontier models (including LLMs, VLMs, image/video generation, and world models).

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Responsibilities

Drive data quality, acquisition, and labeling strategies, and oversee mixture optimization for robotics foundation models.Coordinate training runs, improve training recipes, and systematically hill-climb model performance against benchmarks.Build and maintain the software tools and processes required to iterate on research ideas quickly and verify data quality through robot policy training.Contribute to our wider research agenda, including reinforcement learning, vision-language-action modeling, world-action models, and simulation, working in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.


Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. rows.title: Principal Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

As a Principal Data Scientist on the Global Experiences Data Science team, you'll sit at the intersection of cutting-edge analytics and Atlassian's most customer-facing products. Reporting to the Manager of Global Experiences Data Science, you'll bring deep technical expertise to complex, ambiguous problems — shaping how millions of users experience Atlassian's suite of products.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where you'll lead the full data science lifecycle: from defining the right questions and building robust models to influencing product strategy and communicating insights to senior leaders. You'll be a force multiplier for the team — elevating the craft of data science while partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to drive meaningful outcomes at scale.

Responsibilities

Define and drive the data science strategy for your product area, translating ambiguous business problems into rigorous analytical frameworks and measurable outcomesLead end-to-end development of ML models and statistical analyses — from problem framing and data acquisition through experimentation, deployment, and ongoing evaluationPartner with Product, Engineering, and Design to embed data-driven decision-making into the product development lifecycleOwn experimentation infrastructure and methodology for your domain, including A/B test design, power analysis, and interpretation of results at scaleIdentify high-impact opportunities through exploratory analysis, surfacing insights that influence roadmap prioritization and business strategyServe as the technical authority for data science within your team — setting standards for modeling approaches, code quality, and analytical rigorMentor and develop junior and mid-level data scientists; contribute to hiring, onboarding, and capability-building across the broader DS organizationCommunicate findings and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders and executives, translating complex analyses into actionable narrativesCollaborate cross-functionally to define metrics frameworks, north star metrics, and guardrail metrics for product and business healthDrive adoption of best practices in feature engineering, model monitoring, and responsible AI/ML across teams

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.
